english: to examine thoroughly
example_en: They had ensured the plumbing was overhauled a year ago.
example_zh: 他們曾保證水管一年前徹底檢修過。

english: the state or an instance of disagreement
example_en: It could explain the odd discordance of diseases among identical twins.
example_zh: 它可以解釋同卵雙胞胎不一致的發病現象。

english: very obvious and offensive
example_en: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Commons on the blatant violations of basic human rights.
example_zh: 代表團向下院呈交了有關公然侵犯基本人權的備忘錄。

english: play down, de-emphasize
example_en: On the issue of industrial pollution, the environmental activist plead with the government not to soft - pedal.
example_zh: 自然環境保護活動分子請求政府不要淡化工業污染問題。

english: possessing or acting with bravery or boldness
a period of new growth or activity
example_en: Popular art is experiencing a renaissance.
example_zh: 通俗藝術正在復興。

english: not harsh, severe, or strict
example_en: He believes the government already is lenient with drug traffickers.
example_zh: 他認爲政府對毒販已經很寬容了。

english: not having or providing enough of what is needed
example_en: He decided there was insufficient evidence to justify criminal proceedings...
example_zh: 他認定證據不充分無法提起刑事訴訟。

english: to accustom to accept something undesirable
example_en: We should inure ourselves to hard life.
example_zh: 我們應該使自己習慣艱苦生活。

english: not mixed with something else
example_en: After the steepest decline since the Great Depression, unalloyed optimism among veteran stock market hands is hard to find.
example_zh: 股市發生了大蕭條以來最大跌幅之後，資深股市老手中是很難找到純粹的樂觀情緒的。

english: marked by often extreme fervor
example_en: He is a fervid orator.
example_zh: 他是個慷慨激昂的演說者。

english: respected and dignified
example_en: Jack is an august soldier.
example_zh: 傑克是一個威嚴的士兵。

english: making you feel serious and thoughtful
example_en: It is sobering to realize that this is not a new problem.
example_zh: 意識到這並不是新問題，就會使人冷靜嚴肅起來。

english: excessively grasping or covetous
example_en: Rapacious developers soon bought up the land.
example_zh: 不久貪婪的開發商就把這塊地全部買下了。

english: a businessperson of exceptional wealth, power, and influence
example_en: The tycoon is on the verge of bankruptcy.
example_zh: 那名大亨瀕臨破產的邊緣。

english: extending beyond the usual or ordinary especially in size or scope
example_en: Their epic fight is the subject of a new film.
example_zh: 他們史詩般的戰鬥是一部新電影的主題

english: having corresponding points whose connecting lines are bisected by a given point or perpendicularly bisected by a given line or plane
example_en: The two wings of the building are exactly symmetrical.
example_zh: 大樓的兩翼完全對稱。

english: the principle or practice of complete abstinence from alcoholic drinks
example_en: Teetotalism is against nature.
example_zh: 滴酒不沾是違背天性的。

english: to examine carefully especially in a critical way
example_en: The statement was carefully scrutinized before publication.
example_zh: 聲明在發表前經過仔細審查。

english: not wanting or willing to do something
example_en: He was loath to admit his mistake.
example_zh: 他不願承認自己的錯誤。

english: to make very weak or tired
example_en: Idleness enervates the will to succeed.
example_zh: 懶惰削弱了成功的決心。

english: a sudden overpowering fright
example_en: Office workers fled in panic as the fire took hold.
example_zh: 火勢起來時，辦公室人員驚慌逃出。

english: not working correctly or happening in the expected way
example_en: Things started to go awry just after you left the company.
example_zh: 你剛離開公司，事情就出了岔子。

english: based on testing or experience
example_en: More than ever, economics today is an empirical discipline.
example_zh: 如今，經濟學比以往任何時候都是一門實證學科。

english: a feeble or ridiculous imitation
example_en: The parody was just a form of teasing.
example_zh: 這拙劣的模仿僅僅是戲弄的一個形式。

english: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase literally denoting one kind of object or idea is used in place of another to suggest a likeness or analogy between them
example_en: In poetry the rose is often a metaphor for love.
example_zh: 詩歌中常用玫瑰花來隱喻愛情。

english: showing or feeling very strong emotions
example_en: He made an impassioned appeal for peace.
example_zh: 他慷慨陳詞，呼籲和平。

english: capable of being easily led, taught, or controlled
example_en: He could easily manage his tractable and worshipping younger brother.
example_zh: 他能輕而易舉地管住聽話並且崇拜自己的弟弟。

english: roughly outlined
example_en: He gave us a very sketchy account of his visit.
example_zh: 他跟我們非常粗略地講了他參觀的情況

english: to change or stop the effect of
having or showing sound judgment
example_en: Far from being a dreamer, she's a level-headed pragmatist.
example_zh: 她是個頭腦冷靜的務實派，絕不是一個不切實際的人。

english: of a timid disposition
example_en: He is a reclusive, timorous creature.
example_zh: 他是個離羣索居、膽小羞怯的傢伙。

english: a state of agreement
example_en: They expressed the hope that he woul d pursue a neutral and balanced policy for the sake of national concord.
example_zh: 他們希望，爲了國家的和諧，他會奉行中立、不偏不倚的政策。

english: to move in a confused or disordered manner
example_en: They had jumbled it all up into a heap.
example_zh: 他們把所有的東西胡亂堆成了一堆。

english: a great disaster or complete failure
example_en: After the debacle of the war the world was never the same again.
example_zh: 經歷了這場戰爭的慘敗之後，世界再也不是原來的那個樣子了。

english: to goad or urge forward
example_en: His object was to instigate a little rebellion on the part of the bishop.
example_zh: 他的目的是,在主教方面煽起一場小小的造反。

english: arousing or appealing to sexual desire or imagination
example_en: The newspapers once again filled their columns with salacious details.
example_zh: 赤裸裸的猥褻細節再度充斥了報紙的版面。

english: lacking remembrance, memory, or mindful attention
example_en: He was oblivious of what was happening.
example_zh: 他已經忘卻發生什麼事了。

english: the quality of a person who is completely honest
example_en: Her probity and integrity are beyond question.
example_zh: 她的誠實和正直是無可爭辯的。

english: to agree to a request or a demand
example_en: Any country of the Union which has signed this Act may ratify it, and, if it has not signed it, may accede to it.
example_zh: 本聯盟任何國家已在本議定書上簽字者，可以批准本議定書，未簽字者可以加入本議定書。

english: to make furious
a minute or minor detail
example_en: Much of his early work is concerned with the minutiae of rural life.
example_zh: 他早期的許多作品關注的是農村生活中一些雞毛蒜皮的瑣事。

english: bewilder, perplex
example_en: We got lost in the maze.
example_zh: 我們在迷宮裏迷失了方向。

english: notably or brilliantly outstanding because of dignity or achievements or actions
example_en: The composer was one of many illustrious visitors to the town.
example_zh: 那位作曲家是許多造訪過這個城市的傑出人物之一。

english: the quality or state of being self-governing
example_en: Activists stepped up their demands for local autonomy last month.
example_zh: 上個月激進分子對地方自治的呼聲更高了。

english: extremely costly, rich, luxurious, or magnificent
example_en: We dined in sumptuous surroundings.
example_zh: 我們在富麗堂皇的環境中用餐。

english: lacking conviction: half- hearted
example_en: The study received a lukewarm response from the Home Secretary.
example_zh: 內政大臣對這項研究反應不是很熱烈。

english: not commensurable broadly
example_en: Many photographers liked to take photos for her in order to get the incommensurable beauty.
example_zh: 很多攝影師喜歡爲她拍照以捕捉那無法比擬的美。

english: an indication of approval carrying great prestige
example_en: No other shipping company had quite the cachet of Cunard.
example_zh: 沒哪家船運公司有肯納德輪船公司這樣的聲望。

english: something that incites or has a tendency to incite to determination or action
example_en: Many companies in Britain are keen on the idea of tax incentives for R& D.
example_zh: 英國許多公司都熱衷於用稅收優惠的方式來鼓勵研發。

english: one having spiritual or ecclesiastical supervision
chinese: 醜聞傳開後他辭去了主教職務。
example_en: He resigned from his post as bishop when the scandal broke.
example_zh: 醜聞傳開後他辭去了主教職務。

english: to draw in by breathing
chinese: 當地居民吸入了大火的濃煙，需要入院
example_en: Local residents needed hospital treatment after inhaling fumes from the fire.
example_zh: 當地居民吸入了大火的濃煙，需要入院治療。

english: of or relating to a clerk or office worker
example_en: He was still attired in his clerical outfit.
example_zh: 他還穿着牧師的行頭。

english: to restrain from motion, action, or progress
example_en: We reverence tradition but will not is fetter by it.
example_zh: 我們尊敬傳統,但不願被它束縛。

english: to place on a shelf
example_en: The government has shelved the idea until at least next year.
example_zh: 政府決定把這個想法先放一放，至少推遲到明年再說。

english: subsisting or feeding on animal tissues
example_en: Tigers, lions and leopards are all ferocious carnivorous animals.
example_zh: 老虎、獅子和豹都是兇猛的食肉動物。

english: to represent in a clear and obvious way
example_en: Toyota, a company that used to embo dy Japan's reputation for quality, is enmeshed in a safety and public relati ons nightmare.
example_zh: 曾作爲日本質量象徵的豐田汽車（Toyota），如今陷入了一場安全與公關夢魘。

english: the act of giving money, food, or other kinks of help to people who are poor, sick, etc.
example_en: Most of the runners in the London Marathon are raising money for charity.
example_zh: 大多數人蔘加倫敦馬拉松賽跑是爲慈善事業募集資金。

english: vast or ample in extent
example_en: The house has a spacious kitchen and dining area.
example_zh: 這座房子有一個寬敞的廚房和用餐區。

english: to prevent from doing something or to stop from happening
example_en: The accounting firm deliberately destroyed documents to thwart government investigators.
example_zh: 會計事務所故意毀壞文件，阻撓政府調查工作。

english: existing before a war
example_en: There are many antebellum houses in the area.
example_zh: 這個地區有許多南北戰爭以前的房屋.

english: reserved, shy
to induct into an office with suitable ceremonies
example_en: The new President will be inaugurated on January 20.
example_zh: 新總統將於1月20號舉行就職典禮。

english: widely acclaimed and highly honored
having or occurring in great variety
example_en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
example_zh: 西班牙是多種傳統和多個民族的合成體

english: a method of writing rapidly by substituting characters, abbreviations, or symbols for letters, sounds, words, or phrases
example_en: Ben took notes in shorthand.
example_zh: 本用速記法記筆記。

english: causing someone to feel sad or without hope
example_en: All in all, it appeared that a pretty depr essing summer awaited Jones.
example_zh: 總之，等待瓊斯的似乎是一個相當令人沮喪的夏天。

english: to imitate or mimic in an inept way （

example_zh: 以偶像爲榜樣並不是說要模仿他們的一言一行。

english: not usually good, interesting, etc.
example_en: Since then, Michael has lived an unexceptional life.
example_zh: 自那以後，邁克過着平淡的生活。

english: matching or in agreement with something
example_en: Our bilateral economic relationship is a nchored in the realization that our long- term interests are essentially congruen t and mutually reinforcing.
example_zh: 我們的雙邊經濟關係植根於兩國的長期利益基本上是一致且相輔相成的。

english: one who expends resources foolishly and self- indulgently
example_en: Her father wouldn't let her marry a wastrel.
example_zh: 她的父親不會讓她嫁給一個敗家子。

english: marked by an impassive matter-of-fact manner, style, or expression
example_en: Some people don't catch his deadpan humor, that makes it even funnier.
example_zh: 有些人不能瞭解他那種無表情的幽默,因此更有趣。

english: to set a high value on
example_en: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues.
example_zh: 她深受同事的敬重。

english: to attract and hold the attention of by being interesting, pretty, etc.
example_en: For 40 years she has captivated the world with her radiant looks.
example_zh: 40年來，她那令人驚豔的美貌讓全世界爲之癡迷。

english: not compatible
example_en: New computer software is often incompatible with older computers.
example_zh: 新的計算機軟件往往和舊式計算機不兼容。

english: excessively embellished in style or language

example_zh: 《弗蘭肯斯坦》已經是誇張的，但珀西使它更誇張。

english: to praise highly
example_en: They kept extolling my managerial skill s.
example_zh: 他們不停地讚美我的管理技能。

english: to make less severe, harmful, or painful

example_zh: 政府應努力緩解貧困問題。

english: a model or pattern for something that may be copied
example_en: He had become the paradigm of the successful man.
example_zh: 他已經成爲成功人士的典範。

english: very thorough
example_en: He has made an exhaustive study of t he problem.
example_zh: 他對這個問題進行了徹底的研究。

english: a small amount of something
example_en: Even the film's impressive finale can't hide the first hour's paucity of imagination.
example_zh: 這部電影的結局可圈可點，即使這樣也無法掩蓋前一個小時想象力貧乏的缺憾

english: having a clear decisive relevance to the matter in hand
example_en: Mrs Southern listened keenly, occasionally breaking in with pertinent questions.
example_zh: 薩瑟恩夫人興致勃勃地聽着，間或插話問一些相關的問題。

english: a person who has very strong feelings about something and who wants other people to have those feelings
to make fit, suitable, or congruous

example_zh: 這個機場的跑道正在擴建以適應大型飛機起落。

english: to revile or scold in harsh, insolent, or abusive language
example_en: Other Internet users rail at companies and government departments forcing staff to donate to national appeals.
example_zh: 其它互聯網用戶則抱怨企業與政府部門強迫員工響應國家號召，加入捐款活動

english: marked by assurance and self-control
example_en: Donald Duck-the irascible but unflappable waterfowl-prepared to be feted in grand fashion,as he turned 75 years old Tuesday.
example_zh: 本週是唐老鴨的75歲生日，這位脾氣暴躁卻鎮定自若的鴨先生將迎來盛大的生日慶典。

english: to offer for discussion or consideration
example_en: Zoologist Eugene Morton has propounded a general theory of the vocal sounds that animals make.
example_zh: 動物學家尤金·莫頓提出了一個有關動物發聲的概括性理論。

english: an underground storage compartment
example_en: Most of the money was in storage in bank vaults.
example_zh: 這筆錢的一大部分是存放在銀行保險庫中的。

english: flippant, impertinent
example_en: Don't be flip with me.
example_zh: 不要對我油嘴滑舌。

english: to make usually small adjustments in or to
example_en: He expects the system to get even better as the engineers tweak its performance.
example_zh: 他預計在工程師對其性能稍加改進後，該系統會運行得更加良好。

english: to break into small pieces
example_en: Rice flour makes the cake less likely to crumble.
example_zh: 這種糕餅用米粉做不那麼容易碎。

english: to expose to view by or as if by digging away a covering
example_en: The site has been excavated by archaeologists.
example_zh: 這個遺址已被考古學家發掘出來。

english: flamboyant, exaggerated, or sensational promotion or publicity
example_en: They announced, amid much ballyhoo, that they had made a breakthrough.
example_zh: 他們在一片喧囂中宣佈，他們取得突破性的進展。

english: having a surface luster or brightness
example_en: The leaves were dark and glossy.
example_zh: 樹葉顏色深暗，頗有光澤。

english: something that you say, give, or do to show respect or affection for someone
example_en: At her funeral her oldest friend paid tribute to her life and work.
example_zh: 在葬禮上，她最早的朋友對她的一生和工作給予了高度的讚揚。

english: a source of danger
to be better than
example_en: Sometimes small firms can outdo big business when it comes to customer care.
example_zh: 在顧客服務方面，有時小企業可能優於大企業。

english: causing unrest, violence, or disturbance
example_en: The present international situation remains tense and turbulent.
example_zh: 當前的國際局勢依然緊張動盪.

english: a rude or discourteous act
example_en: It is gross incivility to refuse answer when spoken to.
example_zh: 當人家找你說話時拒絕答應是極其無禮的事.

english: of or relating to a citizen, a city, citizenship, or community affairs
example_en: The study showed that most teens felt little sense of civic pride or responsibility.
example_zh: 研究有明，大多數青少年很少有作爲公民的自豪感和責任感。

english: to associate as a member
example_en: Our New York company has an affiliate in Los Angeles.
example_zh: 我們的紐約公司在洛杉磯有一個下屬企業。

english: given or provided abundantly
example_en: Mr Yang has a bountiful experience working with education.
example_zh: 楊先生有着豐富的教育工作經驗。

english: of or relating to the countryside or to the lives of people who live in the country
example_en: We watched from the train window as the pastoral landscapes of Burgundy unfolded.
example_zh: 透過火車車窗，勃艮第的鄉村風光展示在我們眼前。

english: excessive or unseemly frivolity
example_en: At the time, Arnold had disapproved of such levity.
example_zh: 那時候的阿諾德對這種輕浮行爲很看不慣。

english: to rescind or annul by authoritative act
example_en: Many voted for the repeal of that property law.
example_zh: 許多人投票贊成廢止那項財產法。

english: to think about or discuss something very carefully in order to make a decision
example_en: She deliberated over the decision for a long time before she made up her min d.
example_zh: 她慎重考慮了好久才下定決心作出這一決定。

english: deadly or pernicious in influence
example_en: The polls corroborate the baleful economic portents.
example_zh: 民意調查加重了這種經濟的不祥之兆。

english: having the ability to make a person feel strong or healthy again
example_en: Sure I thought of rest as refreshing, restorative and necessary.
example_zh: 當然，我認爲休息可以使人振作，恢復健康，並且是必要的。

english: easily broken or destroyed
example_en: The fragile economies of several southern African nations could be irreparably damaged.
example_zh: 一些南非國家的脆弱經濟可能會被徹底破壞，無法挽回。

english: not clear in meaning
example_en: He looked at her vague shape through the frosted glass.
example_zh: 他透過霧濛濛的眼鏡注視着她模糊的身形。

english: to cause to happen or be created
to engage in argument
example_en: He disputed the allegations.
example_zh: 他對指控表示懷疑。

english: to think about and revolve in the mind beforehand
example_en: The happiness is a kind of very spoiled thing, it can't premeditate , can't store, can't be make by will.
example_zh: 快樂是一種很嬌貴的東西，它不能預謀，不能儲備，不能靠意志來製造。

english: liking to talk and talking smoothly and easily
example_en: Would you guess women are more loquacious?
example_zh: 你會認爲女人更健談嗎？

english: a condition of weariness or debility
example_en: Symptoms of anaemia include general fatigue and lassitude.
example_zh: 貧血癥狀包括全身疲勞和睏乏。

english: changing often
example_en: Emily's mercurial temperament made her difficult to live with.
example_zh: 埃米莉脾氣反覆無常，很難與她相處。

english: action that is quickest or most effective in a particular situation
example_en: This was a matter less of morals than of expediency.
example_zh: 此舉只是權宜之計，不關乎道德問題。

english: to subdue or reduce in intensity or severity
example_en: They are trying to allay public fears about the spread of the disease.
example_zh: 他們正竭力減輕公衆對這種疾病傳播的恐懼。

english: to actively second and encourage
example_en: You've done enough to be charged with attempt to aid and abet.
example_zh: 你所作的一切足以被控教唆犯罪。

english: of or relating to a judgment, the function of judging, the administration of justice, or the judiciary
example_en: Hearing the case in open court is only one part of the judicial process.
example_zh: 公開審理這一案件只是司法程序的一部分。

english: a mixture of different things
example_en: The gross national product were seen as a hodgepodge of buicks, chickens, shirts, and diaper services.
example_zh: 把國民生產總值看成是別克牌汽車，小雞，襯衫和織補服務等的大雜燴。

english: a pretense of bravery
example_en: He behaved aggressively out of bravado.
example_zh: 他擺出一副挑釁的架勢，但只是虛張聲勢。

english: to cause to be at a loss as to what to say, think, or do
example_en: The professor is never at a nonplus, and never perplexed by a problem.
example_zh: 那位教授從未感到困惑，也沒有被任何問題所難倒。

english: to provoke impatience, anger, or displeasure in
example_en: Their attitude irritates me.
example_zh: 他們的態度激怒了我。

english: to control the course of
example_en: He managed to steer the conversation away from his divorce.
example_zh: 他設法把話題從他離婚一事上引開。

english: shut off from the light : dark, murky
example_en: Two doors along , a rubric stood out
example_zh: from the tenebrous gloom.走過兩扇門，黑洞洞的幽暗中顯現出注目的標題

english: to stop from doing something or to stop from happening
example_en: Relief efforts have been stymied in recent weeks by armed gunmen.
example_zh: 最近幾周的救援工作一直受到武裝分子的阻撓。

english: a privilege, gain, or profit incidental to regular salary or wages
example_en: Everybody is born with no perquisites.
example_zh: 每個人出生都沒有特權。

english: to give official authority or legal power to
example_en: The new law empowered the police to search private house.
example_zh: 新法律給予警察搜查私人住宅的權利。

english: to list or rate (projects, goals, etc.) in order of priority
example_en: The government is prioritising the service sector, rather than investing in industry and production.
example_zh: 政府將優先投資服務行業，而非工業和生產行業。

english: the curved path of something
example_en: It is not difficult to sketch the subsequent trajectory.
example_zh: 很容易描繪出它們最終的軌跡。

english: one who is legally appointed to transact business on another's behalf
example_en: He needed to consult with an attorney
example_zh: 他需要找個律師諮詢一下。

english: harshly and haughtily arrogant
example_en: He's so overbearing that no one wants to work for him.
example_zh: 他那麼專橫，沒人願爲他工作。

english: to make shorter
example_en: The United States of America is commonly abbreviated to U.S.A.
example_zh: 美利堅合衆國常被縮略爲 U.S.A.。

english: feeling or showing doubt about doing something: not willing or eager to do something
example_en: Scientific institutions have been reluctant to take corrective action.
example_zh: 科學機構一直不願作出更正。

english: lasting or enduring through all time
a deed notable especially for courage
example_en: The tunnel is a brilliant feat of engineering.
example_zh: 這條隧道是工程方面的輝煌成就。

english: great happiness or joy
example_en: The goal was greeted by jubilation from the home fans.
example_zh: 主場球迷爲進球歡呼。

english: to determine or influence the quality or nature of
example_en: Too often we try to mold our children into something they do not wish to be.
example_zh: 我們常常試圖把孩子塑造成他們自己不想成爲的樣子。

english: idealizing or idolizing biography
example_en: In this hagiography, his success is exaggerated.
example_zh: 在這本理想化的傳記當中，他的成功被誇大了。

english: to seize upon to the exclusion of others
example_en: They do not preempt the land surface that is useful for other purposes.
example_zh: 它們不需要預先佔用對其它目的有用的地面。

english: not to be modified or evaded
to make (someone) ashamed or embarrassed
example_en: She had been beaten and humiliated by her husband.
example_zh: 她遭到丈夫的毆打和羞辱。

english: the quality or state of being faithful
example_en: He believed in marital fidelity.
example_zh: 他認爲婚內應該忠誠。

english: having a thick edge or point
example_en: He was sawing the bread with a blunt knife.
example_zh: 他用一個很鈍的小刀切面包。

english: not focusing the mind on a matter
example_en: The government has said it was an inadvertent error.
example_zh: 政府聲稱那是因疏忽造成的過失。

english: to become smaller
example_en: Blood is only expelled from the heart w hen it contracts.
example_zh: 血液在心臟收縮的時候從心臟流出。

english: dishonest behavior that is meant to trick someone
chinese: 薩曼莎認爲他在爲其私底下兩面派的行
example_en: Samantha believed he was guilty of duplicity in his private dealings.
example_zh: 薩曼莎認爲他在爲其私底下兩面派的行爲而心生愧疚。

english: an expression of rebuke or disapproval
example_en: She was reproach by colleagues for leaking the story to the press.
example_zh: 她因爲將這件事透露給新聞媒體而受到同事的指責。

english: to declare or maintain with certainty
example_en: All entrants must warrant that their entry is entirely their own work.
example_zh: 所有參賽者必須保證其參賽作品完全是自己創作的。

english: characterized by friendly goodwill
example_en: The two countries made settlement by amicable arrangement.
example_zh: 兩國以友好調解解決爭端。

english: to seize and hold in the custody of the law
example_en: We'll need to impound your car.
example_zh: 我們要扣留你的車輛。

english: marked by keen caution, cunning, and watchfulness especially in detecting and escaping danger
example_en: Bankers are keeping a wary eye on the outcome.
example_zh: 銀行家們對結果保持高度謹慎。

english: to shorten by or as if by cutting off
example_en: He truncated a news item to fit the available space.
example_zh: 他刪節一則新聞以適應報紙的篇幅。

english: to direct or impose by authoritative order or with urgent admonition
example_en: She enjoined me strictly not to tell anyone else.
example_zh: 她嚴令我不準告訴其他任何人。

english: not usual or normal
example_en: Flying at 1,000 ft. he heard a peculiar noise from the rotors.
example_zh: 在1,000英尺的高度飛行時，他聽到旋翼發出一種奇怪的噪音。

english: by surprise
example_en: Cross was a little taken aback by her abrupt manner.
example_zh: 她魯莽的態度讓克羅斯感到有點喫驚。

english: separated by different opinions
example_en: The profession is divided on the issue.
example_zh: 對於這一問題，從業人士意見有分歧。

english: to cause great damage or harm to
lacking stability or steadiness
example_en: Isabelle was a frivolous little fool, vain and flighty.
example_zh: 伊莎貝爾是個輕佻、沒頭腦的小女人，非常虛榮又反覆無常。

english: incapable of being fatigued
example_en: His indefatigable spirit helped him to cope with his illness
example_zh: 他不屈不撓的精神幫助他對抗病魔。

english: to put things in an orderly form
example_en: The latest draft of the agreement codifi es the panel's decision.
example_zh: 最新的協議草案把專家小組的決定加以整理，形成了條文。

english: something that is unusual or unexpected
example_en: The British public's wariness of opera is an anomaly in Europe.
example_zh: 英國公衆對歌劇不大輕易接受的態度在歐洲來說很反常。

english: a strong feeling of excitement and enthusiasm
example_en: The speech aroused nationalist fervor.
example_zh: 這個演講喚起了民族主義熱情。

english: of, relating to, or characteristic of a past era
example_en: There are some traditional farmers left who still make cheese the old- fashioned way.
example_zh: 還有一些傳統的農場主仍舊在用老式的方法制作奶酪。

english: a desire or liking for something
example_en: She gave him just enough information to whet his appetite.
example_zh: 她向他透露的信息剛好能吊起他的胃口

english: official strong criticism
chinese: 這樣的誇獎我不敢當，這樣的責備我也

english: consisting of documents: written down
example_en: Last Sunday I watched a documentary program about Manchester United.
example_zh: 上週日我看了有關曼徹斯特聯隊的一檔紀實節目。

english: capable of existing together in harmony
example_en: This printer is fully compatible with all leading software.
example_zh: 這個打印機和所有的主要軟件完全兼容

english: a ruler with absolute power and authority
example_en: He was a cruel despot.
example_zh: 他是一個殘酷無情的暴君。

english: to bring together
example_en: He has assembled a team of experts to handle queries.
example_zh: 他召集了一班專家來答疑解惑。

english: to reach its highest altitude
example_en: In just a few days, a century- long struggle will culminate in a historic vote.
example_zh: 幾天之後，在歷史性的投票中，長達一個世紀的努力即將達到高潮

english: a cause or occasion of enticement
not able to be stopped or changed
example_en: His own career continues its inexorable ascent
example_zh: 他事業的上升勢頭銳不可當。

english: to walk or travel over
chinese: 一些農民離開老家，走遍全國尋找季節
example_en: Some peasants left their home village and peregrinated the country for seasonal jobs.
example_zh: 一些農民離開老家，走遍全國尋找季節工作。

english: to ask for something in a serious way
example_en: The United Nations has appealed for help from the international community.
example_zh: 聯合國已經呼籲國際社會提供援助。

english: fashionable, stylish
example_en: She is always crazy at modish things.
example_zh: 她瘋狂熱愛流行物品。

english: very surprising, shocking, or frightening
example_en: Sometimes the results may be rather startling.
example_zh: 有時結果可能會令人喫驚。

english: to carry away with delight, wonder, or rapture
example_en: Her beauty entirely entrance him.
example_zh: 她的美麗完全使他出神了。

english: of or relating to the country or country life
example_en: Tomorrow I head off with my family to a bucolic place at the edge of the continent.
example_zh: 明天我將和家人去到這塊大陸邊緣的一個寧靜鄉村。

english: the agency, function, or office of a deputy who acts as a substitute for another
example_en: Your proxy will need to sign the form on your behalf.
example_zh: 你的代理人將須代表你在表格上簽字。

english: to flourish in youthful beauty, freshness, or excellence
example_en: Not many economies bloomed in 1990, least of all gold exporters like Australia.
example_zh: 1990年經濟繁榮的國家並不多，尤其是像澳大利亞這樣的黃金出口國。

english: to examine or consider with attention and in detail
example_en: If you peruse the software industry, you'll find hundreds of commercial plug-ins and products for Eclipse.
example_zh: 如果你仔細的研究軟件業，你會發現成百上千的Eclipse的商用插件和產品。

english: a slight offense
example_en: People are not tolerant of extra-marital peccadilloes by public figures.
example_zh: 人們不能容忍公衆人物婚外過失。

english: the degree or amount of strength or force that something has
example_en: Speech is made up of sound waves that vary in frequency and intensity.
example_zh: 語音是由不同頻率和強度的聲波組成的

english: tawdrily and falsely attractive
example_en: Advertisements convey an impression, however meretricious, of the importance of the goods being sold.
example_zh: 商業廣告儘管華而不實，卻能使人對正在銷售的商品的重要性留有印象。

english: bitterly scathing
example_en: There was a vicious and vitriolic attack on him in one of the Sunday newspapers two weeks ago.
example_zh: 兩週前一份週日報紙刊登了一篇對他進行尖酸惡毒攻擊的文章。

english: using conversational style
example_en: When reading, I'm always confused wit h idioms, slang and colloquial words.
example_zh: 在閱讀中，我總是弄不清慣用語、俚語和口語詞彙。

english: to throw away because it is useless or unwanted
example_en: On no account should we discard our f ine traditions and styles of work.
example_zh: 好傳統、好作風絕不能扔掉。

english: to affirm or declare positively or earnestly
sudden and extreme
example_en: The Liberals have scored a dramatic vi ctory in this by-election.
example_zh: 自由黨在本次補選中取得引人注目的勝利。

english: desirous to the point of greed
example_en: She was avid for praise from her coach.
example_zh: 那女孩渴望得到教練的稱讚.

english: requiring immediate attention
example_en: It has becoming an exigent task to find a "new continent" of species resource s.
example_zh: 尋找生物種質資源的“新大陸”已經成爲了一個迫切的問題。

english: to confuse very much
chinese: 你不要以這個問題困惑她。

english: to form the basis or foundation of
example_en: It is our brains that are responsible for the complex social organization and the accumulation of technical, economic and scientific advances that, for better and worse, undergird modern civilization.
example_zh: 正是我們的大腦纔出現了複雜的社會組織、技術、經濟、科學進步的積累不管怎麼說，都是這些才奠定了當代文明。

english: to secure firmly
having or showing a lack of intelligence or serious thought
example_en: When you feel vacuous and unhappy, you can do some labour, such as cleaning the house, tables and windows .
example_zh: 感到空虛不快樂的時候你可以勞動一下，比如打掃房子，抹抹桌子，窗子啥的。

english: to pretend or exaggerate incapacity or illness (as to avoid duty or work)
example_en: She was told by her doctor that she was malingering.
example_zh: 醫生告訴她，她這是在裝病。

english: excessively acquisitive especially in seeking to hoard riches
example_en: They are avaricious and will do anything for money.
example_zh: 他們很貪婪，願意爲了錢做任何事情。

english: manner of treating
example_en: Parts of the motor wore out because of constant usage.
example_zh: 發動機的一些部件由於不斷使用而磨損了。

english: easily notice or seen
example_en: It is important that China play an increasingly prominent role on climate change.
example_zh: 中國在氣候變化問題上發揮日益突出的重要作用。

english: feeling or showing concern about someone who is in a bad situation
example_en: She was very sympathetic to the problems of adult students.
example_zh: 她對成年學生的問題深表同情。

english: very bad events or situations that cannot be avoided
example_en: The chairman insisted that all was not doom and gloom.
example_zh: 主席堅持說不是所有的事情都是消極和註定失敗的。

english: behaving in an unreasonably impatient and angry way, like a child
example_en: Bryant is often portrayed as petulant, selfish, and at times overbearing in newspaper coverage and magazine profiles.
example_zh: 科比常被媒體描述爲脾氣壞的、自私的球員，有時還在報紙封面和雜誌外形中顯得傲慢。

english: a mixture of various things
example_en: The show was a miscellany of song and dance.
example_zh: 那是有歌曲和舞蹈的混合表演。

english: to complain about
example_en: The poor shouldn't underestimate their own capabilities and constantly bemoan their fate.
example_zh: 窮人不應低估自身能力，也不要自怨自艾，哀嘆命運。

english: to drive or beat back
example_en: He spent most of his speech rebutting criticisms of his foreign policy.
example_zh: 他講演的大部分時間都在反駁對他外交政策的批評。

english: marked by lack of proper caution
example_en: The policeman chewed out the driver for reckless driving.
example_zh: 那位司機因爲開車莽撞，被警察狠狠批評了一頓。

english: evil reputation brought about by something grossly criminal, shocking, or brutal
example_en: He enjoyed exaggerating his infamy.
example_zh: 他喜歡誇大他的惡行。

english: limited in character or scope
example_en: The police said the murder was sectarian.
example_zh: 警方說這是一起派系謀殺。

english: to place in a very strong position that cannot easily be changed
example_en: These dictators have entrenched them selves politically and are difficult to move.
example_zh: 這些獨裁者在政治上已經站穩了腳跟，很難推翻他們。

english: full or loud in sound
example_en: The sonorous voice of the speaker echoed round the room.
example_zh: 那位演講人洪亮的聲音在室內迴盪.

english: a sickness or illness
example_en: The pharmacist can assist you with the treatment of common ailments.
example_zh: 藥劑師能幫你治療一般的小病。

english: a sudden increase in knowledge, understanding, etc.
example_en: Scientists have made a breakthrough in their treatment of that disease.
example_zh: 科學家在治療那種疾病方面已有突破。

english: proof or evidence that something exists or is true
example_en: The testimony given by him is dubious.
example_zh: 他所作的證據是可疑的。

english: of or relating to an enemy
example_en: She fixed her questioner with a hostile glare.
example_zh: 她敵意地瞪着向她提問的人。

english: to mislead the mind or judgment of
example_en: He had been unwittingly deluded by th eir mystical nonsense.
example_zh: 他不知不覺被他們故弄玄虛的胡說八道給騙了。

english: to refuse to admit or approve
example_en: The president vetoed the economic package passed by Congress.
example_zh: 總統否決了國會通過的一攬子經濟計劃

english: something that causes great destruction, violence, etc.
example_en: The Great Depression was an economic cataclysm on a scale hard to imagine.
example_zh: 大蕭條是一場規模難以想像的經濟災難

english: to damage seriously
example_en: Our camping trip was spoilt by bad weather.
example_zh: 天氣不好，破壞了我們的露營旅行。

english: a change or a set of changes that corrects or improves something
example_en: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
example_zh: 實際上寫作過程中最重要的階段是修改

english: having or preceding from authority
example_en: Amanda launched into an authoritative disquisition about contracts.
example_zh: 阿曼達就合約給出了權威性的闡述。

english: to descend or dip suddenly
example_en: Some traders said the plunge put the market more in sync with the state of the USA.
example_zh: 一些交易員說，此次大盤跳水令市場和美國經濟現狀更爲協調。

english: dealing with or affecting a great variety of different things
example_en: The negotiations have a wide-ranging scope with emphasis on trade and investment liberalization and facilitation.
example_zh: 談判涵蓋的範疇廣泛，重點是貿易和投資的自由化及便利化。

english: staying strong and in good condition over a long period of time
example_en: He bought himself a pair of durable trousers.
example_zh: 他給自己買了一條耐穿的褲子。

english: close in value or amount but not precise
example_en: The cost of the project will approximate to 10, 000 pounds.
example_zh: 這項工程的成本約需一萬英鎊。

english: not modern or current
example_en: Romania badly needs aid to modernize its outmoded industries.
example_zh: 羅馬尼亞迫切需要援助以對其過時的產業進行現代化。

english: a large number
example_en: He asked me a slew of questions.
example_zh: 他問了我許多問題。

english: to think carefully and deeply about something
example_en: As people grow older, they begin to ruminate on the uncertainty of life.
example_zh: 隨着年齡的增長, 人們開始對生活的變化無常冥思苦想.

english: to include or consist of
chinese: 工作小組由國會領導人、內閣首腦和行
example_en: The task force is comprised of congres sional leaders, cabinet heads and adm inistration officials.
example_zh: 工作小組由國會領導人、內閣首腦和行政官員組成。

english: impossible to see or notice
example_en: The slight change in the taste was imperceptible to most people.
example_zh: 這種味道的細微變化對大多數人而言是無法覺察的。

english: victualler, caterer
example_en: Over the past few years, the company has been shifting from its roots as a hardware and on-premise software vendor, toward a future as a cloud and services purveyor.
example_zh: 過去幾年，這家公司一直在努力從硬件和內部部署軟件提供商轉型成雲計算和服務供應商。

english: to take, receive, or obtain especially from a specific source
example_en: The cause of the difference may deriv e from different accounting standards used.
example_zh: 導致賬目出現差異的原因可能是採用了不同的會計準則。

english: good-natured and usually witty and animated joking
chinese: 士兵們把他當作弟弟一樣和他開着玩笑
example_en: The soldiers bantered with him as though he was a kid brother.
example_zh: 士兵們把他當作弟弟一樣和他開着玩笑

english: doing or requiring much sitting
example_en: People in sedentary jobs need to take exercise.
example_zh: 工作上要久坐的人需要做運動.

english: free from fault or error
to swell or distend with air or gas
example_en: They inflated clients' medical treatment to defraud insurance companies.
example_zh: 他們誇大客戶傷勢的嚴重性和治療情形以欺騙保險公司。

english: a feeling of being frustrated or annoyed because of failure or disappointment
example_en: But to the chagrin of many of its trading partners, the stabilization of the Chinese renminbi is most unwelcome.
example_zh: 但對中國的貿易夥伴來說，人民幣匯率趨穩可不是好事，令它們失望。

english: the act of praising or approving of someone or something
example_en: His conduct merits commendation.
example_zh: 他的行爲應該受到稱讚。

english: forestelling events
example_en: This ominous warning soon proved prophetic.
example_zh: 這個不祥的警告很快證明是有預見性的

english: awkwardly blundering or faltering
example_en: He has often been portrayed as Holmes’ rather bumbling assistant.
example_zh: 作爲福爾摩斯的助手，他通常被刻畫成一個笨手笨腳的人。

english: agreeably stimulating because of freshness or newness
example_en: People drink tea because of its variety and refreshing effect.
example_zh: 人們喝茶是因爲茶的不同品種和提神的效果。

english: to change to an opposite state or condition
example_en: Because the normal word order is reversed in passive sentences, they are sometimes hard to follow.
example_zh: 由於正常語序在被動句中被顛倒過來了，所以有時很難理解。

english: something that is joined or added to another thing but is not an essential part of it
example_en: The Party was certainly not an official adjunct of the police department.
example_zh: 該黨派肯定不是公安部門的官方附屬機構。

english: capable of adapting to varying conditions
example_en: TV game show hosts with their banal remarks and plastic smiles.
example_zh: 語言陳腐、笑容刻板的電視競賽節目主持人

english: great or imposing in size or extent
an element in experience or in artistic representation evoking pity or compassion
chinese: 引起憐憫或同情的元素
example_en: The music is full of pathos.
example_zh: 這首曲子充滿了哀傷的情調。

english: to give life, action, or spirit to
example_en: The dreary book is enlivened by some very amusing illustrations.
example_zh: 這本枯燥乏味的書加了一些精彩的插圖才變得生動有趣。

english: tediously uniform or unvarying
example_en: It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.
example_zh: 與工廠大部分工作一樣，這份工作也很單調乏味。

english: a heavy burden
example_en: For today's politicians, the treaty is becoming a millstone.
example_zh: 對今天的政治家而言，該條約正成爲一大包袱。

english: to make more acute, intense, or effective
example_en: She honed her debating skills at college.
example_zh: 她在大學時便練就了辯論技巧。

english: an unfortunate, difficult, or precarious situation
example_en: He just wants to draw attention to the plight of the unemployed.
example_zh: 他僅僅是想引起人們對失業者困境的關注。

english: not outstanding in quality or rarity
example_en: For many they clearly represent an alternative to run-of-the-mill estate cars.
example_zh: 對於很多人來說，他們顯然可以作爲普通旅行車的替代品。

english: marked by, held in, or conducted with secrecy
example_en: She is the director of clandestine operations of the CIA.
example_zh: 她是中央情報局祕密行動的負責人。

english: elastic, porous, and absorbent
example_en: We liked the bike's spongy handgrip for keeping our hands away from cold metal.
example_zh: 我們喜歡這輛自行車的軟把手，有了它，我們的雙手就不用再接觸冰冷的金屬了。

english: to become larger and rounder because of pressure from inside
example_en: Air is introduced into the stomach to distend it.
example_zh: 將空氣導入胃部使之膨脹。

english: marked by arrogant assurance
example_en: From across the desk she gave him a witheringly imperious look.
example_zh: 她從桌子對面掃了他一眼，目光咄咄逼人，凌利而專橫。

english: help bring about
example_en: Friendly contacts between different peoples facilitate the cultural and economic interchange.
example_zh: 各國人民的友好接觸促進文化和經濟交流。

english: impalpable
example_en: There are intangible benefits beyond a rise in the share price.
example_zh: 除股價上升之外還有無形利益。

english: treating all people and groups equally
example_en: Careers officers offer impartial advice to all pupils.
example_zh: 就業指導員向所有學生提供公正無私的建議。

english: to damage by rubbing, grinding or scraping
example_en: Their gossips abraded her into restlessness.
example_zh: 他們的流言蜚語使她心煩意亂。

english: to stop short and refuse to proceed
example_en: We get strong indications that his agent would balk at that request.
example_zh: 我們得到的強烈暗示是他的經紀人會迴避那個要求。

english: a statement in which you express too much pride in yourself or in something you have, have done, or are connected to in some way
example_en: The Rough Guide to Nepal is a compr ehensive guide to the region.
example_zh: 《尼泊爾概況》是一本全面介紹該地區的旅遊指南。

english: turned away from what is right or good
including a multitude of individuals
example_en: There is a multitudinous array of chemical substances that exist in the natural world.
example_zh: 自然界中存在着各種各樣的化學物質。

english: of, relating to, or characteristic of the social middle class
example_en: This is a typical bourgeois neighborhood.
example_zh: 這是一個典型的中產階級地區。

english: lacking in clarity or definition
example_zh: The lettering is fuzzy and indistinct.書寫的文字模糊難認。

english: markedly lacking in strength
example_en: The newborn baby gave a feeble cry.
example_zh: 那個新生兒哭聲很弱。

english: to prove to be false or wrong
example_en: They accepted what he had said in default of any evidence to disprove it.
example_zh: 由於沒有相反的證據,他們相信了他的話。

english: to use abusive language
example_en: The tramp reviled the man who drove him off.
example_zh: 流浪漢辱罵那位趕他走開的人。

english: punctiliously exact
example_en: Both readers commend Knutson for his scrupulous attention to detail.
example_zh: 兩位讀者都稱讚克努森對細節一絲不苟

english: an ancestor in the direct line
example_en: He was the progenitor of a family of distinguished actors.
example_zh: 他是一個著名演藝世家的先輩。

english: to engage in contemplation or reflection
example_en: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
example_zh: 這時我就會試着沉思或者做些深呼吸練習。

english: expending or bestowing profusely
example_en: He drew criticism for his lavish spending.
example_zh: 他因揮霍無度而招致批評。

english: out of date or old- fashioned
example_en: It is a shame such things have come to seem so anachronistic.
example_zh: 遺憾的是這類事物最終流於不合時宜了

english: relating to or involving general ideas or qualities rather than specific people, objects, or actions
example_en: His painting went through both representational and abstract periods.
example_zh: 他的繪畫經歷了具象風格和抽象風格兩個階段。

english: a hiding place especially for concealing and preserving provisions or implements
an inexperienced person
example_en: My son is an apprentice in a furniture maker's workshop.
example_zh: 我的兒子在一家傢俱廠裏當學徒工。

english: presaging ill fortune or trouble
example_en: The air of desertion lenDS the place a sinister aspect.
example_zh: 荒蕪的景象給這個地方蒙上了一種不祥的色彩。

english: of or relating to an order of existence beyond the visible observable universe
example_en: Today, most people no longer believe in ghosts and witches. But these supernatural beings are still a part of Halloween.
example_zh: 在今天，很多人不再相信有幽靈和巫婆，但這些神奇的人物仍然是萬聖節的一部分。

english: to regard or think of as
example_en: The sale has been held up because the price is reckoned to be too high.
example_zh: 銷售陷入停滯，因爲大家認爲價格太高了。

english: having no personal reference or connection
example_en: We must be as impersonal as a surgeon with his knife
example_zh: 我們必須像外科醫生拿手術刀時一樣冷靜客觀，不受任何感情影響。

english: to prove that someone is not guilty of doing something wrong
example_en: He was exculpated by the testimony of several witnesses.
example_zh: 幾名目擊者的證詞證明他無罪。

english: disposed to arouse or take part in or guilty of sedition
example_en: He distributed a seditious pamphlet called The Rights of Man.
example_zh: 他散發了名叫《人的權利》的帶有煽動性的小冊子。

english: brilliantly lively, stimulating, or witty
example_en: You can hardly expect scintillating conversation from a kid that age.
example_zh: 你幾乎想不到那麼點兒的孩子會說出妙趣橫生的話來。

english: deserving very strong criticism
example_en: Mr Cramer said the violence by anti- government protestors was reprehensible.
example_zh: 克拉默先生說反政府示威者的暴力活動應該受到譴責。

english: tending to produce horror in a beholder
example_en: Police have made a macabre discovery.
example_zh: 警察有了個可怕的發現。

english: a special magnetic charm or appeal
example_en: He was elected to power on the strength of his charisma
example_zh: 他憑藉其個人魅力而當選掌權。

english: to quickly move away from something shocking, frightening, or disgusting
example_en: One child shrinks away from me when I try to talk to him.
example_zh: 當我試圖和一個孩子說話時，他避開了我。

english: to gain or regain the favor or goodwill of
example_en: Sacrifices were made to propitiate the gods.
example_zh: 人們供奉祭品以求神靈息怒。

english: a law enacted by the legislative branch of a government
example_en: Corporal punishment was banned by statute in 1987.
example_zh: 1987年通過的法令明文禁止體罰。

english: to spread apart
feeling or showing strong and energetic support for a person, cause, etc.
example_en: She was a zealous worker for charitable bodies.
example_zh: 她對慈善事業充滿熱忱。

english: the use of an unnecessarily large number of words to express an idea
example_en: He is a master at circumlocution.
example_zh: 他講話很會兜圈子。

english: characterized by resolute fearlessness, fortitude, and endurance
example_en: Intrepid rally-drivers meet in Beijing for the start of the Peking to Paris Motor Challenge.
example_zh: 無畏的拉力賽選手相聚北京，參加北京到巴黎賽車挑戰賽的開賽。

english: a collection of selected literary pieces or passages or works of art or music
chinese: 除了編輯上的一些巧妙之處，這本選集
example_en: Despite some artful editing, the anthology is a weak one.
example_zh: 除了編輯上的一些巧妙之處，這本選集乏善可陳。

english: to learn so that it is fully understood and can be used
example_en: French Jews generally had been assimilated into the nation's culture.
example_zh: 法裔猶太人已經大體上被這個國家的文化同化了。

english: to want very much
to make very happy and excited
example_en: The news of victory elate the whole nation.
example_zh: 勝利的消息使得舉國歡悅。

english: of much importance or consequence
example_en: He wants to shrink the weighty state subsidy that Whitehall gives to Northern Ireland.
example_zh: 他希望能夠將政府給予北愛的重大國家補貼予以壓縮。

english: to say in a strong and definitive way that someone or something is bad or wrong
example_en: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence.
example_zh: 政界領袖昨日聯合起來對最近激增的暴力事件予以譴責。

english: to soothe or content (someone) by indulgence
chinese: 他要我改變辦公室的格局，我照做了，
example_en: He told me to change my office layout, and I did it, mostly to humor my wife.
example_zh: 他要我改變辦公室的格局，我照做了，多半是爲了迎合我太太

english: put up with
to incite or rouse as if with a goad
example_en: His opposition acted as a goad to her determination to succeed.
example_zh: 他的反對反而刺激她堅定了取得成功的決心。

english: criticism for a fault
done or said in a natural and often sudden way and without a lot of thought or planning
example_en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
example_zh: 觀衆自發地鼓起掌來。

english: expressing praise or admiration for someone or something
example_en: Meg's mother Susan Jordan was not complimentary about her daughter in the biography she wrote.
example_zh: 梅格的媽媽在書中自己寫到：自己是不應該被女兒稱讚的。

english: not uniform
example_en: He staggered on the uneven surface of the car park.
example_zh: 他搖搖晃晃地行走在停車場凹凸不平的地面上。

english: the act of giving away money or the quality of a person who gives away money
example_en: Our people are in no need of richer nations’ largesse.
example_zh: 我國人民不需要富國的施捨。

english: expressing opinions and feelings in an honest and sincere way
to make or adapt to suit a special need or purpose
example_en: Most travel agents are prepared to tailor travel arrangements to meet individual requirements.
example_zh: 爲了滿足個別需要，大多數旅行社都願意做出專門的旅遊安排。

english: to take vengeance for or on behalf of
example_en: He promised to avenge his father's murder.
example_zh: 他發誓要報殺父之仇。

english: to make stupid, groggy, or insensible
example_en: He was stupefied by the amount they had spent.
example_zh: 得知他們花了那麼多錢，他都驚呆了。

english: happening or beginning now or in recent times
example_en: Shakespeare was not contemporary with Dickens.
example_zh: 莎士比亞與狄更斯不是同時代的人。

english: to agree to or approve of something
example_en: The director has given her assent to the proposals.
example_zh: 負責人已表示同意提案。

english: the quality of having or showing discernment or good judgment
example_en: Discretion in speech is more than eloquence.
example_zh: 出言慎重勝過口若懸河。

english: to display clearly
example_en: His conversation evinces great courage.
example_zh: 他的談話顯示了很大的勇氣。

english: not energetic or excited
example_en: The critics's reaction to the film was rather tepid.
example_zh: 評論家對那部影片的反映不太熱烈。

english: intense, disordered, and often destructive rage
example_en: He stood up in a fury and flounced out.
example_zh: 他氣得一躍而起，衝了出去。

english: a very dangerous or frightening situation
example_en: My boss felt he was on the edge of an abyss; one false move and he was done for.
example_zh: 我的上司覺得自己如臨深淵，一步不慎便會永劫不復。

english: full of or exuding emotion or spirit
example_en: She has a fiery temper.
example_zh: 她脾氣暴躁。

english: resolute, determined
example_en: This is a time of decisive action and quick thinking.
example_zh: 這個時候應該果斷行動、快速反應。

english: likely to change in a very sudden or extreme way
example_en: He has a volatile temper.
example_zh: 他脾氣反覆無常。

english: showing or expressing deference
example_en: She gets excessively deferential to authorities, even when rejecting their views.
example_zh: 即便當她想反對權威的觀點的時候，她也表現得過度順從於權威。

english: pleasant or amiable in person: attractive
example_en: Everyone knows that it's wise to be friendly and personable when in the company of the boss.
example_zh: 每個人都知道在老闆的公司裏聰明的做法是友善、和睦。

english: a feeling of good friendship among the people in a group
example_en: Everyone in our class is permeated wit h the spirit of camaraderie.
example_zh: 我們班貫穿着友愛的精神。

english: a sudden change or disturbance that affects a country, organization, etc.
example_en: The country was in ruin and convulsion.
example_zh: 這個國家沒落於動亂之中。

english: the doctrine that pleasure or happiness is the sole or chief good in life
example_en: The age of hedonism is being ushered out by a new era of temperance.
example_zh: 享樂主義時代正讓位於一個注重節制的時代。

english: a person who hates or distrusts humankind
example_en: You must be some kind of cynic or misanthrope to object to such a laudable goal.
example_zh: 你一定是有點憤世嫉俗或反人類纔會反對這個值得讚賞的目標。

english: very small or too small in amount
example_en: His influence on this matter is paltry .
example_zh: 他對這件事的影響是微不足道的。

english: arousing or deserving hatred or repugnance
example_en: Herr Schmidt is certainly the most odious man I have ever met.
example_zh: 赫爾·施密特無疑是我見過的最讓人作嘔的人。

english: spread out over a large space
example_en: His talk was so diffuse that I missed his point.
example_zh: 他的談話漫無邊際, 我抓不住他的要點

english: if someone is obsessed with a person or thing, they keep thinking about them and find it difficult to think about anything else
example_en: She wasn't in love with Steve, she was obsessed by him physically.
example_zh: 她並沒有愛上史蒂夫，只是被他的外表迷住了。

english: not capable of being defended against attack or criticism
example_en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
example_zh: 從智識、道德和現實的角度來看，這一論點是站不住腳的。

english: existing or continuing in the same way for a long time
example_en: It reflects a perennial worry in the Arab world about the state of the language.
example_zh: 它反映了長久以來對阿拉伯語世界內關於該語言現狀的擔憂。

english: to search about
example_en: The team is trying to ferret out missing details.
example_zh: 該團隊正試圖搜尋遺失的細節。

english: of or relating to the worldly or temporal
example_en: Cardinal Daly has said that churches should not be used for profane or secular purposes.
example_zh: 戴利主教已經說過，教堂不應該用於非宗教或世俗的目的。

english: to stop from happening or to cause to happen at a later time
example_en: Try to anticipate what your child will do and forestall problems.
example_zh: 儘量預見你的孩子會幹什麼，並預先阻止問題發生。

english: marked by forceful and fluent expression
an imperfection or lack that detracts from the whole
example_en: Not being punctual is his greatest shortcoming.
example_zh: 不守時間是他的最大缺點。

english: easily annoyed or angered and likely to argue
example_en: He was seen as truculent, temperamental, too unwilling to tolerate others.
example_zh: 他們認爲他性格好鬥, 性情暴躁, 不大能容人。

english: not affected by personal or emotional involvement
example_en: We, as prosecutors, try to be dispassi onate about the cases we bring.
example_zh: 作爲檢察官，我們對經手的案件會盡力做到不偏不倚。

english: serious, boring, or old- fashioned
example_en: Her thoughts were staid and solemnly adapted to a condition.
example_zh: 她的思想已經定形,安於一板一眼地順應現實.

english: something that is incongruous
example_en: There is an absurd incongruity between her wealth and her lifestyle.
example_zh: 她的財富與生活方式之間幾近荒謬的不相稱。

english: a group of illustrious or notable persons or things
example_en: This book records the pantheon of the all-time greats.
example_zh: 這本書記載了古往今來的名人。

english: exaggeratedly or childishly emotional
example_en: The most common writing theme in the western newspaper is obituary report which is rich in content, varied in style, and sentimental in expression but not mawkish as well.
example_zh: 西方報紙上常見的訃聞，內容豐富、形式多樣，哀而不傷。

english: failing to show proper respect and courtesy
example_en: The teacher threatened to kick the impudent pupil out of the room.
example_zh: 老師威脅着要把這放肆無禮的小學生攆出教室。

english: a grave crime
to make a fetish of
example_en: Politicians fetishize ratings, too.
example_zh: 政治家們也盲目崇拜評級。

english: an act of approving formally or officially
example_en: The proposal met his approbation.
example_zh: 這個提議獲得了他的讚許。

english: to fasten or restrain by or as if by a tether
example_en: The officer dismounted, tethering his horse to a tree.
example_zh: 這位軍官下了馬，把馬拴在一棵樹上。

english: marked by or indicating a liking for companionship
example_en: Holmes was gregarious, a great wit, a man of wide interests.
example_zh: 福爾摩斯愛交際，非常風趣，興趣廣泛

english: deserved, appropriate
example_en: The public approved the condign punishment.
example_zh: 公衆一致稱讚這個罪判得很恰當。

english: high spirits: merriment
chinese: 彩旗增添了盛會的歡樂氣氛。
example_en: The colorful flags added to the gaiety of the occasion.
example_zh: 彩旗增添了盛會的歡樂氣氛。

english: neither perpendicular nor parallel
example_en: Our laughter startled people at a nearby table.During the time left to us, out glances were furtive,oblique.
example_zh: 我們的笑聲驚動了鄰桌的人，接下來我們的目光躲躲閃閃，遊離不定。

english: having a wide range or effect
example_en: The economy is in danger of collapse unless far-reaching reforms are implemented.
example_zh: 如果不實施影響深遠的改革，經濟就面臨崩潰的危險。

english: an exclusive or special right, power, or privilege
chinese: 修改憲法是議會獨有的權力。
example_en: Constitutional changes are exclusively the prerogative of the parliament.
example_zh: 修改憲法是議會獨有的權力。

english: the respect and admiration that someone or something gets for being successful or important
chinese: 是他在外交事務中的盡職盡責爲他贏得
example_en: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
example_zh: 是他在外交事務中的盡職盡責爲他贏得了國際聲望。

english: to treat with too much care or kindness
example_en: She coddled her youngest son madly.
example_zh: 她對小兒子過於溺愛。

english: to cause to change direction
example_en: The war did not deflect him from the p ath he had long ago taken.
example_zh: 戰爭並沒有使他放棄自己很久以前就選擇的道路。

english: to include as part of something else
example_en: We had to incorporate the company for tax reasons.
example_zh: 由於納稅的原因，我們不得不把那家公司合併了。

english: not showing enough care and attention
not causing happiness or warm feelings
example_en: It is cold and cheerless in the yard with no one there.
example_zh: 院子裏冷冷清清，一個人也沒有。

english: very unwilling to spend money
example_en: Even the parsimonious Littler paid for drinks all round.
example_zh: 即便是吝嗇鬼利特勒，無論在哪裏喝酒也都是付錢的。

english: distress or suffering resulting from oppression or persecution
example_en: Even in our awful tribulation we were quite optimistic.
example_zh: 即使在極端痛苦時，我們仍十分樂觀。

english: large and impressively beautiful
example_en: She was attracted by the majestic scenery.
example_zh: 她被這壯麗的景色所吸引。

english: basic or simple
example_en: They are deprived of the ability to exercise the most rudimentary workers' rights.
example_zh: 他們被剝奪了行使最基本的工人權利的資格。

english: full of danger
example_en: The journey through the jungle was perilous.
example_zh: 穿過叢林的旅行充滿了危險。

english: causing laughter especially because of a startlingly or unexpectedly humorous impact
example_en: Her expression is almost comical.
example_zh: 她的表情近乎滑稽。

english: to disappear entirely without a clear explanation
example_en: The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
example_zh: 魔術師在一股煙霧中突然不見了。

english: speak evil of
example_en: Either the managers have been maligned or they are not telling the truth.
example_zh: 要麼是經理們受到了污衊，要麼就是他們在撒謊。

english: of the best and most characteristic
example_en: If you can buy only one case at auction, it should be vintage port.
example_zh: 如果你在拍賣會上只能買一箱酒，那就應該是優質的波爾圖葡萄酒。

english: to promote for or as if for sale
example_en: Commercial bribery direct purpose is to facilitate transactions that sell goods or purchase merchandise.
example_zh: 商業賄賂的直接目的是促成交易，即推銷商品或者購買商品。

english: government by the best individuals or by a small privileged class
example_en: This country has never had a genuine aristocracy or an aristocratic tradition.
example_zh: 這個國家從來沒有出現真正的貴族和貴族傳統。

english: a symbol written above and to the right of a mathematical expression to indicate the operation of raising to a power
example_en: She was a leading exponent of free trade during her political career.
example_zh: 她從政期間是自由貿易的主要倡導者。

english: to detract from the good quality of
example_en: The affair could tarnish the reputation of the prime minister.
example_zh: 這一事件可能有損首相的名譽。

english: an area within which someone or something has authority, influence, or knowledge
example_en: These are questions that lie outside / that do not come within the purview of our inquiry.
example_zh: 這些問題不在我們的調查範圍之內.

english: extremely excited
example_en: One overwrought member had to be restrained by friends.
example_zh: 一位成員過於激動，朋友們不得不進行攔阻。

english: the quality or state of someone or something that will never die or be forgotten
example_en: The flame is a quasi-religious emblem of immortality.
example_zh: 火焰可以算作不朽的宗教象徵。

english: to increase in extent, volume, number, amount, intensity, or scope
example_en: The fighting escalated into a full-scale war.
example_zh: 這場交戰逐步擴大爲全面戰爭。

english: bitter deep-seated ill will
to deal with or manage wrong or ignorantly
example_en: The equipment could be dangerous if mishandled.
example_zh: 這套設備如果使用不當會有危險。

english: to diffuse through or penetrate something
example_en: Water will easily permeate a cotton dress.
example_zh: 水很容易滲透棉布衣服。

english: consisting of two parts
example_en: The machine does the calculations in binary.
example_zh: 這臺機器採用二進制進行計算。

english: causing anger
example_en: People sported swastikas and walls were covered with inflammatory slogans.
example_zh: 人們佩戴着納粹黨的曲十字標誌，牆上寫滿了煽動性口號。

english: free from ambiguity or uncertainty
not capable of being affected or disturbed
example_en: She seems almost impervious to the criticism from all sides.
example_zh: 對於來自各方的指責，她似乎無動於衷

english: marked by a lack of order or plan
example_en: He now faces another crisis in his helter-skelter existence.
example_zh: 他亂糟糟的生活中現在又面臨着另一個危機。

english: to repair, adjust, or experiment with
example_en: It is not enough to tinker at the edges; our objective must be to reconstruct the entire system.
example_zh: 只在外緣做一些小修小補是不夠的，我們的目標必須是重建整個系統。

english: torment, vex
example_en: Todd could take it, whereas I'm harrowed by it.
example_zh: 託德可以忍受，但是我卻感到很痛苦。

english: an initial and often tentative attempt to do something in a new or different field or area of activity
example_en: China's biggest property developer has made its first foray into the US with a deal for a high-end residential complex in San Francisco.
example_zh: 中國最大的房地產開發商首次進軍美國市場，簽約參與舊金山一個高檔住宅項目。

english: to cause to become viscous or thickened into a coherent mass
example_en: Blood began to coagulate around the edges of the wound.
example_zh: 血液開始在傷口的邊緣凝固。

english: to make unclear or difficult to see or remember
example_en: The writing blurred and danced before his eyes.
example_zh: 字跡變得一片模糊，在他眼前晃動。

english: someone who does not specialize in a particular area, activity, field of research, etc.
example_en: The nonspecialist will be able to obtain at least a notion of the sorts of data and argument that support evolutionary theory.
example_zh: 非專業人士至少可以瞭解支持進化論的各種數據和觀點。

english: to think deeply or carefully about
example_en: The young surgeon contemplated the difficult operation of kidney transplant.
example_zh: 年輕的外科醫生爲腎移植這一棘手的手術苦思冥想。

english: inquisitive in an annoying, officious, or meddlesome way
example_en: Imelda might think she was prying.
example_zh: 艾美達可能認爲她在刺探別人的隱私。

english: not eating and drinking too much
example_en: Already someone trying to live well would seem eccentrically abstemious in most of the US.
example_zh: 美國大部分地方，那些嘗試過簡樸生活的人，已經看起來象怪物了。

english: to interpret wrongly
example_en: An outsider might misconstrue the nature of the relationship.
example_zh: 外人可能會誤解這種關係的本質。

english: behaving in a way that shows you think you are better than other people because you are from a higher social class or know more than they do
example_en: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
example_zh: 他們非常勢利，不喜歡智力和社會地位不如自己的人。

english: to offend or insult
example_en: They felt slighted by not being adequately consulted.
example_zh: 沒有充分徵求他們的意見，這讓他們感到被冷落了。

english: accepted as true or correct by most people
example_en: They are orthodox jews.
example_zh: 他們是正統的猶太教徒。

english: of basic importance
example_en: As a salesman, your cardinal rule is to do everything you can to satisfy a customer.
example_zh: 作爲推銷員，最基本的原則是竭盡全力讓顧客滿意。

english: to lose or lose the right to especially by some error, offense, or crime
example_en: If you cancel your flight, you will forfeit your deposit.
example_zh: 乘客取消航班訂位，定金概不退還。

english: a cure or solution for any illness or problem
example_en: He said the introduction of market disci pline to the economy was not a magic cure-all for its problems.
example_zh: 他說把市場規範引入該國經濟，並不是解決其經濟問題的靈丹妙藥。

english: affording a general view of a whole
example_en: There are many vortex patterns on synoptic maps.
example_zh: 摘要天氣圖上有許多種渦旋型式。

english: marked by firm determination
example_en: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
example_zh: 他將形勢描述得非常危險，並號召採取果斷行動。

english: capable of being impeached or accused
example_en: Thus, Congress cannot remove an executive official except for impeachable offenses.
example_zh: 因此，除非有可彈劾的行爲，否則國會不能罷免行政官員。

english: full of or covered with grime: dirty
example_en: They crept toward the grimy window and looked down.
example_zh: 仍然披着隱形衣，悄悄走到滿是污垢的窗前向下張望。

english: not favoring one side or group over another
example_en: He is a broad-minded but evenhanded judge.
example_zh: 開明而公正的法官。

english: to drive danger or attack away from
example_en: He has hired a lawyer to defend him a gainst the allegations.
example_zh: 他已聘請了一位律師針對這些指控爲自己辯護。

english: extremely poor or bad
example_en: The general standard of racing was abysmal.
example_zh: 競賽總體水平極糟。

english: a mixture of different elements
example_en: The film script is an amalgam of all three books.
example_zh: 這個電影腳本由三本書合成。

english: to begin to understand or deal with something in a direct or effective way
example_en: Many investigators had grapple with the problem, usually with poor results.
example_zh: 許多研究人員曾設法處理這個問題, 但是往往沒有好結果。

english: emphasizing that it is better or greater than anything else of its kind
example_en: In another literary form, poetry, the Bible is unsurpassed.
example_zh: 在另一種文學形式即詩歌方面來看, 《聖經》是無與倫比的。

english: to cause to seem inferior
example_en: Such conduct will derogate from your reputation.
example_zh: 那樣的行爲有損你的名譽。

english: to cause to subside
example_en: The government tried to appease discontented workers.
example_zh: 政府試圖安撫不滿的工人們。

english: normally used up or consumed in service
example_en: We need such expendable supplies as pencils, ink and paper.
example_zh: 我們需要像鉛筆、墨水和紙張這樣的消費品。

english: inflame, excite
example_en: Lady Lysa's face was flushed with fury.
example_zh: 萊莎夫人氣得滿臉通紅。

english: very large or great
example_en: There has been a colossal waste of public money.
example_zh: 一直存在巨大的公款浪費。

english: not likely to be seen or noticed by many people
to dispose in advance
example_en: Franklin was predisposed to believe him.
example_zh: 富蘭克林傾向於相信他。

english: of the same mind or habit of thought
example_en: Some like-minded people got together and set up a group.
example_zh: 一些志趣相投的人聚在一起，成立了一個小組。

english: used to say that two or more things are very similar and can be compared to each other
a narrow opening or crack of considerable length and depth usually occurring from some breaking or parting
example_en: Just ahead of us there was a huge fissure.
example_zh: 離我們不遠處,出現一個大裂縫。

english: made to be useful rather than to be decorative or comfortable
example_en: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behavior.
example_zh: 這個實用的基礎模型較爲簡略地解釋了人類的行爲。

english: to oppose directly and stubbornly
example_en: He wants to be the tough rebel who bucks the system.
example_zh: 他想成爲抵制體制的強硬叛逆者。

english: the place or general locality where a person or thing is
example_en: The police are anxious to hear from anyone who may know the whereabouts of the firearms.
example_zh: 警察急於從任何可能知道那些槍支下落的人那裏得到消息。

english: resembling or befitting a rude or insensitive person
example_en: He disgusted many with his boorish behavior.
example_zh: 他以其粗魯的行爲使許多人感到厭惡。

english: showing concern for the happiness and welfare of other people rather than for yourself
example_en: Nations are governed by self - interest, but they prefer to believe that their aims are altruistic.
example_zh: 各國都只考慮自己的利益, 卻總願意相信自己的目標是大公無私的。

english: to reduce the speed of
chinese: 但大多數分析師已經預料到中國的增長
example_en: But most analysts already expect Chin ese growth to decelerate.
example_zh: 但大多數分析師已經預料到中國的增長會減速。

english: to impair the strength of
example_en: Prolonged strike action debilitated the industry.
example_zh: 長時間的罷工削弱了這個行業的活力。

english: markedly good- humored especially as evidenced by cheerfulness and conviviality
example_en: Amidst the drumbeats and jovial chants, time passed.
example_zh: 時間在鼓聲和愉快的聖歌聲中流逝。

english: to cut with something sharp
example_en: Trim the shrubs with shears.
example_zh: 用大剪刀修剪灌木叢。

english: engage in sycophancy
chinese: 她們隨後來到後臺，對他嬌語諂媚。
example_en: They came backstage afterward, cooing and toadying to him.
example_zh: 她們隨後來到後臺，對他嬌語諂媚。

english: to promise the performance of by a pledge
example_en: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
example_zh: 達德利先生已承諾將任何所獲的損害賠償額都捐給慈善機構。

english: to declare to be untrue or invalid
example_en: Nobody can gainsay his claims.
example_zh: 沒人能夠反駁他的說法。

english: unlimited power over a country
example_en: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.
example_zh: 這些人民珍視他們的獨立和主權。

english: politely pleasant and friendly
example_en: The conversation was carried on in a cordial and friendly atmosphere.
example_zh: 會談是在親切友好的氣氛中進行的。

english: to present for acceptance
example_en: The army has not yet proffered an explanation of how and why the accident happened.
example_zh: 軍隊還沒有對這次事件發生的經過和原因給出解釋。

english: to cut in pieces in order to display or examine the structure and use of the parts
example_en: This paper tries to anatomize China's regional disparity issue from the dimension of modern state establishment.
example_zh: 論文試圖從現代國家構建的緯度來探析中國的區域差距問題。

english: moving about aimlessly or irregularly
example_en: His errant son at Dartmouth ran up debts of 250m.
example_zh: 他那行爲出格的兒子在達特茅斯欠下了高達2億5千萬英鎊的債務。

english: having knowledge or experience
example_en: Those in business are not, on the whol e, conversant with basic scientific prin ciples.
example_zh: 總的來說，那些從商的人並不太熟悉基本的科學原理。

english: split apart
example_en: The upper surface of glacier is riven by crevasses.
example_zh: 冰川的上表面已裂成冰隙。

english: cruel, severe
example_en: There has been an overall growth in population, despite some draconian efforts to contain it.
example_zh: 儘管有嚴厲的遏制措施,人口還是在全面增長。

english: containing or giving large amounts of something
example_en: Rainfall is plentiful in the area.
example_zh: 這個地區雨量充足。

english: characterized by a heavy dimness or obscurity caused by or like that caused by overhanging fog or smoke
example_en: He had a somewhat murky past.
example_zh: 他有一段不清白的過去。

english: to officially force to leave a place or organization
example_en: An American academic was expelled fr om the country yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天一位美國學者被逐出該國。

english: not original or special
example_en: For god sake, this is a canned soap opera.
example_zh: 上帝啊，這簡直就是一出千篇一律的肥皂剧。

english: a breaking apart or the state of being broken apart
example_en: The incidents have not yet caused a major rupture in the political ties
example_zh: between countries.這些事件尚未造成各國間政治聯繫的嚴重破裂。

english: to decide not to think about or consider
example_en: Mr Wakeham dismissed the reports as speculation.
example_zh: 韋克厄姆先生把這些報道當作臆測而不予考慮。

english: done or experienced by everyone
example_en: There are no economic universals.
example_zh: 沒有普遍適用的經濟學原理。

english: to make rigidly conventional and opposed to change
example_en: It reckons that rationing would ossify the farm industry
example_zh: 人們認爲實行配給制會使農業僵化。

english: to delight in
example_en: She drank the wine slowly, savoring every drop.
example_zh: 她慢慢地喝着葡萄酒, 細細品味。

english: in a fair and reasonable way
to give life and energy to
example_en: Take a deep breath in to invigorate you.
example_zh: 深吸一口氣來提提神。

english: ancestor, forefather
to raise trivial and frivolous objection
example_en: Although his composition was flawless, the teacher was always cavil ling at his handwriting.
example_zh: 雖然他的作文寫得完美無瑕，但老師對他的書法總是百般挑剔。

english: to watch, observe, listen to, or check for a special purpose over a period of time
example_en: Government monitors will continue to accompany reporters.
example_zh: 政府監督員將繼續陪同記者。

english: to change from one form or function to another
example_en: Innovators rarely come up with new ideas; instead, they convert old ideas into new ones, adapting them from one context to another.
example_zh: 創新者很少產生新創意。 他們把老的創意變成新創意，讓其從一個環境轉換到另一個環境。

english: marked by an often ill- natured inclination to stress faults and raise objections
example_en: There is no captious client but faulty product.
example_zh: 只有不完美的產品，沒有挑剔的客戶。

english: to use for gain
example_en: Now some experts are proposing that we should take advantage of the teen brain's keen sensitivity to the presence of friends and leverage it to improve education.
example_zh: 現在一些專家提出，我們應該利用青少年的大腦對朋友在場的敏銳感知，並藉助它來改善教育。

english: narrowly, stodgily, and often ostentatiously learned
extending in scope or effect to a prior time or to conditions that existed or originated in the past
example_en: There are few precedents for this sort of retroactive legislation.
example_zh: 這種有追溯力的法規鮮有先例。

english: not showing or having tact
example_en: His tactless words had always incurred his father’s deep displeasure.
example_zh: 他嘴笨，說話總是使他父親感到十分不快。

english: more interested in reading books and studying than doing more physical activities
example_en: He had a bookish and rather shy look.
example_zh: 他外表有點學究氣，相當害羞。

english: characterized by shrewdness in managing, contriving, or dealing
example_en: Many towns often found it politic to change their allegiance.
example_zh: 很多城鎮經常發現改變擁戴對象纔是上策。

english: to fill up the number of with new members
example_en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Asian officers.
example_zh: 警方正在試圖招聘更多黑人和亞裔警官

english: a name that is wrong or not proper or appropriate
example_en: Herbal "tea" is something of a misnomer because these drinks contain no tea at all.
example_zh: 花草“茶”是個誤稱，因爲這類飲料里根本不含茶。

english: very strong, clear, and effective
example_en: His comment was trenchant and perceptive.
example_zh: 他的評論既一針見血又鞭闢入裏。

english: fought or conducted from the last ditch
example_en: It's a last-ditch attempt to prevent civil war.
example_zh: 這是阻止內戰發生的最後一搏。

english: very complicated
example_en: The operations can be quite involved, requiring many procedures in order to restructure the anatomy.
example_zh: 手術可能會十分複雜，需要許多步驟來重建結構。

english: to establish or order by appointment, decree, or law
example_en: Equal punishment was ordained for the two crimes.
example_zh: 規定對這兩種罪行量刑相同。

english: the quality or state of being accurate and correct
example_en: They cannot determine their optimum price and output with neat exactitude.
example_zh: 他們不能精確無誤地知道最優價格和產量。

english: an indispensable and fundamental basis
example_en: The doctrine of surplus value is the cor nerstone of Marx's economic theory.
example_zh: 剩餘價值學說是馬克思經濟理論的基石

english: to speak slightingly of
chinese: 沒有理由輕視這場災難的嚴重性。
example_en: It makes no sense to belittle the enormity of the disaster.
example_zh: 沒有理由輕視這場災難的嚴重性。

english: very excited about and interested in something
example_en: We are keen that our school should get involved too.
example_zh: 我們盼着自己的學校也參與其中。

english: lasting forever
characterized by grotesqueness, extravagance, complexity or flamboyance
example_en: Some of baroque architecture over the pursuit of luxury boldness, even to the point of tedious piling up.
example_zh: 有些複雜的建築過分追求華貴氣魄，甚至到了繁瑣堆砌的地步。

english: to grow or develop quickly
example_en: Manufacturers are keen to cash in on the burgeoning demand.
example_zh: 需求急速增長，製造商急着從中撈一把

english: able to move quickly, easily, and lightly
to agree to stop fighting, hiding, resisting, etc., because you know that you will not win or succeed
example_en: The rebel soldiers were forced to surrender.
example_zh: 叛軍被迫投降。

english: markedly short and abrupt
example_en: They received a characteristically brusque reply from him.
example_zh: 他們從他那裏得到的是簡短的答覆，他一貫都是那樣的。

english: moral integrity
example_en: You're a symbol of righteousness and rectitude in our godforsaken land.
example_zh: 在這個淒涼的土地上，你是正直和清廉的象徵。

english: a smith who forges iron
example_en: The blacksmith was pelting away at the hot iron.
example_zh: 鐵匠正在不停地敲打熱鐵。

english: marked by display of feeling
example_en: We came from the English tradition of not being demonstrative.
example_zh: 我們繼承了英國人輕易不表露感情的傳統。

english: the removal or reducing of something that is painful or unpleasant
example_en: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
example_zh: 這個消息會讓法國當局大大鬆一口氣。

english: too eager to help or obey someone important
example_en: He looked at the two ladies with an obsequious air.
example_zh: 他看着兩位太太，滿臉諂媚的神情.

english: of, relating to, or conforming to idiom
example_en: In his lecture,he bore down on the importance of idiomatic usage in a language.
example_zh: 他在演講中着重強調了語言中習慣用法的重要性。

english: limiting or limited to possession, control, or use by a single individual or group
example_en: We ask to be the exclusive agency for your computers in Taiwan.
example_zh: 我們公司請求作爲貴公司電腦在臺灣的獨家代理商。

english: to leave or get rid of quickly or without concern
example_en: The government declared that it did not dump radioactive waste at sea.
example_zh: 政府宣稱並未將放射性廢料傾倒在海里

english: to happen, go, or come before
example_en: His resignation was preceded by weeks of speculation.
example_zh: 在他辭職之前，有關的猜測已持續了幾個星期。

english: of, relating to, or being the basic or essential constituent of something
example_en: Learning to control one of the most ele mental forces in nature is a pivotal mo ent in any child's personal history.
example_zh: 學會如何控制自然界中這一最基本的力量是每一個孩子個人成長曆史中的關鍵時刻。

english: party spirit especially when marked by dissension
example_en: There has been a substantial amount of factionalism within the movement.
example_zh: 該運動中已有大量的派系鬥爭了。

english: eerie, mysterious
example_en: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
example_zh: 怪異的是，她看起來竟有些面熟，這讓託尼心慌意亂。

english: analyze critically
example_en: Then you could have your test automation read, parse, and use the data in this file.
example_zh: 然後您可以讓您的測試自動化讀取、解析和使用該文件中的數據。

english: marked by or expressive of gloom
cheep falseness
example_en: Are those real diamonds or only shams?
example_zh: 那些是真鑽石還是贗品?

english: the amount of living matter
example_en: The weight of living organisms is called biomass.
example_zh: 生物有機體的重量稱爲生物量。

english: to fail to see or notice
example_en: He seems to have overlooked one important fact.
example_zh: 他好像忽略了一個重要的事實。

english: advocating or involving a rigidly uncompromising course of action
example_en: This politician is a hardliner.
example_zh: 這個政治家是一個強硬分子

english: depending on something else that might or might not happen
example_en: The role they play is contingent on thei r political ability and zeal.
example_zh: 他們起的作用取決於他們的政治能力和熱情。

english: the close or termination of something
example_en: The festival ended with a grand finale in Hyde Park.
example_zh: 節日的壓軸活動是在海德公園舉行的盛大演出。

english: given to tears or weeping
example_en: Julia Moreno plays the lachrymose heroine of the film.
example_zh: 朱莉亞莫雷諾在片中扮演愛哭的女主角

english: causing wonder
example_en: We were driven across this wondrous vast land of lakes and forests.
example_zh: 我們乘車穿越這片有着湖泊及森林的廣袤而神奇的土地。

english: to break or ignore without hiding what you are doing or showing fear of shame
example_en: No one can flout the law with impunity.
example_zh: 任何人都不能不受懲罰地藐視法律。

english: very important and needing immediate attention
example_en: There is an urgent need for food and water.
example_zh: 現在亟需食物和水。

english: a feeling of being offended by what someone has said or done
example_en: He takes umbrage against anyone who criticizes him.
example_zh: 不管誰批評他，他都心生憤懣。

english: fawning, obsequious
example_en: We heard the sound of sycophantic laughter.
example_zh: 我們聽到了諂媚的笑聲。

english: to gather into a ball, mass, or cluster
example_en: Similarly charged colloidal particles cannot agglomerate into larger particles.
example_zh: 帶相同電荷的膠粒不能聚集成較大的顆粒。

english: a usually localized act of popular violence in defiance usually of an established government
example_en: Isolated attacks in the north-east of the country have now turned into a full- scale uprising.
example_zh: 該國東北部的零星襲擊現在已經演變成爲全面暴動。

english: willing to end a disagreement with someone
example_en: They approached the talks in a concili atory spirit.
example_zh: 他們抱一種和解的態度去參加談判。

english: to hold or keep with limits
example_en: At the sight of this cruelty, he could har dly contain his anger.
example_zh: 見此殘暴情形，他無法剋制自己的憤怒

english: to long persistently, wistfully, or sadly
example_en: The people yearned for peace.
example_zh: 人民渴望和平。

english: elegant or graceful in manner, appearance, or shape
example_en: There are not as many genteel young men in Devonshire as Sussex.
example_zh: 與蘇塞克斯相比，德文郡有教養的年輕人不多。

english: truth or accuracy
example_en: They questioned the veracity of her story.
example_zh: 他們質疑她所述事情的真實性。

english: a thing done with ease
example_en: For me, the GRE was really a cinch.
example_zh: 對我來說，GRE考試真是小菜一碟。

english: not readily ruled, disciplined, or managed
example_en: It's not good enough just to blame the unruly children.
example_zh: 對難管教的孩子只是責備是不夠的。

english: wide and general destruction
example_en: The floods caused havoc throughout the area.
example_zh: 洪水給整個地區帶來了災害。

english: to make young or youthful again: give new vigor to
example_en: Shelley was advised that the Italian climate would rejuvenate him...
example_zh: 有人建議雪萊去意大利，那裏的天氣會使他恢復活力。

english: to spend extravagantly or foolishly
example_en: Hobbs didn't squander his money on flashy cars or other vices.
example_zh: 霍布斯沒有把錢揮霍在奢華汽車或其他惡習上。

english: to free from restraint, control, or the power of another
example_en: This new machine will emancipate us from the hard work.
example_zh: 這部新機器將把我們從繁重勞動中解放出來。

english: to cause to feel angry or irritated especially for a long time
example_en: Their refusal to sell the country arms in 1937 still rankled with him.
example_zh: 他們在1937年拒絕向該國出售武器一事仍然令他憤憤不平。

english: not named or identified
example_en: An anonymous caller told police what had happened.
example_zh: 有人打匿名電話向警方報告了所發生的事。

english: a disadvantage that makes achievement unusually difficult
example_en: Not speaking the language proved to be a bigger handicap than I'd imagined.
example_zh: 事實證明不會講這種語言造成的障礙比我所想象的大。

english: to assert without proof or before proving
example_en: The people arguing for an attack on Iran allege that containment is failing.
example_zh: 主張打擊伊朗的人斷言，遏制政策正走向失敗。

english: to remove (something that is not wanted or needed)
