to call forth or draw out
chinese: 那起罪行引發了打擊違禁藥品的呼聲。
example_en: The crime elicited an outcry against illi cit drugs.
example_zh: 那起罪行引發了打擊違禁藥品的呼聲。

english: genetically or innately determined
example_en: Others think that the rules for what is 'musical' are hard-wired in our brains to some degree.
example_zh: 其他人認爲，我們的大腦對什麼東西是“悅耳的”在某種程度上有其內在的標準

english: used to describe someone who allows things to happen or who accepts what other people do or decide without trying to change anything
example_en: His passive attitude made things easier for me.
example_zh: 他的被動態度使我辦起事來容易多了。

english: a group of retainers or attendants
example_en: Mind trainers are now part of a tennis star's retinue.
example_zh: 現在，網球明星的隨行人員中有些是心理培訓師。

english: a church that is the official seat of a diocesan bishop
a strong inclination or interest
example_en: Mr Putin seems bent on proving only that Russia is again able to say no.
example_zh: 普京似乎更傾向於試圖證明俄羅斯再次可以說“不”。

english: to cause to lose its value or to have no effect
causing great fear
chief, principal
example_en: Unemployment was the arch cause of poverty.
example_zh: 失業是貧窮的主要原因。

english: irritably sullen and churlish in mood or manner
a solemn oath
example_en: Her last adjuration to daughter was to escape from dinginess if she could.
example_zh: 她對女兒最後的叮囑是要竭盡全力擺脫這種困難。

english: to make nervous
example_en: Officials are not normally rattled by any reporter's question.
example_zh: 官員們一般不會因爲任何記者的提問而緊張不安。

english: to think of or describe something as larger or greater than it really is
example_en: Sheila admitted that she did sometime s exaggerate the demands of her job.
example_zh: 希拉承認自己有時候確實誇大了工作的難度。

english: inspiring horror or repulsion
following one’s own capricious, wanton, or depraved inclinations
example_en: Wayward students are always getting into trouble.
example_zh: 任性的學生老是惹麻煩。

english: a stupid or unimaginative person
example_en: For years, teachers had figured him for a dullard.
example_zh: 多年來老師們都以爲他是個笨蛋。

english: perception of the nature of an event after it has happened
example_en: What looks obvious in hindsight was not at all obvious at the time.
example_zh: 事後一目瞭然的在當時根本看不清。

english: to take the place or position of
example_en: Hand tools are relics of the past that have now been superseded by the machine.
example_zh: 手工工具是歷史的遺物，現在已經被機器所取代。

english: to go through very carefully in order to find something useful or valuable
example_en: Sift out the wheat from the chaff.
example_zh: 把小麥的殼篩出來。

english: a natural liking for something
example_en: Charles has always had a predilection for red-haired women.
example_zh: 查爾斯對紅頭髮女人一直有偏愛。

english: having or showing knowledge that is learned by studying
example_en: Even the most erudite native speaker does not know the meaning of every w ord.
example_zh: 就算最博學的母語使用者也不可能知道每個字的意思。

english: easily irritated
example_en: Europe's most prickly neighbors is turning nasty.
example_zh: 歐洲兩個最易動怒的鄰國間一場曠日持久的爭吵變得不堪入耳。

english: show, indicate
example_en: He betrayed nervousness by stammering.
example_zh: 他說話結結巴巴表明他膽子小。

english: easily disrupted, overthrown, or damaged
example_en: Pine is brittle and breaks.
example_zh: 松木硬脆易折。

english: causing feelings of sadness and sympathy
example_en: The animal gave a pathetic little whimper.
example_zh: 這隻動物低聲哀叫，令人憐憫。

english: conflicting with accepted standards of good conduct or good taste
example_en: Carrie could not ignore his indecorous behavior though she loved him very much.
example_zh: 儘管凱莉非常愛他卻無法忽視他那有失體統的行爲。

english: full of mystery and difficult to understand
not easily understood or explained
example_en: His equivocal response has done nothi ng to dampen the speculation.
example_zh: 模棱兩可的回應絲毫沒有消除人們的猜疑。

english: varying in pitch from the proper tone of a melody
example_en: Moe was having fun banging the drums and singing off-key.
example_zh: 莫自得其樂地一邊敲着鼓，一邊不成調地唱着歌。

english: moving, occurring, or performed in a backward direction
not influenced by emotions or personal interest
example_en: It is written in a detached, precise style .
example_zh: 行文冷靜客觀，一針見血。

english: very smart or clever
example_en: The ingenious boy made a radio set for himself.
example_zh: 那個聰明的男孩自己組裝了一臺收音機

english: a comment or remark
example_en: In hospital she'll be under observation all the time.
example_zh: 醫院會對她24小時密切觀察。

english: strikingly out of the ordinary
example_en: His fast-paced novels are full of bizarre situations and madcap antics.
example_zh: 他那些快節奏的小說裏充滿了怪誕的場景和荒唐的行爲。

english: tending to cause discontent, animosity, or envy
example_en: It would be invidious to single out any one person to thank.
example_zh: 單獨感謝任何一個人都易引起反感。

english: hard to handle or manage because of size or weight
example_en: Although the machine looks cumberso me, it is actually easy to use.
example_zh: 儘管這臺機器看上去很笨重，操作起來卻很容易。

english: the state of being easily changed
example_en: The flexibility of distance learning would be particularly suited to busy managers.
example_zh: 遠程學習的靈活性對於日理萬機的經理人來說特別適合。

english: to make, declare, or prove obsolete or out-of- date
example_en: Your car would be superannuated early.
example_zh: 你的汽車早就該淘汰了。

english: to try to keep from happening
example_en: She summoned up all her pity for him, to smother her self-pity.
example_zh: 她抑制着心中的自憐，將滿腔的憐憫之情都傾注在了他的身上。

english: to preserve or cherish as sacred
example_en: At least as important, the law appears to enshrine a right to collective bargaining.
example_zh: 至少同樣重要的是，這項法律似乎確立了工人有集體談判的權利。

english: cruel, savage
example_en: Custer was an idiot and a brute and he deserved his fate.
example_zh: 卡斯特是個愚蠢而粗暴的人，他應該有這樣的下場。

english: noisily turbulent
example_en: We can hear their boisterous laughter in the next room.
example_zh: 我們可以聽到他們在隔壁房間的喧鬧的笑聲。

english: specified, fixed
example_en: Over a given period, the value of shares will rise and fall.
example_zh: 股票的價值在某一特定的時期內會有漲跌。

english: to state or do over again or repeatedly sometimes with wearying effect
example_en: We reiterate that such cooperation is inclusive and non-confrontational.
example_zh: 我們重申這種合作是包容的、非對抗性的。

english: a hideous giant of fairy tales and folklore that feeds on human beings
example_en: The ogre was portrayed as an abortion.
example_zh: 民間傳說裏的喫人巨人給畫成了畸形的怪物。

english: the performance of a lawful action in an illegal or improper manner
example_en: The wisdom of the common law's stress on the crucial distinction between misfeasance and nonfeasance.
example_zh: 普通法的智慧在於，它重點強調了違法行爲與消極不行爲之間的區別。

english: not gained by labor, service, or skill
example_en: The worst guilt is to accept an unearned guilt.
example_zh: 最嚴重的罪行是接受一個不勞而獲的罪行。

english: keenly perceptive or discerning
example_en: The war has aggravated an acute economic crisis.
example_zh: 戰爭加劇了原本已很嚴重的經濟危機。

english: to accept something as inevitable
example_en: He was under pressure to resign and was about to be sidelined.
example_zh: 他承受着被迫辭職的壓力，很快就要被排擠出去了。

english: to present again in a slightly different form
the path of a point in a plane moving around a central point while continuously receding from or approaching it
example_en: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral
example_zh: 這個過程不是一個圓周運動而是螺旋上升型的。

english: lacking distinctive or interesting qualities
example_en: She lived in a nondescript suburban apartment block.
example_zh: 她住在一個毫無特徵的市郊公寓樓裏。

english: having little value or importance
example_en: Outside California these difficulties may seem fairly trifling.
example_zh: 在別處，加利福尼亞的這些困難可能看起來相當微不足道。

english: having a very sour or sharp taste
example_en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.
example_zh: 二氧化碳溶解後能使水的酸性增加。

english: the quality or state of being very exact, careful, or strict
example_en: The crime will be treated with the full rigor of the law.
example_zh: 這一罪行會嚴格依法審理。

english: low in spirit
very bad and easily noticed
example_en: In a few cases, such egregious online behavior has led to their dismissal from medical school.
example_zh: 在少數情況下，這種惡劣的上網行爲會導致他們被醫學院開除。

english: a feeling of not worrying about anything
example_en: She hid her worries behind an air of insouciance.
example_zh: 她掩飾着自己的煩惱，表現得無憂無慮

english: a deserter from one faith, cause, or allegiance to another
example_en: When he was doing underground work he was arrested because a renegade informed against him.
example_zh: 他做地下工作時，曾因叛徒告密而被捕

english: worthy of esteem
example_en: He is an estimable and likeable young
example_zh: fellow.他是一個難能可貴而又可愛的年輕人。

english: of, relating to, involving, or forming a periphery or surface part
example_en: Among high-income economies, those with most slack are those in the peripheral eurozone.
example_zh: 在高收入經濟體中，擁有最多閒置資源的是那些處於歐元區外圍的經濟體。

english: providing something additional to a main part of function
example_en: The transport corps is ancillary to the infantry.
example_zh: 運輸隊是步兵的輔助部隊。

english: aiming for equal wealth, status, etc.
to promise to give up or to stop doing
example_en: Wells was not likely to forswear the faith of a lifetime.
example_zh: 威爾斯決不會背棄他畢生的信仰。

english: expressing a strong opinion
example_en: Such tendentious statements are likely to provoke strong opposition.
example_zh: 這種有傾向性的說法可能招致強烈的反對。

english: confident and hopeful
example_en: They are less sanguine about the company's long-term prospects.
example_zh: 他們對公司的遠景不那麼樂觀。

english: something offensive to view
example_en: That new multi-story carpark is a real eyesore.
example_zh: 那座新的多層停車場實在難看。

english: the exact opposite of something or someone
to state or declare positively and often forcefully or aggressively
example_en: The defendants, who continue to assert their innocence, are expected to appeal.
example_zh: 各被告仍然宣稱自己無辜，並會提起上訴。

english: tending to catch the interest or attention
example_en: If you can think of a catchy domain name, get it registered for less than $10.
example_zh: 如果你能想到的一個引人注目的域名，註冊用不了10美元。

english: to have recourse
example_en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
example_zh: 異常緊張的工作安排使他開始吸毒。

english: feeling or showing a lack of interest or enthusiasm
example_en: Joanna had made one or two half- hearted attempts to befriend Graham's young wife.
example_zh: 喬安娜曾有一兩次敷衍着去親近格雷厄姆年輕的妻子。

english: to make someone do something by using force or threats
example_en: Potter had argued that the government coerced him into pleading guilty.
example_zh: 波特辯稱是政府強迫他認罪的。

english: fully or abundantly provided or filled
example_en: The Harbor was replete with boats.
example_zh: 港口裏滿是船隻。

english: free of encumbrance
to become unsteady, feeble, or spiritless
example_en: Her confidence had never flagged.
example_zh: 她的信心從未減弱。

english: friendly social atmosphere
example_en: The comity needs sincerity to measure , but the sincerity is offer by comity.
example_zh: 友誼需真誠來衡量，而真誠由友誼來奉獻。

english: the technical terminology or characteristic idiom of a special activity or group
example_en: The manual is full of the jargon and slang of self-improvement courses.
example_zh: 手冊裏滿是有關自修課程的行話術語。

english: possessing or characterized by life
example_en: We are animate beings, living creatures.
example_zh: 我們是有生命的存在，有生命的動物。

english: to make less severe or extreme
example_en: If you temper criticism with reason everyone can obey you.
example_zh: 如果以說理來緩和批評，誰都會服從你

english: sphere, domain
example_en: In the realm of sculpture too, the technical skill of foreign artists was long recognized.
example_zh: 在雕塑領域，外國藝術家的技藝也早已得到認可。

english: to control or direct with or as if with reins
example_en: The government would try to rein back inflation.
example_zh: 政府將努力控制通貨膨脹。

english: to make a low whining plaintive or broken sound
example_en: The child was lost and began to whimper.
example_zh: 那孩子迷了路，抽抽搭搭地哭起來。

english: to cause to happen more quickly
example_en: The treatment she received may, in fact, have hastened her death.
example_zh: 實際上，她所接受的治療可能加快了她的死亡。

english: luck that takes the form of finding valuable or pleasant things that are not looked for
example_en: Some of the best effects in my garden have been the result of serendipity.
example_zh: 我園子裏最珍貴的幾件物品是機緣巧合之下意外所得。

english: to make longer or to grow longer
example_en: Corn is treated when the stalk starts to elongate.
example_zh: 在玉米稈開始拔節時，給玉米打藥。

english: very appropriate
example_en: She thought in both languages, and selected the most apposite phrase from either.
example_zh: 她用兩種語言思考，然後從中選擇最貼切的一種表達。

english: to convey in addition to exact explicit meaning
example_en: The critique of religion as a social phenomenon did not connote a dismissal of the issues behind it.
example_zh: 去批判作爲一種社會現象的宗教並不意味着對它背後那些話題的否棄。

english: enormously or inconceivably large or great
example_en: Astronomical sums of money will be needed for this river tunnel plan.
example_zh: 這條過江隧道的計劃需要極大的一筆錢

english: permitting or designed to permit spontaneous and unguided responses
example_en: Girls do better on open-ended tasks that require them to think for themselves.
example_zh: 女孩子更擅長需要獨立思考的開放式任務。

english: to criticize very harshly
example_en: They lambasted the report as a gross distortion of the truth.
example_zh: 他們激烈批評該報告是嚴重歪曲事實。

english: penetrating only the easily or quickly perceived
example_en: The evening news is often criticized for being shallow.
example_zh: 晚間新聞常因其內容膚淺而受到批評。

english: to endure without protest or reaction
to breathe out
example_en: She exhaled the smoke through her nose.
example_zh: 她從鼻子裏噴出煙霧。

english: tyro, beginner
an unpleasant person who grabs inconsiderately
example_en: The grabber was arrested by the police.
example_zh: 那個掠奪者被警察逮捕了。

english: a connoisseur of food and drink
example_en: The seafood here is a gourmet's delight.
example_zh: 這兒的海鮮是美食家的一大享受。

english: to understand or become aware of
example_en: People don't realize how serious this recession has actually been.
example_zh: 人們沒有意識到這次經濟衰退事實上有多嚴重。

english: exhibiting mature qualities at an unusually early age
example_en: Margaret was always a precocious child.
example_zh: 瑪格麗特一直是個早熟的孩子。

english: free, unrestrained
bring about, cause
example_en: Something vital must have occasioned this visit.
example_zh: 肯定有什麼重大的事導致了這次訪問。

english: a feeling of contempt for someone or something regarded as unworthy or inferior
example_en: Jackie disdained the servants that her millions could buy.
example_zh: 傑姬鄙視那些她用錢就可以收買的奴僕

english: to keep secret
a sudden stoppage of a forward course or progress
example_en: She wanted to tell him the whole truth but she checked herself─it wasn't the right moment.
example_zh: 她本想告訴他全部真相，但是又忍住了—那還不是時候。

english: very harsh or severe
example_en: He is given to making scathing remarks.
example_zh: 他這人說起話來老這麼尖酸刻薄。

english: doing something involves the use of logical reasoning
example_en: Programming is for analytical mind.
example_zh: 編程適合善於分析的人。

english: to become thick and partly solid
a person who has just started learning or doing something
example_en: In fact, in the world of complex software, everyone is effectively a novice.
example_zh: 事實上，在複雜的軟件世界裏，每個人實際上都是新手。

english: to feel astonishment or perplexity at or about
example_en: We all marveled at his success.
example_zh: 我們對他的成功感到驚奇。

english: the act or an instance of conjoining
example_en: Now this conjunction of an immense military establishment and a large arms industry is new in the American experience.
example_zh: 在美國歷史上，這種龐大的軍事組織和龐大的軍事工業的結合時前所未有的。

english: to treat like a god or goddess
example_en: These young men deify financial success.
example_zh: 這些年輕人崇拜財務上的成功。

english: done in a quiet and secret way to avoid being noticed
example_en: His furtive behavior aroused our suspicion.
example_zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟的行爲引起了我們的懷疑。

english: flowing in abundance
example_en: People's need for money has been increasing since they have been enjoying the many benefits brought by an affluent material life.
example_zh: 人們享受在豐富的物質生活帶來的好處中，從而對金錢的需求越來越大。

english: a disease or illness
example_en: He tried the baths there for an internal malady.
example_zh: 他到那兒洗溫泉對他的內科病進行浴療

english: the use of few words to say something
example_en: Brevity is the soul of English.
example_zh: 簡潔是英語的精華。

english: a feeling of guilt or regret
example_en: He has no compunction about relating how he killed his father.
example_zh: 他在講述自己殺害父親的過程時，沒有感到絲毫的內疚。

english: removed or distant either physically or emotionally
example_en: He seemed aloof and detached.
example_zh: 他看起來冷淡且超然。

english: not original
example_en: One heart expert thinks this study provides further evidence of the dangers of secondhand smoke.
example_zh: 一位心臟專家認爲這一研究提供了間接吸菸危險性的進一步證據。

english: extreme cruelty
example_en: The pirates treated their captives with barbarity.
example_zh: 盜們殘暴地對待他們的俘虜。

english: tastelessly showy
example_en: They climbed the garish purple- carpeted stairs.
example_zh: 他們登上鋪着俗豔的紫色地毯的樓梯。

english: to become smaller or less
example_en: Her enthusiasm for the whole idea was waning rapidly.
example_zh: 她對整個想法的熱情迅速冷淡了下來。

english: being without content or occupant
example_en: The position of chairman has been vacant for some time.
example_zh: 主席的職位已經空缺一段時間了。

english: deception or trickery
example_en: Charges of political chicanery were bro ught against him.
example_zh: 他被指控行駛政治欺騙手段。

english: a valuable person or thing
example_en: From day one he's been a great asset to the company.
example_zh: 從入職第一天開始，他就是公司難得的人才。

english: a main interest, quality, or goal
example_en: The course is essentially theoretical in orientation.
example_zh: 該課程的目標基本上是理論性的。

english: showing or suggesting that future success is likely
example_en: With favorable weather conditions it was an auspicious moment to set sail.
example_zh: 風和日麗，正是揚帆出海的黃道吉日。

english: to cover with a flood
example_en: If the dam breaks, it will inundate large parts of the town.
example_zh: 如果水壩坍塌，該城的大部分將被淹沒

english: shared in common
example_en: The East and the West can work together for their mutual benefit and progress.
example_zh: 東西方可以爲互惠和進步而合作。

english: the payment of damages
example_en: There is a clear demand amongst victims for some sort of reparation from offenders.
example_zh: 受害者明確要求責任人給予一定的賠償

english: to make clear and easier to understand
example_en: Our interesting teacher could illuminate almost any subject we studied.
example_zh: 我們這位有趣的老師幾乎能解釋清楚我們所學的所有科目.

english: an arbitrary constant whose value characterizes a member of a system
example_en: Each input parameter should have the variable name and its value.
example_zh: 各輸入參數應該有自己的變量名和值。

english: violent and cruel in a way that hurts someone physically
example_en: He suffered a vicious attack by a gang of white youths
example_zh: 他遭到一幫白人青年的殘暴襲擊。

english: to eliminate the interrelationship of
example_en: The issue threatened to decouple Euro pe from the United States.
example_zh: 這一問題可能會割裂歐洲同美國的關係

english: to make happy or satisfied
example_en: Jay Gatsby did that to gratify his girlfriend's vanity.
example_zh: 蓋茨比做那事是要滿足他女友的虛榮心

english: gloomy and somber
example_en: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.
example_zh: 沿海地區的天氣會非常陰冷。

english: impervious to external influence
example_en: The hermetic seal on the packet means that the food lasts longer.
example_zh: 封袋上的密封印表明食物能保存更長的時間。

english: to entice by charm or attraction
example_en: The window displays allure customers to buy goods.
example_zh: 櫥窗陳列品引誘顧客購買商品。

english: edge, periphery
example_en: It was easier to move about on the fringe of the crowd.
example_zh: 在人羣外圍移動比較容易。

english: a person or thing that receives help or an advantage from something
example_en: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
example_zh: 迄今爲止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

english: consisting of, containing, or like sludge
example_en: His voice is not sludgy and slow, as it was in "Brokeback Mountain."
example_zh: 他的聲音不似《斷臂山》裏的拖沓、低沉。2025年最新真題詞彙

english: large in extent or degree
example_en: The project wasted a considerable amount of time and money.
example_zh: 那項工程耗費了相當多的時間和資金。

english: to attribute real identity to (a concept)
example_en: The mind has a tendency to hypostatize abstractions.
example_zh: 心靈有一種把抽象東西具體化的趨勢。

english: a reason that you give to hide your real reason for doing something
example_en: They wanted a pretext for subduing the region by force.
example_zh: 他們需要一個用武力征服那個地區的託詞。

english: to gain or attain usually by planned action or effort
example_en: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
example_zh: 只有採取大規模直接行動，我們纔會取得這樣的改變。

english: hard, harsh, or severe in manner or character
example_en: The police are planning sterner measures to combat crime.
example_zh: 警方正制訂更嚴厲的措施打擊犯罪活動

english: to impose, involve, or imply as a necessary accompaniment or result
example_en: The larger budget deficits entailed by tax reform would underpin yields on long-term Treasury bonds.
example_zh: 因稅收改革而造成的更大的預算赤字會支撐起長期國債的收益。

english: causing or tending to cause sleep
example_en: The warmth of the room and the monotony of the speaker's voice grew soporific.
example_zh: 房間裏的熱氣和發言人單調的聲音讓人昏昏欲睡。

english: making usually unjustified or excessive claims
example_en: He is a talented but pretentious writer.
example_zh: 他是一個有才華但自以爲是的作家。

english: to make weaker or less effective usually in a secret or gradual way
example_en: She undermined him and destroyed his confidence in his own talent
example_zh: 她暗中打擊他，讓他對自己的才華信心全無。

english: not feeling or showing emotions such as affection or kindness
example_en: She's hard-boiled, tough and funny.
example_zh: 她冷峻、堅韌而風趣。

english: a mixture especially of incongruous elements
a natural or inherent aptitude, impulse, or capacity
to praise excessively especially from motives of self-interest
something of full width
example_en: Books influence the depth and breadth of life.
example_zh: 書籍影響生命的深度和廣度。

english: remaining after a process, event etc is finished
example_en: There are still a few residual problems with the computer program.
example_zh: 電腦程序還有一些殘留問題。

english: the status or position of a star
example_en: She is on the escalator to stardom.
example_zh: 她青雲直上地躋身於明星界。

english: based on or reflecting a belief that human conduct is motivated primarily by self- interest
example_en: With that cynical outlook, he doesn't tr ust anyone.
example_zh: 抱着那種憤世嫉俗的觀點，他不相信任何人。

english: obsequiously submissive
example_en: She is expected to be subservient to her uncle.
example_zh: 她被要求對叔叔恭敬順從。

english: lacking power or strength
example_en: He blazed with impotent rage.
example_zh: 他勃然大怒，但於事無補。

english: to cause to lose the sense of time, place, or identity
example_en: They were disorientated by the smoke and were firing blindly into it.
example_zh: 他們在煙霧中迷失了方向，向裏面胡亂射擊了一通。

english: trouble, harass
example_en: The country is beset by severe economic problems.
example_zh: 這個國家被嚴重的經濟問題所困擾。

english: inclined to be merciful
example_en: The embrace of father is clement and mother's is warm.
example_zh: 爸爸的懷抱是寬厚的，媽媽的懷抱是溫暖的。

english: convinced of one's own righteousness especially in contrast with the actions and beliefs of others
example_en: He is critical of the monks, whom he considers narrow-minded and self- righteous.
example_zh: 他對僧侶們頗有微詞，認爲他們思想偏狹，自視清高。

english: doing something that has not been done before
example_en: The school has won awards for its pioneering work with the community.
example_zh: 該校因與社區開創性合作而獲獎。

english: the dispensing or receiving of reward or punishment
example_en: People are seeking retribution for the latest terrorist outrages.
example_zh: 人們在設法對恐怖分子最近的暴行進行嚴懲。

english: the act or process of ministering
example_en: He had a kitchen made spotless by the ministrations of a cleaning lady.
example_zh: 他的廚房被清潔女工照料得一塵不染。

english: to muster for a common purpose
example_en: About three thousand people held a rally to mark international human rights day.
example_zh: 大約三千人舉行集會以紀念國際人權日

english: a formal or elegant letter
example_en: Her mother sends her a long epistle every week.
example_zh: 她母親每週給她寫一封長信。

english: opposed to someone or something in a very angry or determined way that cannot be changed
example_en: She is implacable an adversary as a wife suing for alimony.
example_zh: 有如訴訟要求贍養費的妻子一樣，她是個難以安撫的對手。

english: break, disregard
example_en: They violated the ceasefire agreement.
example_zh: 他們違反了停火協議。

english: to take arbitrary or forcible possession of
example_en: All automobiles in the town were commandeered by the army.
example_zh: 城中所有的汽車均被部隊徵用了。

english: showing or characterized by a superior attitude towards others
example_en: The Chinese court assumed an aloof and patronizing attitude toward these Westerners, keeping them confined to the southern port cities of Macao and later, Canton.
example_zh: 中國朝廷對這些西方人採取的是冷漠和施恩的態度，把他們限制在南部的港口城市：澳門以及和後來的廣州。

english: powerfully pleasing, appealing, or delightful
example_en: She has the most enchanting smile.
example_zh: 她有着最迷人的微笑。

english: exciting distaste or aversion
example_en: All food was repugnant to me during my illness.
example_zh: 生病時所有的食物都使我感到厭惡.

english: to control and use the natural force or power of something
example_en: Harness your nervous energy and transform it into vitality and enthusiasm.
example_zh: 要控制你的緊張情緒並把它變成活力和熱情。

english: a loss of power, success, popularity, etc.
example_en: The gramophone had been eclipsed by new technology such as the compact disc.
example_zh: 激光唱片等新技術使留聲機黯然失色。

english: characterized by or expressive of a concern with morality
example_en: To me moralistic films are just unbearable.
example_zh: 對我來說，說教電影簡直難以忍受。

english: highly enthusiastic and favorable
example_en: He gave her a warm glowing smile.
example_zh: 他給了她一個熱情洋溢的微笑。

english: movement away from a place or situation especially because it is dangerous, unpleasant, etc.
example_en: The army was forced to retreat after suffering heavy losses.
example_zh: 部隊因傷亡慘重被迫撤退。

english: a convinced adherent of a school or individual
shared or done by a group of people
example_en: It was a collective decision.
example_zh: 這是集體的決定。

english: an estate inherited from one's father or ancestor
chinese: 我離開了父母的家，放棄了我的房產和

english: excessive use of the first person singular personal pronoun
example_en: Egotism produces disrespectful attitud es toward others.
example_zh: 自我中心會產生對別人不尊重的態度。

english: something of monstrous size, power, or appearance
example_en: The city is a sprawling behemoth with no heart.
example_zh: 這座城市像缺失中心的龐然大物向外延伸。

english: low in spirits
example_en: Everyone has days when they feel dej ected or down.
example_zh: 每個人都有沮喪失意或情緒低落的時候

english: to make public
example_en: Officials refuse to divulge details of the negotiations.
example_zh: 官員們拒絕透露談判的細節。

english: to increase in number or amount quickly
example_en: Computerized data bases are proliferating fast.
example_zh: 計算機數據庫正在迅速激增。

english: a coming into being or use
example_en: Until the advent of the railways, the camel was the main form of transport throughout north China and into Central Asia.
example_zh: 在鐵路出現之前，駱駝是中國北部去往中亞的主要運輸工具。

english: a concluding section that rounds out the design of a literary work
example_en: Fortinbras speaks the epilogue in Shakespeare's Hamlet.
example_zh: 在莎士比亞的《哈姆雷特》中，由福丁布拉斯念收場白。

english: to make more serious or severe
example_en: South Korean media said the move will further aggravate the tense situation in the peninsula.
example_zh: 韓國媒體稱，此舉將進一步加劇半島緊張局勢。

english: unable to move
example_en: He lay inert with half-closed eyes.
example_zh: 他半睜着雙眼一動不動地躺着。

english: adversary, opponent
example_en: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
example_zh: 你高舉了他敵人的右手，你叫他一切的仇敵歡喜。

english: the state or custom of being married to only one person at a time
example_en: There are apparently some misconceptions about this whole monogamy thing.
example_zh: 很多人顯然對一夫一妻制存在着誤解。

english: not called for by the circumstances : not necessary, appropriate, or justified
example_en: There's too much crime and gratuitous violence on TV.
example_zh: 電視上充斥着過多的犯罪與無端的暴力

english: characterized by very widespread growth or extent
to abuse or censure severely or abusively
example_en: Human is not God. God is reasoning, human isn't, human would rather vituperate than reasoning.
example_zh: 人不是上帝, 上帝是講道理的, 人更易通過謾罵的方式而不是講道理。

english: a member of the laity
example_en: How would you explain to the layperson how gene therapy works?
example_zh: 你會如何向外行人解釋基因治療法的工作原理呢？

english: fatigued by overwork
experiencing or tending to bring about renewal or revival
example_en: That could harm exports and growth in the resurgent eurozone.
example_zh: 對於正在復甦的歐元區，這可能會危害到它的出口和增長。

english: extol, laud
example_en: The middle-class woman of the late eighteenth century had good reason to accept and magnify these values of sensibility and passionate love.
example_zh: 十八世紀後期的中產階級婦女完全有理由接受並讚美這些感情和熾熱愛情價值

english: to prove wrong by argument or evidence
example_en: She refutes any suggestion that she behaved unprofessionally.
example_zh: 誰要是表示她不在行，她都予以反駁。

english: the right of voting
example_en: He was an advocate of universal suffrage as a basis for social equality.
example_zh: 他提倡普選權，認爲這是社會公平的基礎。

english: to cause to correspond
example_en: The pillow cover can match up with the sheets.
example_zh: 這個枕巾可以和這些被單相配。

english: to give warnings or advice : make urgent appeals
example_en: Therefore I exhort you to confirm your love toward him.
example_zh: 所以我勸你們，要向他證實你們的愛。

english: to lessen the intensity or extremeness of
example_en: They are hoping that once in office he can be persuaded to moderate his views.
example_zh: 他們希望等他一上臺，可以說服他觀點別那麼激進。

english: to make it work again after a period in which it has not been working
example_en: American government has launched a series of economic reforms to reactivate the economy.
example_zh: 美國政府推行了一系列旨在復甦經濟的經濟改革。

english: self-proclaimed
example_en: Two of those arrested are said to be self-styled area commanders...
example_zh: 據說在那些被捕的人員中有兩人自稱是地區指揮官。

english: to publicly say that you no longer have an opinion or belief that you once had
example_en: White House officials ordered Williams to recant.
example_zh: 白宮官員命令威廉斯公開宣佈放棄自己的觀點。

english: marked by unruly or aggressive noisiness
example_en: Ms Chen finds it hard to manage a class of obstreperous students.
example_zh: 面對一班吵鬧的學生，陳老師感到難以管束。

english: to disperse in an emulsion
example_en: Grime Reaper works fast to loosen and emulsify grease and grime for easy rinse.
example_zh: 格里姆收割機工程快速放鬆和乳化油脂和污垢，便於清洗。

english: a mania for great or grandiose performance
example_en: Early success may lead to megalomania.
example_zh: 少年得志可能導致妄自尊大。

english: calm and in control of your emotions
example_en: Laura was very calm and composed.
example_zh: 勞拉看上去十分沉着冷靜。

english: a difference especially between things that should be the same
example_en: Several explanations spring to mind for the discrepancy between perceived opportunities and actual behavior.
example_zh: 有些理由可以解釋理想的機會和現實的行爲之間存在的矛盾。

english: an overwrought expression of concern or guilt
example_en: There's also been much hand-wringing over ballooning mortgage debt.
example_zh: 不斷膨脹的抵押貸款債務也令人坐立不安.

english: marked by inactivity or repose
example_en: The rapid development of the economy turns the quiescent town into a noisy city.
example_zh: 經濟的迅速發展使這個寧靜的小鎮成爲鬧市。

english: belonging to, consisting in, or dependent on circumstances
example_en: The reasons for the project collapsing were circumstantial.
example_zh: 工程垮掉的原因得依情況而定。

english: being without exception or qualification
example_en: We don't know whether this was because he didn't want to take the chance or because he believed in the categorical moral principles.
example_zh: 我們不知道這是否是因爲他不想冒這個險，還是因爲他相信絕對的道德原則。

english: having or showing no understanding of what is proper or acceptable
example_en: The government has behaved with cra ss insensitivity.
example_zh: 該政府行事愚蠢而且麻木不仁。

english: mechanical or unthinking routine or repetition
example_en: He is very skeptical about the value of rote learning.
example_zh: 他非常懷疑死記硬背是否有用。

english: very dirty
being about to appear or to be produced or made available
example_en: The party is all geared up for the forthcoming election campaign.
example_zh: 該黨爲即將來臨的競選活動做好了準備.

english: to improve or perfect by pruning or polishing
example_en: Surgical techniques are constantly being refined.
example_zh: 外科手術的技術不斷得到完善。

english: hard to find or capture
example_en: Try to catch the elusive charm of the o riginal in translation.
example_zh: 翻譯時設法把握住原文中難以捉摸的風韻。

english: very small in size or amount
example_en: There is scant evidence of strong economic growth to come.
example_zh: 沒有足夠的證據表明經濟將會突飛猛進

english: having a very close relationship
example_en: Professor Li has already intimated that he intends to retire.
example_zh: 李教授已經暗示他打算退休。

english: to charge with a fault or offense
to occur, fall, or come between points of time or events
example_en: The situation calmed down when police intervened
example_zh: 警方介入後，局勢平息下來。

english: of or relating to idealists or idealism
example_en: This idealistic concept is at variance with reality.
example_zh: 這種空想主義的觀念和現實相矛盾。

english: having particles that easily move and change their relative position without a separation of the mass and that easily yield to pressure
example_en: The forehand stroke should be fluid and well balanced.
example_zh: 正手擊球應該保證動作流暢和平穩。

english: a person who falsely pretends to know or be something in order to deceive people
example_en: He was exposed as a charlatan.
example_zh: 他被揭穿，原來是個騙子。

english: the state of having identical cumulative distribution function or values
example_en: The government panicked into imposing a kind of cultural homogeneity.
example_zh: 政府在恐慌下開始強制實施某種文化統一政策。

english: working very hard
failing to give proper care and attention
example_en: Rumor had it that although Louise lived in a derelict house, he was really very wealthy.
example_zh: 傳言說雖然路易斯住在破敗的房子裏，但他其實很有錢。

english: not proper or appropriate for the situation
example_en: Everyone was shocked by his unseemly conduct.
example_zh: 大家都被他不得體的舉動震驚了。

english: a place or situation regarded as isolated, stagnant or backward
example_en: Quebec remained a backwater until the 1960s.
example_zh: 魁北克直到20世紀60年代還是一片死氣沉沉。

english: extravagantly emotional
example_en: The rejection of their pay claim was given a less than rhapsodic reception by the miners.
example_zh: 礦工要求提高工資遭到拒絕而甚爲惱火

english: approaching death
example_en: They said it was outdated, moribund, and in decline.
example_zh: 投資者說這家公司已經過時了，奄奄一息而且在下滑。

english: having or showing an ability to think clearly
example_en: It lies in the blend of clearheaded logic and powerful intuition.
example_zh: 它是清晰的邏輯和強有力的直覺的融合

english: perfectly typical or representative of a particular kind of person or thing
example_en: Chopstick is the quintessential cutlery choice throughout most of Asia.
example_zh: 筷子是亞洲大部分國家最典型的餐具選擇。

english: to give the necessary skill or knowledge to do a particular job or activity
example_en: The test qualifies you to drive heavy vehicles.
example_zh: 通過這一考試就有資格駕駛重型車輛。

english: respect for someone or something
example_en: He made a deep obeisance to the queen.
example_zh: 他向女王深深鞠了一躬。

english: having or showing a very clear understanding of something
example_en: She offered some really interesting, insightful observations.
example_zh: 她給出了一些非常有趣又富有洞察力的評論。

english: a tactic intended to embarrass or frustrate an opponent
example_en: Christmas should be a time of excitement and wonder, not a cynical marketing ploy.
example_zh: 聖誕節應該是興奮和美妙的時刻，而不該是一種肆無忌憚的營銷策略。

english: careful use of money, resources, etc.
example_en: It seems a false economy to me to cut down on libraries.
example_zh: 我看來，減少圖書館的數量並不是真正的節約。

english: forming or relating to the most important part of something
example_en: But on this question, the two leaders have very fundamental differences.
example_zh: 但在這個問題上，兩位領導人有着根本性的分歧。

english: a great disaster
example_en: Driving into Tripoli is to drive into a ghost city, you will feel like wondering in a set for a Hollywood apocalypse film.
example_zh: 車進入的黎波里就好像進入鬼城，彷彿置身好萊塢災難影片中的場景。

english: extremely or excessively particular, exacting, or meticulous in taste or standards
example_en: Even the most finicky eater will find something appetizing here.
example_zh: 即使是最挑剔的食客在這裏也會找到讓人胃口大開的美食。

english: very noticeable
example_en: There has been a marked increase in crimes against property.
example_zh: 侵犯財產罪的數量有了明顯的增加。

english: to claim to be or do a particular thing when this claim may not be true （
example_en: His plans are not what they purport to be.
example_zh: 他的計劃並不如他們所聲稱的那樣。

english: always wanting more
example_en: The public has an insatiable appetite for stories about the famous
example_zh: 公衆對名人有着難以滿足的好奇心。

english: being such to a degree that is extreme, excessive, or markedly abnormal
example_en: He experiences chronic, almost pathological jealousy
example_zh: 他長期心懷近乎病態的嫉妒。

english: serving as a crucial means, agent, or tool
example_en: In his first years as chairman he was instrumental in raising the company's wider profile.
example_zh: 在剛擔任董事長的頭幾年，他在提升公司形象方面發揮了作用。

english: to keep from doing what he or she wants to do
example_en: Wine or sugary drinks inhibit digestion.
example_zh: 葡萄酒或含糖飲料抑制消化。

english: to play or act so as to impress onlookers
example_en: The grandstand play caught attention of the crowd just as they were leaving.
example_zh: 就在觀衆正要離場的時候，那個吸引人的表演引起了他們的注意。

english: to suspend indefinitely or until a later stated time
example_en: The trial has been adjourned until next week.
example_zh: 審判延期至下週。

english: public violence, tumult, or disorder
example_en: Twelve inmates have been killed during a riot at the prison.
example_zh: 12名犯人在一場監獄暴亂中被殺害。

english: easy or possible to get or use
example_en: There are three small boats available for hire.
example_zh: 有3艘小船可供出租。

english: a memorable event or date
example_en: The birth of Christ was the beginning of a major epoch of world history.
example_zh: 基督誕生是世界歷史上一個重要紀元的開端。

english: fully taking one’s attention
example_en: Children will find other exhibits equally absorbing.
example_zh: 孩子們會對其他展品一樣感興趣。

english: to withdraw or shrink from or as if from pain
example_en: Murat had looked into the eyes of the firing squad without flinching.
example_zh: 穆拉特毫不退縮地直視着執行槍決的行刑隊員們的眼睛。

english: to torment by or as if by constant attack
example_en: She has been harried by the press all week.
example_zh: 整個星期她都受到新聞界的不斷煩擾。

english: abnormal dread of being in closed or narrow spaces
example_en: He experienced feelings of claustrophobia from being in a small place.
example_zh: 他呆在一個狹小的地方，體驗到了幽閉恐懼症的感覺。

english: to penetrate and come to understand
example_en: It is hard to fathom the pain felt at the death of a child.
example_zh: 喪子之痛是難以體會的。

english: coming and going at intervals
example_en: After three hours of intermittent rain, the game was cancelled.
example_zh: 雨斷斷續續地下了3個小時之後，比賽被取消了。

english: devoted to or biased in support of a party, group, or cause
example_en: The audience was very partisan, and refused to listen to the points she was making in her speech.
example_zh: 觀衆們很有偏見, 拒絕聆聽她發言中的要點。

english: to put or keep apart
example_en: The two countries have severed all diplomatic links.
example_zh: 兩國斷絕了一切外交關係。

english: moving slowly or lazily
example_en: She suggests ways to jump-start the sluggish educational system.
example_zh: 她提出了幾種方法來推動發展遲緩的教育體制。

english: existing or being something in name or form only
example_en: As he was still not allowed to run a company, his wife became its nominal head.
example_zh: 因爲他仍未獲準經營公司，他妻子成了名義上的老闆。

english: something that indicates or fixes a limit or extent
example_en: The boundaries between history and storytelling are always being blurred and muddled.
example_zh: 歷史和軼聞的分界向來是模糊而混亂的

english: an erratic, unpredictable, or extravagant manifestation, action, or notion
example_en: The style of vagary and ghastfulness and the sense of mystery are full of thestory of Allan.
example_zh: 愛倫的小說風格奇特恐怖,充滿了神祕感.

english: used to describe things that touch each other or are immediately next to each other
example_en: Its vineyards are virtually contiguous with those of Ausone.
example_zh: 其葡萄園差不多與着歐頌堡的葡萄園相鄰。

english: to destroy or remove completely
example_en: The country must extirpate the evils of drug abuse.
example_zh: 這個國家必須根除毒品氾濫的罪惡。

english: the act of obeying
example_en: Obedience by women towards men is a remnant of religious teaching.
example_zh: 女人對男人的順從是宗教教義的殘跡。

english: something pleasant or helpful
example_en: Low-cost Chinese imports have been a boon to European consumers, retailers and producers.
example_zh: 低成本的中國進口產品給歐洲消費者、零售商和生產商帶來了實惠。

english: a line at the beginning of a news story, magazine article, or book giving the writer's name
example_en: Finally, we wish to thank the author of this article which carries no byline.
example_zh: 最後，我們要感謝這篇文章的那位沒有署名的作者。

english: very exciting
example_en: He watched the breathtaking match to the end.
example_zh: 他把激動人心的比賽看到最後。

english: something that is made by combining different things
example_en: This kind of lighting encourages vitamin D synthesis in the skin.
example_zh: 這種光照會促進皮膚中維生素 D 的合成。

english: to have weight or effect
example_en: This would certainly militate against good bonding between the resin matrix and the glass.
example_zh: 這當然會影響樹脂基體與玻璃間的良好粘結。

english: incapable of being taken by assault
example_en: The Bundesbank's seemingly impregnable position has begun to weaken.
example_zh: 德意志聯邦銀行看似不可撼動的地位開始削弱了。

english: continuing or following without interruption
example_en: The noise of bombs and guns was incessant.
example_zh: 炸彈和槍炮接連不斷。

english: to follow a winding or intricate course
example_en: The stream meanders slowly down to the sea.
example_zh: 這條小河彎彎曲曲緩慢地流向大海。

english: tedious from familiarity
example_en: The Government, he said, were sticking to stale ideas.
example_zh: 他說政府仍在抱殘守缺。

english: having no example or parallel
example_en: In recent years, with the rapid development of economic construction in our country, high-grade highway construction is evolving with unexampled speed.
example_zh: 近些年來，隨着國民經濟持續高速發展，高等級公路的建設正以前所未有的發展速度向前推進。

english: to think of as having little importance or value
example_en: In his plans he discounted the expens e.
example_zh: 他在計劃中沒有考慮費用。

english: someone or something that comes before another
example_en: Dr. Sun Yat-sen was the forerunner of Chinese revolution.
example_zh: 孫中山 先生是中國革命的先行者。

english: lacking of honesty
example_en: Politicians are often accused of mendacity.
example_zh: 政客們常被斥爲扯謊成性。

english: giving warning
example_en: Some patients develop premonitory signs and symptoms, such as nervousness, sweating, and tachycardia.
example_zh: 病人可有先兆性症狀，例如易於激動，出汗和心動過速。

english: to act as intermediary
example_en: The Vatican successfully mediated in a territorial dispute between Argentina and Chile in 1984.
example_zh: 梵蒂岡成功地調解了1984年阿根廷與智利之間的領土爭端。

english: a calculated move: stratagem
example_en: He sees the proposal as more of a diplomatic gambit than a serious defense proposal.
example_zh: 在他看來，與其說這是一項精心籌劃的國防動議，倒不如說是外交上的一着妙棋。

english: very old or old- fashioned
to bring about or carry out (something, such as a crime or deception)
example_en: You begin to ask yourself what kind of person perpetrated this crime.
example_zh: 你開始自問是什麼樣的人犯下這樣的罪行。

english: not genuine, sincere, or authentic
example_en: He had managed to create the entirely spurious impression that the company was thriving.
example_zh: 他設法製造出一種徹頭徹尾的假象，讓人誤以爲公司一派興旺。

english: having a sickness that can be passed to someone else by touching
example_en: People with contagious diseases shoul d be isolated.
example_zh: 傳染病患者應予以隔離。

english: in good health
to make slow or difficult
example_en: Heavy snow hindered construction work.
example_zh: 大雪阻礙了建築工程的進展。

english: harshness of behavior or speech that expresses bitterness or anger
example_en: He spoke to the boy with asperity.
example_zh: 他嚴厲地對那男孩講話。

english: very clear and easy to understand
example_en: His explanation was lucid and to the point.
example_zh: 他的解釋扼要易懂。

english: an immature or inexperienced person
example_en: It turns out to be a fledgling mercenary to save them.
example_zh: 結果是一個新手僱傭兵去救他們。

english: to change level, strength, or value frequently
example_en: Body temperature can fluctuate if you are ill.
example_zh: 人患病後體溫可能會上下波動。

english: to withdraw from a place in an organized way especially for protection
example_en: They were planning to evacuate the seventy American officials still in the country.
example_zh: 他們當時在計劃將仍在那個國家的70位美國官員撤離。

english: to put together in a makeshift way
to set aside: annul
example_en: They need 12 votes to override his veto.
example_zh: 他們需要12票來推翻他的否決。

english: to avoid an encounter with
example_en: These might help people dodge some of the health effects of being overweight.
example_zh: 這些可能會幫助人們規避肥胖對健康的某些影響。

english: an unhelpful, unkind, or harmful act
example_en: You could do yourself a grave disservice by revealing all to a potential rival.
example_zh: 將一切都透露給潛在的競爭對手只會給自己幫倒忙。

english: connection, link
example_en: The Prayer Book has provided a flexible enough nexus of beliefs to hold together the different church parties.
example_zh: 祈禱書爲各信仰之間建起了足夠靈活的聯繫紐帶，以期將各個不同教派凝聚在一起。

english: great technical skill (as in the practice of a fine art)
example_en: At that time, his virtuosity on the trumpet had no parallel in jazz.
example_zh: 那時，他高超的小號吹奏技巧在爵士樂界無人能比。

english: to settle down for rest or sleep
example_en: The peacocks roost in nearby shrubs.
example_zh: 孔雀棲息在附近的灌木叢裏。

english: having a heavy offensive smell
example_en: The air of the room was fetid with stale tobacco smoke.
example_zh: 房間裏的空氣有陳煙的臭味。

english: to express scornfully one's low opinion of
example_en: To assert this is to denigrate the effectiveness of the police.
example_zh: 堅持這一點就是貶低警方的辦事能力。

english: to drink a large amount of quickly
example_en: He's quaffed many a glass of champagne in his time.
example_zh: 他年輕時曾經開懷暢飲過不少香檳美酒

english: pleasing to the mind or senses
example_en: To be idle sometimes is agreeable, but to be idle all the time might become monotonous.
example_zh: 一段時間空閒是令人愉快的，整日無所事事可能就單調乏味了。

english: the human body apart from the head, neck, arms, and legs
example_en: Torso more than a quarter of the site restricted activity, including tonic or should not rotate.
example_zh: 軀幹四分之一以上部位活動受限, 包括強直或不能旋轉。

english: meriting condemnation or blame especially as wrong or harmful
example_en: They held him culpable for the offence.
example_zh: 他們認爲他有罪應受懲罰。

english: something by which one is entangled, involved in difficulties, or impeded
example_en: Given data which are free from bias there are further snares to avoid in statistical work.
example_zh: 即使數據本身不存在偏差在統計工作中仍需要避免其他陷阱。

english: providing amusement or entertainment
example_en: It was a witty and diverting program.
example_zh: 這是個妙趣橫生的娛樂節目。

english: to be in charge of something
example_en: The PM returned to Downing Street to preside over a meeting of his inner cabinet.
example_zh: 首相回到唐寧街去主持一場核心內閣會議。

english: to lose vigor, health, or flesh
example_en: Men were also more likely to say I love you first and to pine after their first love.
example_zh: 男性更可能首先說我愛你，並在初戀結束後更易憔悴痛苦。

english: favoritism (as in appointment to a job) based on kinship
example_en: Cage changed his name to deflect accusations of nepotism.
example_zh: 凱奇改了名字以避免別人指責他搞裙帶關係。

english: a comprehensive presentation of a subject
example_en: The tower offers a breathtaking panorama of Prague.
example_zh: 從塔上可看到壯麗的布拉格全景。

english: an unfounded or false, deliberately misleading story
example_en: Since the age of internet was coming, canard of internet then challenged the authenticity of news.
example_zh: 自從人類進入互聯網時代以來，網絡謠言便對新聞真實提出了新的挑戰。

english: very polite in a way that shows respect
example_en: The staff is well trained in courteous a nd attentive service to each and every guest.
example_zh: 員工訓練有素，爲每一位客人提供禮貌周到的服務。

english: to change direction or course
example_en: The plane veered off the runway and crashed through the perimeter fence.
example_zh: 這架飛機突然偏離了跑道並且沖斷了周邊的護欄。

english: opposite in nature or effect
example_en: The tension grew in inverse proportion to the distance from their final destination.
example_zh: 拉力的增加與到達它們最終點的距離成相反的比例。

english: noticeable in an unpleasant or annoying way
example_en: The sofa would be less obtrusive in a paler color.
example_zh: 沙發的顏色再淺一點就不那麼扎眼了。

english: to stir to activity
example_en: The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
example_zh: 這一提案將引發全國性的抗議浪潮。

english: not capable of being solved
example_en: Life is a mystery, an inextricable mystery for human society.
example_zh: 生命是一個謎，是紅塵中的人永遠也解不開的謎。

english: to make an exact copy of
example_en: His task will be to duplicate his succes s overseas here at home.
example_zh: 他在海外取得了成功，現在的任務就是要在國內再創輝煌。

english: refusing to obey something or someone
example_en: Despite pulling back its missiles, the government maintained a defiant posture for home consumption.
example_zh: 儘管撤回了導彈，該政府在國內消費問題上仍舊保持蔑視的姿態。

english: accustomed, used
example_en: He was wont to fall asleep after supper.
example_zh: 他習慣喫完晚飯就打盹。

english: an insulting or disparaging remark or innuendo
example_en: She had dared to cast a slur on his character.
example_zh: 她竟敢對他的人品加以詆譭。

english: secret or dishonest behavior or activity
example_en: Ask any student about academic skullduggery and the response is startlingly nonchalant.
example_zh: 隨便問一位學生對於學術欺騙的看法,其若無其事的態度會讓你非常震驚.

english: having the power to horrify
example_en: The film showed the most horrific murder scenes.
example_zh: 那部影片有極恐怖的謀殺場面。

english: allowed according to rules or laws
example_en: The French government has condemned the coup in Haiti and has demanded the restoration of the legitimate government.
example_zh: 法國政府已經譴責了海地的政變，並要求恢復合法政府。

english: to deprive of vital content or force
example_en: The censors eviscerated the book to make it inoffensive to the President.
example_zh: 審查員刪去了該書的精華以取悅於總統

english: a strong feeling of dislike
a feeling of uneasiness about a point especially of conscience or propriety
tired and ready to fall asleep
example_en: The sedative makes people very somnolent.
example_zh: 這種鎮靜劑會讓人瞌睡。

english: to officially require (something)
example_en: He'd been mandated by the West African Economic Community to go in and to enforce a ceasefire
example_zh: 他受西非經濟共同體的命令介入並執行停火協定。

english: strongly marked
example_en: The early phase of Roman affairs was an aristocracy of a very pronounced type.
example_zh: 早期羅馬的事務是屬於顯著的貴族政治類型。

english: a minor flaw or shortcoming in character or behavior
to conquer and bring into subjection
example_en: Troops were called in to subdue the rebels.
example_zh: 軍隊被調來鎮壓反叛者。

english: following one after the other in a series
example_en: Jackson was the winner for a second successive year.
example_zh: 傑克遜已經是連續第二年獲勝了。

english: an opinion or idea formed without proof or sufficient evidence
example_en: That was a conjecture, not a fact.
example_zh: 那只是猜測，不是事實。

english: lacking in foresight or discernment
example_en: The government still has a myopic attitude to spending.
example_zh: 政府在開支方面仍然缺乏遠見。

english: lacking in freshness or originality
example_en: That's the old hackneyed phrase, but it's true.
example_zh: 這雖是老掉牙的套話，但卻是真理。

english: to cause to start or happen
example_en: The current recession was triggered by a slump in consumer spending.
example_zh: 目前的經濟衰退是由消費支出驟跌引起的。

english: shelter or protection from danger or distress
example_en: He regarded the room as a refuge from the outside world.
example_zh: 他把這個屋子當作是逃避外界的避難所

english: very small
example_en: The film was shot in 17 days, a minuscule amount of time.
example_zh: 這部電影僅用短短的17天便拍攝完畢。

english: to call something to mind
example_en: Ramona spoke with warmth when she recollected the doctor who used to be at the county hospital.
example_zh: 拉蒙納回憶起曾在鄉村醫院工作的那位醫生時，言語中透着溫情。

english: directly forward
grandiloquent
example_en: Before that oxymoron was a technical term describing a rhetorical device.
example_zh: 在此之前，oxymoron是一個技術術語，用來描述一種誇張的裝置。

english: to be about to occur
example_en: On the morning of the expedition I awoke with a feeling of impending disaster.
example_zh: 出發遠徵的那個早上，我醒來就有一種災難即將來臨的感覺。

english: to bring together at a single point or place
example_en: In the mass production era multinational firms tended to centralize their operations.
example_zh: 在大規模生產的時代，跨國公司往往實行集權化經營。

english: to form an opinion about something without definitely knowing the truth
example_en: From the looks on their faces, I surmised that they had had an argument.
example_zh: 看他們的臉色，我猜想他們之間發生了爭執。

english: to describe, portray, or set forth with accuracy or in detail
example_en: Biography must to some extent deline ate characters.
example_zh: 傳記必須在一定程度上描繪人物。

english: marked by futility or ineffectualness
example_en: All our efforts were in vain.
example_zh: 我們的所有努力都付諸東流了。

english: not willing to accept new or different ideas
example_en: You will never change their ideas because they are far too hidebound.
example_zh: 你無法改變他們的意思, 因爲他們太墨守成規。

english: exhibiting or given to extreme fierceness and unrestrained violence and brutality
example_en: The ferocious panther is chasing a rabbit.
example_zh: 那隻兇猛的豹子正追趕一隻兔子。

english: to get revenge
example_en: Christie retaliated by sending his friend a long letter detailing Carl's utter incompetence.
example_zh: 爲了報復，克里斯蒂給他朋友寄了一封長信，細述卡爾完全不稱職。

english: having lost character, vitality, or strength
example_en: Effete heart needs a moment rest.
example_zh: 疲憊的心靈也需要片刻的停歇。

english: a small piece of paper that allows one to get a service or product for free or at a lower price
example_en: Bring the coupon below to any Tecno store and pay just £ 10.99.
example_zh: 持下面的優惠券到任意一家Tecno專賣店，只需付10.99英鎊。

english: of little or no consequence
example_en: He believed all of their conclusion comes from a nugatory and pointless observation.
example_zh: 他相信他們的結論來自毫無價值和毫無意義的觀察。

english: to deceive by false appearance
example_en: Many people are hoodwinked by the so-called beauty industry.
example_zh: 很多人都被所謂的美容業欺騙了。

english: having or showing an ability to notice and understand things that are difficult or not obvious
example_en: It was very perspicacious of you to find the cause of the trouble so quickly.
example_zh: 你真是明察秋毫，問題的原因這麼快就找出來了。

english: one who takes part in dialogue or conversation
example_en: He was a more palatable interlocutor for the West than Mr Trump had been.
example_zh: 他相對於普京來說是一個更加合適和西方進行愉悅對話的總統。

english: to create an equal balance between two things

example_zh: 爲補償原料成本的增加而提高了價格。

english: small or narrow in circumference or width in proportion to length or height
example_en: Everybody of us admired her slender figure.
example_zh: 我們人人都羨慕她的苗條身材。

english: a joyous song or hymn of praise, tribute, thanksgiving, or triumph
example_en: The song is a paean to solitude and independence.
example_zh: 這首歌讚美孤寂和獨立。

english: characterized by procrastination
example_en: The boss sacked a dilatory worker yes terday.
example_zh: 昨天老闆開除了一個凡事都愛拖延的人

english: to perplex or confuse especially by a complexity, variety, or multitude of objects or considerations
example_en: The big city bewildered the old woman from the countryside.
example_zh: 大城市把鄉下來的老奶奶弄糊塗了。

english: genetically transmitted or transmittable from parent to offspring

example_zh: 男性脫髮屬於遺傳。

english: to accept, support or approve of

english: not easily upset or excited

example_zh: 大多數來紐約的遊客都被吸引到時代廣場。

english: a body of people entitled to vote

example_zh: 政府在很大程度上沒有弄清楚全體選民的情緒。

english: lacking resilience or firmness

example_zh: 這種鍛鍊能促使鬆弛的腹部變得平坦。

english: very busy or full of activity
example_en: My life was very hectic but empty before I met him.
example_zh: 在遇到他之前，我的生活非常繁忙卻很空虛。

english: form the foundation of
example_en: These ideas underlie much of his work.
example_zh: 他的作品大部分都是以這些主題思想爲基礎。

english: leaving no doubt

example_zh: 報告中傳達的信息是明確的。

english: given to or abounding in excessive moralizing
example_en: His article is sententious and pompous.
example_zh: 他寫的文章是說教式的，華而不實。

english: the main support or major sustaining factor
example_en: The youths are the backbones of the country.
example_zh: 年輕人是國家的棟樑。

english: to approve and sanction formally
example_en: The treaty was ratified by all the member states.
example_zh: 這個條約得到了所有成員國的批准。

english: a feeling or belief that good things will happen in the future
example_en: Optimism was gradually taking the place of pessimism.
example_zh: 樂觀情緒逐漸取代了悲觀主義。

english: take back, cancel
example_en: Trade Union leaders have demanded the government rescind the price rise.
example_zh: 工會領導已經要求政府阻止價格上漲。

english: not drawn upon or utilized

example_zh: 我們必須利用我們尚未利用的人才。

english: to stop developing, progressing, moving, etc.
chinese: 臺灣經濟很可能會停滯很長一段時間。
example_en: Taiwan's economy is likely to stagnate for a long time to come.
example_zh: 臺灣經濟很可能會停滯很長一段時間。

english: appear disturbed and upset or they seem to be slightly crazy.
never stopping

example_zh: 人類社會總是不斷進步的。

english: to convey as a gift
example_en: The Queen has bestowed a
example_zh: knighthood on him. 女王已經授予他爵士頭銜。

english: regard for or consideration of oneself or one's own interests
example_en: With such self - regard as you display, what room is left for the public's love?
example_zh: 像你這樣表現自私的人心裏哪裏還放得下公衆的愛戴?

english: to prevail over
to make more violent, bitter, or severe
example_en: Utter waste, together with inefficient use of water reserves exacerbate the crisis.
example_zh: 浪費加水資源的非有效利用更加加劇了水危機。

english: to move along unsteadily or with difficulty
an undoubted or self- evident truth
example_en: Whilst this might sound like a truism, it is nevertheless a crucial problem to address.
example_zh: 儘管這可能聽起來像是老生常談，但卻是待解決的重要問題。

english: more than is usual, necessary, or proper
example_en: Baking a whole cheese in pastry may seem extravagant.
example_zh: 烤點心時加一整塊奶酪似乎太奢侈了。

english: very devoted or loyal to a person, belief, or cause
example_en: He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.
example_zh: 他堅決支持控制政府開支。

english: to conceal or disguise
example_en: The soldiers camouflaged themselves with leaves.
example_zh: 士兵用樹葉來僞裝自己。

english: difficult or complicated
example_en: The new management faces some knotty problems.
example_zh: 新的管理層面臨着一些棘手的問題。

english: careful about doing something in an accurate and exact way
example_en: The police carried out a thorough investigation.
example_zh: 警方展開了全面的調查。

english: very difficult
example_en: The task is arduous; besides, there's not much time.
example_zh: 任務艱鉅，同時時間又很緊迫。

english: respect that is given to someone who is admired
example_en: The Chinese make a point of their personal honor.
example_zh: 中國人特別重視個人榮譽。

english: to tell everyone about something that you are proud of, especially in an annoying way
example_en: Mark Morris, who is trumpeted as the dance talent of his generation…
example_zh: 馬克·莫里斯，被吹捧爲他那一代的舞蹈奇才

english: to compose out of materials from other documents
example_en: The album was compiled from live recordings from last year's tour.
example_zh: 這套唱片選輯由去年巡迴演出的實況錄音彙編而成。

english: to interpret the meaning of
example_en: The Coastguard needs to decipher garbled messages in a few minutes.
example_zh: 海岸警衛隊需要在幾分鐘內解讀這些含混不清的信息。

english: to say or do again or again and again
example_en: It's very difficult to balance that need to be nimble and iterate quickly and the need to plan.
example_zh: 要想平衡靈活、快速迭代的需求與計劃需求是非常困難的。

english: to show to be false or wrong
example_en: Her energy and youthful good looks belie her 65 years.
example_zh: 她的活力與年輕美貌使人看不出她有65歲了。

english: to declare to be evil or detestable
example_en: It is not polite to execrate others in the public.
example_zh: 在公共場合對他人咒罵很不禮貌。

english: feeling or showing readiness to fight
example_en: At the moment southerners are loyal mostly to belligerent tribal chiefs, not the nascent government that led the fight for independence.
example_zh: 目前，南部蘇丹居民主要效忠於好戰的部落首領，而不是帶領他們爲獨立而戰的新生的政府。

english: a person or thing of little consequence or significance
example_en: Amidst the current bunch of nonentities, he is a towering figure.
example_zh: 在目前這幫無足輕重的人裏面，他算是鶴立雞羣了。

english: devoted to labor
a sudden invasion or attack

example_zh: 從一開始，英格蘭人的入侵就註定了失敗。

english: characterized by or manifesting unrest especially of mind
example_en: The audience grew restless and inattentive.
example_zh: 觀衆變得焦躁不安，注意力不集中。

english: to satisfy (a need, a desire, etc.) fully or to excess
example_en: The dinner was enough to satiate the gourmets.
example_zh: 晚餐足以讓這些美食家們大飽口福。

english: to demand an express term in an agreement
example_en: That is why the vehicle manufacturers stipulate regular engine oil changes.
example_zh: 這就是爲什麼汽車製造商規定定期發動機換油。

english: obstinate, cantankerous
example_en: She's so cussed that she always does the opposite of what you ask.
example_zh: 她這人真是牛脾氣，總是與你的要求背道而馳。

example_en: She is pillory in the press for her extravagant parties.
example_zh: 她的聚會十分鋪張,新聞界對她大加揶揄.

english: an agent that provokes or speeds significant change or action
a person who stimulates or annoys other people especially by persistent criticism

example_zh: 布坎南只是故意攪局還是對總統構成真正的威脅，這還有待觀察。

english: to completely do away with

example_zh: 美國1865年廢除了奴隸制度。

english: sad or depressed

example_zh: 近期的就業前景依然暗淡。

english: product of the imagination

example_zh: 這個故事的確是人們最喜歡的一個，但毫無疑問它純粹是虛構的。

english: showing innocent or childlike simplicity and candidness

english: egoism, egocentrism
chinese: 被自戀症折磨的人會變得只專注於自己

example_zh: 被自戀症折磨的人會變得只專注於自己的事情，或者不斷地自我炫耀。

english: to support, strengthen, or defend
example_en: You need more facts to buttress up your argument.
example_zh: 你需要有更多的事實來支持你的論據。

english: of or relating to birds

example_zh: 已經發現至少有一種禽病的病原體。

english: dividing into two parts

example_zh: 近期作品融合原本二元對立的元素，每幅畫作都試圖尋求一種新的和諧感。

english: to exceed in number

example_zh: 示威者人數遠不及警察人數。

english: the highest point of something

example_zh: 他的作品被認爲是電影藝術的巔峯之作

english: feeling or expressing humble or regretful pain or sorrow for sins or offenses

example_zh: 悔過者獲得了赦免。

english: lacking confidence

example_zh: 他在公開場合表達自己的意見感到膽怯

english: recklessly and often ostentatiously daring
to subdue or deaden (the body, bodily appetites, etc.)

example_zh: 簡離開丈夫的做法使她的家庭蒙羞。

english: to cause or aid the development of

english: a name that someone uses instead of his or her real name

example_zh: 兩個劇本都是以菲利普·戴爾的筆名出版的。

english: complete and total

example_zh: 一切生物之中，只有人類達到了完全控制食物生產的地步。

english: causing or related to a great complete change

english: to say or state in a public, official, or definite way
something choice or pleasing

example_zh: 小姑娘穿着一件漂亮的連衣裙。

english: to treat with insolence, indignity, or contempt

english: to pay attention to

example_zh: 如果民主黨打算今年做出點實事，他們就應當注意這樣的一些擔憂。

english: not capable of bing mistaken or misunderstood

example_zh: 烏雲是下雨的明顯先兆。

english: to give or assume the appearance or effect of often with the intent to deceive
the state of being old and in bad condition or poor health

example_zh: 這座建築看上去破舊失修，無人照管。

noisily insistent

english: possible to verify

english: the money, skill, etc., that is needed to get or do something

example_zh: 中國有足夠的資金實現其龐大的經濟刺激計劃。

english: to accept readily or gladly
having little or no importance or significance

example_zh: 你知道，這聽起來對你是不重要的。

example_zh: 這部電影使用了他的形象，侵犯了他的肖像權。

example_zh: 有證據表明，我們的觸覺會隨着年齡的增長而減損。

english: carried through the air

example_zh: 許多人對空氣傳播的污染物過敏，比如花粉。

english: the act of weakening or exhausting by constant harassment, abuse, or attack

example_zh: 在與政府的消耗戰中，叛軍已宣佈停火

english: old-fashioned and no longer suitable for modern conditions

example_zh: 很多工廠過於陳舊落後，已不值得挽救

english: the origin and the history of something

example_zh: 她有純正的貴族血統。

english: the highest point or the highest level

example_zh: 該黨的最高權力機構是中央委員會。

english: not correct

example_zh: 那家報紙聲明撤回那篇錯誤的報道。

english: having or marked by great volume or bulk

example_zh: 聯邦調查局保存了有關巴勃羅·畢加索的大量檔案。

english: a record of how well you have paid your bills in the past

example_zh: 信用卡業務出現了下滑，而且越來越多的借款者都不按期還款。

english: said or done in such a way that others know exactly what you mean
example_en: It's too soon to give a definite answer.
example_zh: 要給出一個明確的答覆，現在還爲時過早。

english: relating to the human race's actual life on this earth

example_zh: 他鼓吹對所有的世俗享樂的摒棄。

english: of, relating to, or occurring in the night

example_zh: 月圓之夜，這種夜間活動的齧齒類動物會小心地呆在地洞裏不出來。

english: a strong feeling of dislike or hatred

example_zh: 當和平最終來臨時這兩個民族間戰時的敵意消退爲彼此的不信任。

english: the mass of the people as distinguished from those of a particular profession or those specially skilled
example_en: He shows painting skills which distinguish himself from the laity.
example_zh: 他展示出有別於門外漢的繪畫技巧。

english: beginning to exist

example_zh: 我們經理發現了一個新人才。

english: being the first or earliest known of its kind present in a region

example_zh: 印第安人是美國的土著人.

english: mockery usually by caricature （

example_zh: 辯護律師們滑稽的動作將審判變成了對正義的滑稽諷刺

english: deserving attention, admiration, or respect

example_zh: 儘管他的一些同齡人也許並不認同這個稱號，他的資歷仍然令人欽佩不已。

english: to empty of a principal substance

example_zh: 他們長時間開火，耗盡了彈藥。

english: to destroy or interrupt the orderly structure or function of
the smallest part or particle imaginable
example_en: There's not a whit of truth in the statement.
example_zh: 這聲明裏沒有絲毫的真實性。

english: very cruel or unfair
example_en: This country still had a deeply oppressive, unequal and divisive political system.
example_zh: 這個國家的政治體制依然殘暴異常，缺少平等，四分五裂。

english: a person whom one knows but who is not a particularly close friend
example_en: She is not my friend, just an acquaintance.
example_zh: 她不是我的朋友，只是一個熟人。

english: one that is stunning, amazing, or devastating
example_en: His resignation is a political bombshell.
example_zh: 他的辭職是一件政治上的爆炸性新聞。

english: used to describe something that is done without energy or enthusiasm because of habit or because it is expected

example_zh: 那懶惰的小男孩草草地把臉洗了一下。

english: to elevate to divine status

example_zh: 我們不應該神化任何人。

english: to seek to gain or bring about

example_zh: 他們靠提供低息來招攬客戶。

english: to impede or hamper the function or activity of

example_zh: 他們不會在路上拖累大家。

example_zh: 老頭蓬頭垢面，衣衫襤褸。

english: carrying great weight and producing a marked effect

example_zh: 中國驚人地崛起爲超級大國，在政治、經濟、文化方面具有顯著的影響力，這些都引起了人們學習漢語的興趣。

english: rude and showing a lack of respect

example_zh: 艾米笨拙地做了個手勢。

english: marked by bad temper, malevolence, or spite

example_zh: 沒有學生喜歡這個愛發脾氣的老師。

english: a state of perplexity or doubt

example_zh: 政府似乎陷入了左右爲難的境地，不知道該拿這麼多人怎麼辦。

english: a feeling of great happiness and excitement
