example_zh: 選舉後一片興高采烈。

english: more important, powerful, successful, or noticeable than other people or things
example_en: There are several factors, but the predominant one is climate change.
example_zh: 其中因素有幾個，但最主要的就是氣候變化。

english: a person who predicts the future by magical, intuitive, or more rational means
relating to a scientific experiment or to scientific experiments in general
example_en: The experimental results show that the syntaxic method is effective.
example_zh: 實驗結果表明該綜合性方法效果良好。

english: to adjust precisely for a particular function
example_en: He is reading instructions on how to calibrate a thermometer.
example_zh: 他在看校準溫度計的說明。

english: to make a ritual of
example_en: Ritualize your transition at the close of the workday.
example_zh: 以儀式化的方式去結束這一天的工作。

english: not decreasing or becoming weaker
example_en: His unflagging enthusiasm was an inspiration for all of us.
example_zh: 他經久不衰的熱情鼓舞了我們所有人。

english: lack of vitality
example_en: Victims of this disease suffer from a severe and usually fatal anemia.
example_zh: 這種疾病的患者常患嚴重的,往往是致命性的貧血癥。

english: to cancel (an order) especially by giving a new order
example_en: The general countermand the orders issued in his absence.
example_zh: 將軍撤銷了他不在時所發佈的命令。

english: an account of the descent of a person, family, or group from an ancestor or from older forms
example_en: Darwin argued that this kind of similarity — known as homology — was just a matter of genealogy.
example_zh: 達爾文認爲這種相似性是物種之間的宗譜關係的結果。

english: to write or draw hastily and carelessly
example_en: She can't write yet, but she loves to scribble with a pencil.
example_zh: 她現在還不會寫字, 但她喜歡用鉛筆亂塗.

english: very serious about doing things in a direct and efficient way without any foolishness or nonsense
example_en: She saw herself as a direct, no- nonsense, modern woman.
example_zh: 她視自己爲一個率直、高效幹練的現代女性。

english: having or showing perception, comprehension, or shrewdness especially in practical matters
example_en: He is known for his political savvy and strong management skills.
example_zh: 他以政治悟性和強勢的管理手腕出名。

english: no longer useful or acceptable
example_en: The tourists snigger at the locals' outdated ways and dress.
example_zh: 遊客們偷偷地取笑當地人過時的做法和衣着。

english: delay, defer
example_en: The had certainly taken his time, even protracting the process.
example_zh: 他肯定是慢慢來的，甚至還拖延進程。

english: the attitude a person or group has toward a subject
example_en: The military machine is ready to change its defensive posture to one prepared for action.
example_zh: 軍事當局已準備從防禦態勢變爲備戰態勢。

english: happening very soon
example_en: The black clouds show that a storm is imminent.
example_zh: 烏雲預示暴風雨即將來臨。

english: to bring legal action against for redress or punishment of a crime or violation of law
example_en: The police decided not to prosecute.
example_zh: 警方決定不予起訴。

english: fruitful in offspring or vegetation
example_en: The pampas are still among the most f ecund lands in the world.
example_zh: 南美大草原仍然是世界上最肥沃的土地之一。

english: to ask questions or express doubt about
example_en: We queried the bill as it seemed far too high.
example_zh: 賬單上的費用似乎太高了，我們對此表示懷疑。

english: the act of providing money to create or support a school, organization, etc.
example_en: The hospital was founded on an endowment fund.
example_zh: 這所醫院是用捐贈基金創辦的。

english: to check or go counter to
example_en: Austria has sent three army battalions to its border with Hungary to stem the flow of illegal immigrants.
example_zh: 奧地利已派出 3 個營的兵力去本國和匈牙利交界的邊境地區阻止非法移民的流入。

english: done to trick someone for the purpose of getting something valuable
example_en: The investigation has laid bare their fraudulent scheme.
example_zh: 這個調查把他們的騙局暴露無遺.

english: having a rough uneven surface
example_en: We left the rough track and bumped our way over a rugged mountainous terrain.
example_zh: 我們駛離坎坷的小道，又顛簸過了崎嶇多巖的山地。

english: restricted or peculiar to a locality or region
example_en: Street crime is virtually endemic in larg e cities.
example_zh: 街頭犯罪近乎是大城市的通病。

english: a strong written or spoken attack against someone else’s opinions, beliefs, practices, etc.
example_en: The book is both a history and a passionate polemic for tolerance.
example_zh: 這本書既是一段歷史，也是一篇主張寬容的激情論辯。

english: able to be seen
example_en: The same alarm is manifest everywhere.
example_zh: 同樣的恐慌在各地都已出現。

english: very easy to see or notice
example_en: The advertisements were all posted in a conspicuous place.
example_zh: 廣告都貼在了顯眼的地方。

english: deserving to be admired
example_en: The soldiers showed admirable bravery.
example_zh: 士兵們表現出了令人欽佩的勇敢。

english: used for decoration
example_en: The stream was dammed up to form ornamental lakes.
example_zh: 溪流用水壩攔擋起來,形成了裝飾性的湖泊。

english: expressing suffering or sadness
example_en: They lay on the firm sands, listening to the plaintive cry of the seagulls.
example_zh: 他們躺在硬實的沙地上，聽着海鷗的哀鳴。

english: dissent or deviation from a dominant theory, opinion, or practice
example_en: He was burned at the stake for heresy.
example_zh: 他因爲信奉異端思想而以火刑處死。

english: a manner or the content of thinking characteristic of an individual, group, or culture
example_en: Such an approach accords with the principles of socialist ideology.
example_zh: 這種方法與社會主義意識形態的原則相符。

english: to give prominence to
chinese: 網站的其他部分將這個顏色用作強調色
example_en: These colors are used as accent colors in the rest of the website.
example_zh: 網站的其他部分將這個顏色用作強調色

english: to cause to come
example_en: Her screams drew passers-by to the scene.
example_zh: 她的驚叫聲把過路人吸引到了現場。

english: not firm or stiff
an artist, performer, or player of consummate skill
example_en: She was a master of the English language.
example_zh: 她是英文高手。

english: not genuinely felt
example_en: The persons and events portrayed in this production are fictitious.
example_zh: 這部作品中描述的人物和事件均屬虛構

english: capable of relieving pain
example_en: The analgesic effects of acupuncture are well-documented.
example_zh: 鍼灸止痛的效果是舉世公認的。

english: fit for or used for the growing of crops
example_en: The soil proved too infertile to sustain real pasture or arable crops.
example_zh: 這土壤被證明太貧瘠，不能真正用作放牧或耕種作物。

english: friendly joking about or with somebody
example_en: Prince Charles does not escape raillery from others.
example_zh: 查爾斯王子也難逃人們善意的玩笑。

english: of outstanding spiritual, intellectual, or moral worth
example_en: She elevated every rare small success to the sublime.
example_zh: 她把每一次少有的微小成功都提升成了非凡的成就。

english: having a haughty overbearing manner
example_en: Mr Erdogan has good reason for his lofty confidence.
example_zh: 埃爾多安先生有着傲慢狂妄的正當理由

english: proved good, desirable, or feasible
example_en: Now you can apply tried and true principles to your own game.
example_zh: 現在你能把揮杆八步法的真正原理應用到你自己的高爾夫運動中了。

english: thinking carefully about something
having a strong influence on ideas, works, events, etc., that come later
example_en: The reforms have been a seminal event in the history of the NHS.
example_zh: 這些改革已成爲英國國民保健制度史上一件具有開創性的大事。

english: something that exists only in the imagination and is not possible in reality
chinese: 宗教統一仍然和從前一樣，不過是個妄
example_en: Religious unity remained as much a chimera as ever.
example_zh: 宗教統一仍然和從前一樣，不過是個妄想。

english: the feeling that people express when they criticize and laugh at someone or something in an insulting way
example_en: Americans speak with derision of those who are lazy.
example_zh: 美國人總是帶着嘲笑的口氣談論那些懶惰的人。

english: to stray especially from a standard, principle, or topic
example_en: On this occasion the plane deviated from its usual flight path.
example_zh: 這一次那架飛機偏離了正常的航線。

english: yielding abundantly
example_en: There were two very large oak trees in front of our house with wide spreading branches and luxuriant foliage.
example_zh: 那時我們家門口有兩棵枝廣葉茂的大橡樹。

english: to deal out or seek to disseminate
example_en: They even set up their own news agency to peddle anti-isolationist propaganda.
example_zh: 他們甚至建立了自己的新聞機構以散佈反孤立主義思想。

english: lavish or superfluous ornament especially in architecture
example_en: There is a high-gabled gingerbread house.
example_zh: 一幢有高高的山牆、外部裝飾過分雕琢的房屋。

english: to thoroughly overwhelm and reduce to submission or passivity
example_en: Extra police were called in to quell the disturbances.
example_zh: 已調集了增援警力來平定騷亂。

english: to cause confusion in
example_en: Later they may muddle up your names with those of your cousins.
example_zh: 以後他們可能會把你的名字跟你堂兄弟們的名字相混淆。

english: very unusual in a way that does not seem natural
example_en: Their parents had an almost preternatural ability to understand what was going on in their children's minds.
example_zh: 他們的父母有着一種近乎神奇的能力，能夠洞悉自己的孩子腦子裏正在想什麼

english: very cruel
marked by incisive sarcasm
example_en: He delights in making caustic remarks.
example_zh: 他說話刻薄，還以此爲樂。

english: being both relevant and opportune
example_en: Such people are ones that you turn to for guidance, knowledge and apropos wisdom about life.
example_zh: 這些人是良師益友，他們指引你成爲全知並充滿適當的智慧去了解生命的意義

english: a competition, dispute, or fight open to all comers and usually with no rules
example_en: The lowering of trade barriers has led to a free-for-all among exporters.
example_zh: 降低貿易壁壘導致出口商各自爲政。

english: to deprive of courage or confidence
example_en: Clearly, one of the objectives is to dem oralize the enemy troops in any way th ey can.
example_zh: 很明顯，目標之一就是要用一切可能的手段打擊敵軍的士氣。

english: of or relating to centralized control by an autocratic leader or hierarchy
example_en: In totalitarian societies, art exists for didactic purposes.
example_zh: 在極權社會中，藝術是爲教誨目的存在的。

english: malicious or defamatory gossip
example_en: There has been no hint of scandal during his time in office.
example_zh: 他在任期間沒有任何醜聞。

english: unqualified, utter
example_en: His music is sheer delight
example_zh: 聽他的音樂完全是一種享受。

english: a person who criticizes or opposes beliefs and practices that are widely accepted
example_en: Cage was an iconoclast. He refused to be bound by western musical traditions of harmony and structure.
example_zh: 凱奇是個反傳統的人。他拒絕接受西方有關和聲和結構的音樂傳統的束縛。

english: extraordinary, remarkable
example_en: Exports of Australian wine are growing at a phenomenal rate.
example_zh: 澳大利亞葡萄酒出口正在以驚人的速度增長。

english: a state of very great happiness
example_en: My father was in ecstasy when I won my scholarship.
example_zh: 我獲得獎學金時父親欣喜若狂。

english: feeling or showing a lack of courage or confidence
something that will make everything about a situation better
example_en: Membership of the ERM is not a panacea for Britain's economic problems.
example_zh: 加入歐洲匯率機制並不是解決英國經濟問題的萬靈丹。

english: covering or including everything
example_en: An all-inclusive two-week holiday costs around £880 per person.
example_zh: 爲期兩週、包括所有費用的度假大約每人花費880英鎊。

english: to give new life or vigor to
example_en: This hair conditioner is excellent for revitalizing dry, lifeless hair.
example_zh: 這種護髮素能夠非常有效地修復乾枯的頭髮。

english: ample to satisfy and nourish
example_en: Substantial numbers of people support the reforms.
example_zh: 相當多的人支持這些改革措施。

english: marked by outstanding strength and vigor of body, mind, or spirit
the substitution of an agreeable or inoffensive expression for one that may offend or suggest something unpleasant
example_en: The term early retirement is nearly alw ays a euphemism for redundancy now adays.
example_zh: 現在提前退休幾乎就是裁員的委婉說法

english: substantially real
example_en: The policy has not yet brought any tangible benefits.
example_zh: 這項政策還沒有帶來任何切實可行的好處。

english: to find the correct explanation for
example_en: The discovery will help scientists unravel the mystery of the Ice Age.
example_zh: 這一發現將有助於科學家揭開冰川時代的奧祕。

english: expressing harsh or sharp criticism in a clever way
example_en: The playwright allows an acerbic tone to pierce through arid or flowery prose.
example_zh: 劇作家允許在枯燥或華麗的散文中插入刻薄的語調。

english: not fresh or original
example_en: The movie is teeming with obvious and trite ideas.
example_zh: 這部電影充滿着明顯而陳腐的觀點。

english: having or consisting of a physical body or form
example_en: We live in a culture dominated by pixel s, increasingly unmoored from corpore al reality.
example_zh: 我們生活在一個被像素主宰的社會，日益脫離物質現實。

english: marked by excessive enthusiasm and often intense uncritical devotion
seeming to be seen everywhere
example_en: In the US, the camcorder has become ubiquitous
example_zh: 便攜式攝錄機在美國隨處可見。

english: to give heart to: cheer
example_en: These initiatives appeared to hearten investors.
example_zh: 這些舉措似乎鼓舞了投資者。

english: fully revealed or expressed without vagueness, implication, or ambiguity
example_en: He was explicit about his intention to o verhaul the party's internal voting syst em.
example_zh: 他直言自己的目的是改革黨內的投票制度。

english: to confound with fear, amazement, or awe
example_en: The news petrified me.
example_zh: 這個新聞讓我非常喫驚。

english: to produce an effect upon
example_en: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
example_zh: 住房條件差、家庭壓力大會影響身心兩方面的健康。

english: very clever and able to make intelligent
extremely old
example_en: But as the years have passed, what were once fresh ideas have hardened into hoary dogmas.
example_zh: 但是隨着時間的流逝，一度新鮮的觀念也變成了陳腐的教條。

english: tending or intended to evade: equivocal
example_en: They decided to take evasive action.
example_zh: 他們決定採取迴避行動。

english: not exciting or interesting
different from what is usually done or accepted
example_en: Many doctors don't approve of unorthodox medicine.
example_zh: 許多醫生不贊同用非正統的藥品。

english: a state in which all activity or motion is stopped
example_en: Argentina came to a virtual standstill while the game was being played.
example_zh: 在比賽進行的時候，阿根廷全國幾乎陷入了停頓狀態。

english: often angry and annoyed
example_en: He met a crabbed, cantankerous director.
example_zh: 他碰上了一位壞脾氣、易怒的主管。

english: something that is unusual or unexpected
example_en: But others believe the U.S. slowdown was an aberration.
example_zh: 但也有人認爲美國增長的放緩是反常的

english: exceeding or violating propriety or fitness
example_en: This would help the families to survive the drought without undue suffering.
example_zh: 這將有助於這些家庭免受過多痛苦來度過這次旱災。

english: not letting up or weakening in vigor or pace
example_en: An unrelenting downpour of rain disturbed her.
example_zh: 一場下不停的傾盆大雨讓她心煩意亂。

english: to remove from power especially by force
example_en: That government was overthrown in a military coup three years ago.
example_zh: 那個政府在3年前的軍事政變中被推翻

english: needless repetition of an idea, statement, or word
example_en: Modern logicians regard it as little more than tautology.
example_zh: 現代的邏輯學家僅僅把它看作同義反復.

english: good at doing something
an alteration designed to correct or improve
example_en: Chief editor finally accepted the textual emendations made by associate chief editor.
example_zh: 主編最終接受了副編輯的修訂文稿。

english: exemption or freedom from punishment, harm, or loss
example_en: These gangs operate with apparent impunity.
example_zh: 這些團夥明目張膽地活動,卻不受任何懲罰。

english: to read, study, or examine superficially and rapidly
to give spiritual insight to
characterized by or peculiar to wisdom
example_en: Book is my hand-in-hand friend, she and I are together all along, and she loyally strings along with me and gives me ideaistic edification and a sapiential key.
example_zh: 書是我的親密朋友，多年來它對我不離不棄，忠誠地陪伴守候在我身邊，給了我思想的啓迪和智慧的鑰匙。

english: a rapid expansion or increase
example_en: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.
example_zh: 在戰後那段繁榮昌盛的時期裏，生活水平得到了迅速提高。

english: unambiguous
example_en: The president declared that it was important to send a univocal message of support to the beleaguered country.
example_zh: 總統宣稱對處於困境中的國家，明確表示支持是很重要的。

english: having or relating to a frequency below the audibility range of the human ear
example_en: Another haunted and related natural phenomenon is known as frequency infrasonic sound waves.
example_zh: 另一種與鬧鬼相關的自然現象是稱作次聲的低頻聲波。

english: construct, manufacture
example_en: The evidence was totally fabricated.
example_zh: 這個證據純屬僞造。

english: importance
example_en: Who leads Canada is also of some import to the rest of the world.
example_zh: 誰領導加拿大對世界來講也具有一定的重要性。

english: the reason or explanation for something
example_en: However, the rationale for such initiatives is not, of course, solely economic.
example_zh: 然而，這種提議的根據當然並不僅僅是經濟方面的。

english: to deprive or dispossess especially of property, authority, or title
example_en: The army divested the king of all his power.
example_zh: 陸軍剝奪了國王的全部權力。

english: to deny the existence or truth of
example_en: Alcohol negates the effects of the drug.
example_zh: 酒使藥失去了效力。

english: to talk loudly and in a way that shows anger
example_en: As the boss began to rant, I stood up and went out.
example_zh: 老闆開始咆哮的時候，我起身走了出去

english: to yield or grant typically by treaty
example_en: Germany and Japan need to cede to the emerging economies industries in which they are no longer competitive.
example_zh: 德國和日本應該對新興經濟體讓出他們不在佔有優勢的行業。

english: surpassing all others
example_en: Some superlative wines are made in this region.
example_zh: 一些上好的葡萄酒就是在這個地區釀造的。

english: the last small part that remains of something that existed before
example_en: These upright stones are the vestiges of some ancient religion.
example_zh: 這些豎立的石頭是某種古代宗教的遺蹟

english: likely to betray trust
example_en: He publicly left the party and denounced its treacherous leaders...
example_zh: 他公開脫離該黨，並譴責該黨領袖背信棄義。

english: a person who plays pranks
example_en: Deepika is quite a prankster, often
example_zh: playing jokes on her friends.迪皮卡是個頑皮的人，經常和她的朋友開玩笑。

english: to infer from a general principle
example_en: Alison had cleverly deduced that I was the author of the letter.
example_zh: 艾莉森已經聰明地推斷出那封信就是我寫的。

english: someone who knows a lot about many different things
example_en: Mr English, an associate editor of the Guardian, is a polymath who wears his learning lightly.
example_zh: 英格力士先生是《衛報》的副編輯，是一位略顯才華的博學者。

english: capable of being understood or appreciated
example_en: The director believed that program can make science more accessible to young people.
example_zh: 該負責人認爲這項計劃能讓年輕人更容易理解科學。

english: repellent, disconcerting
chinese: 令人不愉快的，令人討厭的
example_en: However, many customers found the smell of this product distinctly off- putting.
example_zh: 然而，很多顧客覺得該產品有一股異味，非常難聞。

english: not false or artificial
example_en: Her countenance and a few artless words fully conveyed all her gratitude and delight.
example_zh: 她的表情和寥寥幾句質樸無華的語言已充分表達了她的感激與高興。

english: to throw a strong light on
example_en: The President highlights the importance of his visit to China.
example_zh: 總統強調訪問中國的重要性。

english: an intimate and often exclusive group of persons with unifying common interest or purpose
example_en: Mary and her coterie gave a party to w hich we were not invited.
example_zh: 瑪利和她的圈內朋友舉行派對，我們沒被邀請。

english: relating to having a strict and simple way of living that avoids physical pleasure
example_en: He lives an ascetic life.
example_zh: 他過着苦行的生活。

english: fast and typically superficial
example_en: The Government should not be pressured into making hasty decisions.
example_zh: 政府不應該迫於壓力倉促作出決定。

english: a great or foolish amount of pride or confidence
having an erratic or intermittent character
example_en: The government is making slow and fitful progress in these negotiations.
example_zh: 政府從這些談判中正取得緩慢的、間斷性的進展。

english: having a coarse uneven surface that is rough or unpleasant to the touch
example_en: The harsh truth is that luck plays a big part in who will live or die.
example_zh: 殘酷的事實是，誰死誰活在很大程度上要靠運氣。

english: to confront with assured power of resistance
example_en: The towering pine and cypress trees defy frost and snow.
example_zh: 松柏參天傲霜雪。

english: separate and different from each other

present in all places at all times

english: being less dense

english: in favor of using peaceful and diplomatic methods to achieve something, rather than using force and violence

english: seeking solitude : retiring from society

example_zh: 關於那名隱居者鄰居們所知道的就是他已經在那棟樓裏住了大約二十年了。

english: making good health possible or likely

example_zh: 因其優美的運動姿態和對健康的有益影響，武術在廣大羣衆中有很強的吸引力

english: excess, superfluity
to introduce something into the mind of

example_zh: 當今很多家長給孩子灌輸這樣的思想：只有在名牌大學畢業的學生將來纔有好前途。

english: an outward sign

example_zh: 只有從他發紅的眼圈上偶爾能看出他非常疲憊。

english: to restrain, check, or control with or as if with a bridle

english: to deprive of vital elements or resources, such as personnel, equipment or funding, for use elsewhere

english: preservation from destruction or failure

example_zh: 基督教中耶穌拯救靈魂的教義改變了很多人的生活。

english: commonplace, unimaginative

english: a group of people who develop new and often very surprising ideas in art, literature, etc.

english: a sensation of motion in which the individual or the individual's surroundings seem to whirl dizzily

english: to shine with or as if with subdued steady light or moderate brightness

english: occurring every day

example_zh: 電視已成爲我們日常生活的一部分。

english: a device that is used to remove something unwanted from a liquid or gas that passes through it

english: marked by ease and fluency in speaking or writing often to the point of being insincere or deceitful

example_zh: 有些人喜歡誇誇其談，其實肚子裏卻是空空如也。

a large number or amount

english: to shorten in duration or extent

example_en: It's classic Amazon: unostentatious, and no company signs on any of the buildings.
example_zh: 這就是經典的亞馬遜：樸素而不聲張，在樓上沒有任何公司的標識。

english: to arrange or direct the movements, progress, or detail of
example_en: There was some carefully choreographed flag-waving as the President drove by.
example_zh: 總統的車經過時，人們按精心編排的動作揮舞着旗幟。

english: friendly and easy to talk to
example_en: My boss is affable enough when she is not preoccupied with business problems.
example_zh: 我的老闆不忙於公事的時候還是和藹可親的。

english: descendants, children
example_en: He was surrounded by his numerous progeny.
example_zh: 衆多的子孫簇擁着他。

english: unduly adhering to one’s own opinion or to preconceived notions
example_en: He is too opinionated to listen to anyone else.
example_zh: 他太固執己見，聽不進別人的意見。

english: to come together to form a group
example_en: The passengers clustered together in small groups.
example_zh: 乘客們三五成羣聚在一起。

english: the origin or source of something
example_en: They try to understand the whole universe, its provenance and fate.
example_zh: 他們試圖認識整個宇宙，其起源及命運

english: incapable of error
example_en: No country should claim infallibility and each country should be prepared to re-examine its own attitudes for the common good.
example_zh: 任何國家都不應自稱一貫正確，各國都要準備爲了共同的利益重新檢查自己的態度。

english: something that happens or appears in many places and is not unusual
example_en: Vagrancy and begging has become co mmonplace in London.
example_zh: 流浪和乞討在倫敦已變得很常見。

english: showing a readiness or desire to fight or argue
example_en: He is a pugnacious fighter.
example_zh: 他是個好鬥的戰士。

english: to cause to do something
example_en: Doctors said surgery could induce a heart attack.
example_zh: 醫生們說手術有可能引起心臟病發作。

english: to understand
example_en: Whenever she failed to comprehend s he invariably laughed.
example_zh: 每當她聽不懂的時候，她總是會笑。

english: acting or done quickly and without thought
example_en: He tended to react in a heated and impetuous way.
example_zh: 他往往反應過火又顯魯莽。

english: hard to notice or see
example_en: The job required a subtle mind.
example_zh: 那項工作需要一個頭腦敏銳的人去做。

english: to lie in wait in a place of concealment especially for an evil purpose
example_en: There is a suspicious man lurking in the shadows.
example_zh: 有一可疑的人躲在陰暗中。

english: very great in size or amount
example_en: We are not in this to reap immense financial rewards.
example_zh: 我們從事這一行不是爲了獲得巨大的經濟回報。

english: to behave in a manner conformable to what is right, proper, or expected
example_en: Another aspect of executive presence is comportment—your way of conducting yourself in interacting with others.
example_zh: 領導者氣質的另一方面就是舉止風度——你與他人交流時行爲表現。

english: to attack or criticize in a violent or angry way
example_en: The opposition's newspapers assail the government each day.
example_zh: 反對黨的報紙每天都對政府進行猛烈抨擊。

english: written in or consisting of elegiac couplets
example_en: The mourning hall is full of wreaths, an d on all the walls elegiac scrolls are hu ng.
example_zh: 靈堂裏擺滿了花圈，牆上也掛滿了挽幛

english: no longer used by anyone
example_en: With technological changes many traditional skills have become obsolete.
example_zh: 隨着技術的革新，許多傳統技藝已被淘汰。

english: to make nervous, worried, or upset
example_en: The presence of the two policemen unsettled her.
example_zh: 兩名警察的出現讓她感到不安。

english: a person who is unusually aware of and interested in new and unconventional patterns
example_en: In 1960 s England, the Vespa shuttled around the sharp, suit - wearing hipster group Known as the Mods.
example_zh: 1960年代的英國, 偉士牌在一羣西裝筆挺的時髦雅痞摩登一族間廣爲流行。

english: not being harmed or spoiled
example_en: Be sure to select firm, unblemished fruit.
example_zh: 一定要選堅實、無疤痕的果子

english: a distinguishing characteristic, trait, or feature
example_en: Police said the explosion bore all the hallmarks of a terrorist attack.
example_zh: 警方稱這次爆炸具有恐怖分子襲擊的所有特徵。

english: the power of choosing or determining
example_en: We like to think that everything we do and everything we think is a product of our volition.
example_zh: 我們願意認爲我們所做和所想的一切都是出於自己的意志。

english: having or showing great knowledge or understanding
example_en: Liu Jun is a famous parallel prose writer of Liang dynasty, is a knowledge profound scholar.
example_zh: 劉峻是梁代著名的駢文家，更是一位知識淵博的學者。

english: characterized by lack of interest, energy, or spirit
example_en: The illness left her feeling listless and depressed.
example_zh: 那場病使她感到虛弱無力，提不起精神

english: disapproving
example_en: From frank's deprecatory remarks abo ut the money "people" owed him, she had imagined the sums to be small.
example_zh: 從弗蘭克不願意提起“人們”欠他錢的態度來看，她一直以爲這筆錢爲數不多。

english: to have a mental picture of especially in advance of realization
example_en: It’s hard to envisage a more disruptive business model.
example_zh: 很難想像一個更具有破壞性的商業模式

english: able to be understood in more than one way
example_en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
example_zh: 這份協議非常含糊，可以有多種解釋。

english: to make more prominent or noticeable
example_en: Happy couples accentuate the positive.
example_zh: 幸福伴侶總是強調積極的一面。

english: the final result
example_en: The surprising upshot is that we have lots of good but not very happy employees.
example_zh: 令人意想不到的結果是，我們有許多優秀但卻不快樂的僱員。

english: to destroy the self- possession or self- confidence
example_en: The girl was abashed by the laughter of her classmates.
example_zh: 那小姑娘因同學的鬨笑而侷促不安。

english: one that is annoying, unpleasant, or obnoxious
example_en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
example_zh: 他喝醉時會是一個有點令人討厭的人。

english: waver, vacillate
example_en: The table wobbled when I leaned on it.
example_zh: 我往桌上一靠，桌子就搖晃了起來。

english: to do away with as completely as if by pulling up by the roots
example_en: These insects are very difficult to eradicate.
example_zh: 這些昆蟲很難根除。

english: marked by transparency
someone or something that makes action or progress slower or more difficult
example_en: Larry was turning out to be a drag on her career.
example_zh: 拉里最後成了她事業上的累贅。

english: to take on an aggressively defensive attitudes
example_en: His hair bristled with anger.
example_zh: 他怒髮衝冠。

english: the outline or outer edge of something
example_en: She traced the contours of his face with her finger.
example_zh: 她用手指描繪他的臉部輪廓。

english: to get value or use form
example_en: The government and its opponents compete to exploit the troubles to their advantage.
example_zh: 政府及其反對派競相利用這些問題爲自己謀利。

english: relating to the collection and study of valuable old things
example_en: The library is rich in historical books and antiquarian.
example_zh: 家圖書館擁有大量歷史和古籍。

english: to assume or claim as true, existent, or necessary
example_en: They postulated a 500-year lifespan for a plastic container.
example_zh: 他們假定塑料容器的壽命爲500年。

english: causing death
example_en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
example_zh: 計劃中有一個致命的缺陷。

english: engross, absorb
example_en: Don't immerse yourself in the infliction too long.
example_zh: 不要長時間沉浸在痛苦經歷中。

english: to make compensation to for incurred hurt, loss, or damage
example_en: They agreed to indemnify the taxpayers against any loss
example_zh: 他們同意補償納稅人的任何損失。

english: stubbornly tenacious
to make a loud, high- pitched cry
to ooze out as if under pressure
example_en: The volcano spewed out more scorching volcanic ashes, gases and rocks.
example_zh: 火山噴出更多灼熱的火山灰、氣體和巖塊。

english: a commonplace or hackneyed statement or notion
example_en: The meeting produced the usual bromides about macroeconomic policy, third-world debt and the environment.
example_zh: 會議上提出的還是那些慣常討論的老套話題——宏觀經濟政策、第三世界債務和環境問題。

english: showing that something important is going to happen, especially something bad
example_en: The report contains numerous portentous references to a future environmental calamity.
example_zh: 報告裏有很多地方預兆性地提到了將來的環境災難。

english: to strike out, obliterate, or mark for deletion
example_en: His name was expunged from the reco rd books.
example_zh: 他的名字被從檔案簿中刪去了。

english: insulting to someone or something
to cause to sleep or rest
example_en: The rhythm of the boat lulled her to sleep.
example_zh: 小船有節奏的搖動將她送入了夢鄉。

english: a natural or artificial channel through which water flows
example_en: This river has a zigzagging watercourse and many branches.
example_zh: 這條河的河道曲折，汊流衆多。

english: morally crude, undeveloped, or unregenerate
example_en: Certain words are vulgar and not acceptable in polite society.
example_zh: 有些字眼較粗俗，不爲上流社會所接受

english: a system of government or business that has many complicated rules and ways of doing things
example_en: State bureaucracies can tend to stifle enterprise and initiative.
example_zh: 國家的官僚機構往往會扼殺人們的事業心和積極性。

english: to see beforehand
example_en: No one can foresee what will happen in the future.
example_zh: 誰也無法預見到將來會發生什麼事。

english: to produce especially as an effect or outgrowth
example_en: War beget misery and ruin.
example_zh: 戰爭導致苦難與毀滅。

english: currently or actually existing
example_en: Two fourteenth-century manuscripts of this text are still extant.
example_zh: 這個文本仍有兩份14世紀手抄本存世。

english: to give clear and effective utterance to
example_en: The president has been accused of failing to articulate an overall vision in foreign affairs.
example_zh: 總統因未能清晰表述對外交事務的整體構想而受到指責。

english: the state of being very annoyed or upset
example_en: She rolled her eyes in sheer exasperation.
example_zh: 她氣急敗壞地轉動着眼珠。

english: to refrain deliberately and often with an effort of self- denial from an action or practice
example_en: His doctor ordered him to abstain from beer and wine.
example_zh: 他的醫生囑咐他戒酒。

english: following the current fashion or style
example_en: She is a dainty, chic woman with wide- set eyes and the neck of a ballerina.
example_zh: 她是一個秀麗時髦的女人，有一對大眼睛，同樣有着芭蕾舞女演員一樣的脖子

english: a gregarious and unreserved person
example_en: His footballing skills and extrovert personality won the hearts of the public.
example_zh: 他的足球技巧和外向的個性贏得了公衆的心。

english: to agree precisely
example_en: His practice does not square with his principles.
example_zh: 他的行爲與主張不符。

english: to represent as less than is the case
example_en: The government chooses deliberately to understate the increase in prices.
example_zh: 政府有意選擇對價格的上漲輕描淡寫。

english: to involve in the nature or operation of something
example_en: He tried to avoid saying anything that would implicate him further.
example_zh: 他盡力避免說出任何會進一步牽連他的事情。

english: difficult to understand
example_en: His impenetrable eyes and inscrutable countenance give little away.
example_zh: 他讓人捉摸不透的眼神和深不可測的表情幾乎什麼也沒流露。

english: a mixture of different things
example_en: Peter Baker's bathroom is a brilliant pastiche of expensive interior design.
example_zh: 彼得·貝克的浴室是高檔室內設計的集大成之作。

english: bring about, cause
example_en: These insects can wreak havoc on crops.
example_zh: 這些昆蟲可嚴重危害農作物。

english: to let out or release
example_en: The combine disgorged a steady stream of grain.
example_zh: 收割機不斷吐出穀粒。

english: something that came before something else and may have influenced or caused it
example_en: It was permissible to take account of antecedent legislation.
example_zh: 先前的法律是允許被考慮進來的。

english: to make less angry
example_en: He tried to find ways of mollifying her.
example_zh: 他想方設法安慰她。

english: impermeable to air or nearly so
example_en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
example_zh: 將胡椒粒儲存在密封容器中，在需要的時候磨成粉。

english: having or showing a slow and stolid temperament
example_en: Her phlegmatic response itself is now a driver in this financial crisis, and people will rightly blame her for any serious accident.
example_zh: 默克爾冷漠反應的本身，如今就是此次金融危機的舵手，如果出現重大事故，人們責備她也理所應當。

english: seeking to avenge
example_en: The morning after that combat, Hugo got up with a heart filled with vengeful purposes against the King.
example_zh: 在那次決鬥後的早晨，雨果懷着對國王復仇的心起牀了。

english: to surprise and confuse
example_en: Don't confound the means with the en ds.
example_zh: 不要混淆手段與目的。

english: of or relating to fields or lands or their tenure
example_en: Since the agrarian reform polarization has taken place among the peasants.
example_zh: 在土地改革後，農民發生了分化。

english: to grope for or handle something clumsily or aimlessly
example_en: His awkwardness made him fumble with the key.
example_zh: 由於尷尬不安，他拿鑰匙開鎖時顯得笨手笨腳。

english: having a gradual and cumulative effect
example_en: They focus on overt discrimination rather than insidious aspects of racism.
example_zh: 他們關注的是公開的歧視，而不是種族主義的一些潛在問題。

english: not having all that is needed or expected
example_en: He analyzed his game and found it wanting.
example_zh: 他分析了他的比賽，發現還有待改進。

english: making provision for the future
example_en: They are provident statesmen.
example_zh: 他們是有遠見的政治家。

english: having a bad smell
example_en: Presently, most of the ground water in China gradually tend to be malodorous black river due to the deteriorating pollution.
example_zh: 目前我國大部分城市地表水由於污染日趨嚴重已經演變成黑臭水體。

english: offering or expressing a choice
example_en: We are currently investigating a number of alternative options.
example_zh: 我們現在正在研究一系列可供替代的選擇方案。

english: to gather or collect in a gradual way
example_en: At present we are gleaning information from all sources.
example_zh: 目前，我們正從各種渠道收集信息。

english: a lack of knowledge, understanding, or education
complete in every detail
example_en: It was one of the most consummate tri umphs of David Beckham's career.
example_zh: 這是貝克漢姆職業生涯中最完美的凱旋之一。

english: to give evidence of displeasure or disapproval by or as if by facial expression
example_en: This practice is frowned upon as being wasteful
example_zh: 這種行爲被認爲是浪費而不獲認可。

english: free from care, anxiety, or seriousness
having, revealing, or marked by a smug, ingratiating, and false earnestness or spirituality
example_en: The kind of unctuous tone that I've heard often at diplomatic parties.
example_zh: 我常在外交聚會上聽到的那種虛與委蛇的腔調

english: an occurrence in which you fail to think or act in the usual or proper way for a brief time and make a mistake
having no definite or clear shape or form
example_en: The cloud image indicated something amorphous, intangible, but still necessary to include in the diagram.
example_zh: 雲鏡像常被用來表示無固定形狀的、不清晰但又必須包含在圖表中的一些內容

english: marked by decay or decline
example_en: Don’t let decadent ideas eat into yourselves.
example_zh: 別讓腐朽的思想侵蝕你。

english: to add notes or comments to
example_en: Historians annotate, check and interpret the diary selections.
example_zh: 歷史學家們對這本日記選集進行了註釋、檢查和闡釋。

english: to represent (an abstraction) by a concrete instance
example_en: In his paper, there is a study of two groups who seemed to instantiate productive aspects of this.
example_zh: 他的論文裏有關於這兩個組的研究，研究似乎能似乎能舉例說明這東西有效性

english: to give energy or excitement to
example_en: Your enthusiasm will energize not just you, but also other people around you.
example_zh: 而且你的熱情不僅會點燃你自己，還包括你身邊的其他人。

english: happening, existing, or arising at precisely the same time
example_en: This synchronous behavior proved to be an immense advantage.
example_zh: 這種同步行爲被證明有巨大的優勢。

english: a combination or mixture of things
example_en: His previous fusions of jazz, pop and African melodies have proved highly successful.
example_zh: 事實證明他先前融合了爵士樂、流行樂和非洲旋律的作品非常成功。

english: notably polite or polished in manner
example_en: He tried hard to be urbane.
example_zh: 他極力作出彬彬有禮的神態。

english: to completely suppress
example_en: The company increased its stake in the business, squelching rumours of a takeover bid.
example_zh: 該公司增加了其在生意中的股份，這樣就壓制住了被收購的謠言。

english: exhibiting boldness or effrontery
example_en: An insolent boy stuck his tongue out at us.
example_zh: 一個無禮的男孩對我們伸出了舌頭。

english: causing, marked by, or expressing misery or grief
example_en: He used dolorous tone, chaotic style of painting showing extreme grief of our life.
example_zh: 他以憂傷的色調，紛亂的筆觸，表達出人生的最大悲痛。

english: into parts
example_en: The debate is tearing Wall Street asunder.
example_zh: 這場爭論令華爾街分崩離析。

english: to assail vigorously or persistently
example_en: The town has been heavily bombarded by the army backed by the airforce.
example_zh: 該鎮遭到了有空軍掩護的陸軍部隊的猛烈攻擊。

english: a person's relatives
to speak ill of
to exhibit especially in an attractive or favorable aspect
example_en: Restored films are being showcased this month at a festival in Paris.
example_zh: 本月的巴黎電影節將展映一些修復版的電影。

english: to ask in a serious and emotional way
example_en: Trevor Steven entreated them to delay their departure.
example_zh: 弗·史蒂文懇求他們晚點走。

english: clearly true and requiring no proof or explanation
example_en: This point is self-evident and needs no elaboration.
example_zh: 含義自明，無須多說。

english: not lasting forever
example_en: We are reminded just how small and how impermanent we are.
example_zh: 我們意識到自己有多麼渺小，我們的生命是何其短暫。

english: to assume the burden or responsibility of
example_en: He has had to shoulder the responsibility of his father's mistakes...
example_zh: 他得爲他父親的過錯承擔責任。

english: to court favor by a cringing or flattering manner
example_en: People fawn over you when you're famous.
example_zh: 你出了名，大家就會來討好你。

english: capable of causing infection
example_en: These viruses affect children and are highly infectious.
example_zh: 這些病毒會侵襲兒童，而且具有很強的傳染性。

english: a person who refuses to follow the customs or rules of a group
example_en: He was too much of a maverick ever to hold high office.
example_zh: 他太特立獨行，永遠不可能升職。

english: lacking life, spirit, or zest
example_en: My problem is, that when we get a few wins, we become lackadaisical .
example_zh: 我的問題是，當取得一點點地勝利時，我們就會變得懶散。

english: to place (different things) side by side
example_en: The technique Mr. Wilson uses most often is to juxtapose things for dramatic effect.
example_zh: 威爾遜先生最常用的技巧是把事物並列起來以獲得戲劇性效果。

english: to disagree politely with another person’s statement or suggestion
example_en: If even a few nations demur or cheat, the whole system can break down.
example_zh: 若再有一些國家出現反對或欺騙的情況，那麼整個系統都將崩潰。

english: dirty and in bad condition form being neglected
example_en: They took me to a sleazy back-street hotel.
example_zh: 他們把我帶到一個骯髒的后街旅館。

english: willing to do dishonest things in return for money
to have particular meaning or importance for someone
example_en: What are the issues resonating with voters?
example_zh: 什麼是投票者特別關心的問題？

english: refusing to do what other people want
example_en: Parts of the administration may be changing but others have been obdurate defenders of the status quo.
example_zh: 政府的一些部門可能正在作出改變，但是其他部門卻執意維護現狀。

english: using few words in speech or writing
example_en: His laconic reply suggested a lack of interest in the topic.
example_zh: 他簡明的回答顯得他對該話題缺乏興趣

english: aggressively malicious
example_en: He was died of a malignant tumor.
example_zh: 他死於惡性腫瘤。

english: marked by unusual delicacy or refinement
example_en: She's the prettiest, most ethereal roma ntic heroine in the movies.
example_zh: 她是所有電影中最美麗、最超凡的愛情女主角。

english: to encroach on the rights (as in trade) of others
example_en: The anyons interlope between bosons and fermions.
example_zh: 介子在玻色子和費米子之間插入。

english: a person who argues for or supports something
example_en: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
example_zh: 哈爾西被認爲是進步教育價值觀的主要擁護者。

english: a disastrous event marked by great loss and lasting distress and suffering
example_en: The recent flooding in the south was a calamity.
example_zh: 最近南方的洪水是一場災難。

english: to use for a particular purpose or to do something
example_en: The firm employs about 100 men.
example_zh: 這家公司大約僱了100人。

english: to ask humbly and earnestly of
example_en: She supplicated the judge for protection.
example_zh: 她懇求法官保護。

english: wrongdoing or misconduct especially by a public official
example_en: The mayor is condemned for the monstrous malfeasance of his administration.
example_zh: 市長被宣告有罪，由於其領導的政府瀆職。

english: appealing to or expressing emotion
example_en: These comparisons are emotive rather than analytic.
example_zh: 這些比較帶有個人感情色彩，而不是客觀分析。

english: not like talking about themselves or drawing attention to themselves
example_en: My teacher is a very quiet modest self- effacing person.
example_zh: 我的老師是一個很沉默謙虛不愛出風頭的人。

english: lacking in means of enforcement or coercion
example_en: In his view, the commission remains a toothless and ineffectual body.
example_zh: 在他看來，委員會仍然是個沒有權威而且缺乏效率的機構。

english: to examine in order to suppress or delete anything considered objectionable
example_en: Censor on film means you examine a film to see whether it can be released or not.
example_zh: 審查電影就是檢查一部電影是否能夠發行。

english: broodingly morose
example_en: The princess looked glum but later cheered up.
example_zh: 公主看起來悶悶不樂，但後來又振作起來。

english: to use the power of the law to take and keep
example_en: The deepening economic gloom may well mean that it will eventually prove necessary to cut interest rates to arrest a sharper downturn.
example_zh: 逐漸加強的經濟衰退跡象也許終將證明降低利率以抑制經濟衰退是必要的手段

english: one who travels to a shrine or holy place as a devotee
example_en: So Muhammad established the One True God in Mecca without injuring its pilgrim traffic.
example_zh: 穆罕默德就這樣在麥加創立了惟一神，絲毫沒有影響麥加朝聖者往來的數量。

english: to leave and never return to
example_en: The scheme's investors, fearful of bankruptcy, decided to abandon the project.
example_zh: 因爲擔心破產，該計劃的投資者決定放棄這個項目。

english: to pull, force, or move by violent wringing or twisting movements
example_en: They attempted to wrest control of the town from government forces.
example_zh: 他們企圖從政府軍手中奪取對這個城鎮的控制權。

english: one originating or coming from an ancestral stock or source
example_en: She is a direct descendant of Queen Victoria.
example_zh: 她是維多利亞女王的嫡系後代。

english: successful, well-known and respected
example_en: He is one of the three eminent profess ors in the college.
example_zh: 他是這所大學三名傑出教授之一。

english: to criticize harshly
example_en: He castigated himself for being so stupid.
example_zh: 他責怪自己太笨。

english: interfere without right or propriety
example_en: He is inclined to meddle in other people's affairs.
example_zh: 他總喜歡干涉別人的事。

english: to persist in a state, enterprise, or undertaking in spite of counterinfluences, opposition, or discouragement
example_en: But we need to continue to strive, to learn from other countries and persevere.
example_zh: 然而，我們也必須力爭上游，借鑑其他國家的經驗，學習他們不屈不撓的精神

english: to utter or pronounce with affectation
example_en: The young lady didn't mince their words, and predicted the worst...
example_zh: 這位女士直言相告，並做了最壞的預測

english: a scheming or crafty action or artful design intended to accomplish some usually evil end
example_en: They are attempting to counter o enemy's machination.
example_zh: 他們在試圖反擊敵人的陰謀。

english: to seek orders or votes
example_en: The party needs to canvass the uncommitted voters.
example_zh: 這個黨需要向未表明態度的選民遊說拉票。

english: to understand in a particular way
example_en: What may seem helpful behavior to you can be construed as interference by others.
example_zh: 在你看來似乎是施助的行爲在別人眼中可能就會被解讀成一種干涉。

english: a contrary or opposing force
example_en: Currently, the only counterforce to the power of the capital is the supreme political power.
example_zh: 目前在中國能夠對抗資本強大力量的只有最高的政治權利。

english: characteristic or habitual inclination or mode of emotional response
example_en: His impulsive temperament regularly got him into difficulties...
example_zh: 他容易衝動，經常因此惹麻煩。

english: to have an effect
example_en: Your political opinions will necessarily impinge on your public life.
example_zh: 你的政治觀點必然會影響你的社會生活

english: to overwhelm with shock, surprise, or wonder
example_en: He is flabbergast when he hears that his friend has been accused of murder.
example_zh: 他聽說朋友被控謀殺罪，大喫一驚。

english: not adulterated : pure
example_en: Organic food is unadulterated food produced without artificial chemicals or
example_zh: pesticides.有機食品是純粹的不含人工化學制劑或殺蟲劑的食物。

english: suggesting that something bad is going to happen in the future
example_en: There was an ominous silence at the other end of the phone
example_zh: 電話那頭出現了不祥的沉默。

english: becoming angry very easily
example_en: He had an irascible temper.
example_zh: 他脾氣易怒。

english: having a healthy reddish color
example_en: He had a naturally ruddy complexion, even more flushed now from dancing.
example_zh: 他的面色天生紅潤，現在跳了舞就更紅了。

english: competition
example_en: In this way, it effectively shut out all price rivalry.
example_zh: 用這種方法有效地排斥了一切價格競爭

english: arising from annoyance or irascibility
example_en: She was often snappish with the children.
example_zh: 她經常對孩子們兇巴巴的。

english: feeling or showing regret for bad behavior
example_en: She assumed a contrite expression.
example_zh: 她裝出一副後悔的表情。

english: very confident and daring
example_en: Your plan of going abroad is an audacious decision.
example_zh: 你計劃出國是一項大膽的決定。

english: an idea or opinion that someone has before learning about or experiencing something directly
example_en: He did not allow his preconceptions to compromise his scientific work.
example_zh: 他不允許自己的先入之見破壞自己的科學工作。

english: to turn away or aside
example_en: Efforts are being made to avert war and find a diplomatic solution.
example_zh: 各方正在爲避免戰爭、尋求外交解決途徑而作出積極的努力。

english: to count, record, or list systematically
example_en: It took me ten hours to tabulate the results.
example_zh: 我花了十個小時把結果製成表格。

english: to enclose in or as if in a capsule
to come together and unite in a common interest or focus
example_en: Some of the brightest inventors converge at these automobile conventions.
example_zh: 這些汽車會議雲集了一些最優秀的發明家。

english: to gradually become smaller
example_en: Exports are dwindling and the trade de ficit is swelling.
example_zh: 出口在縮減，貿易赤字在增長。

english: to cause to exist or to develop
example_en: The issue engendered continuing controversy.
example_zh: 這個問題引起了不斷的爭論。

english: expressing harsh criticism especially in a way that is funny
exhibiting or marked by great intensity of feeling
example_en: The pros and cons of various solutions to society’s problems generated fervent debate in my family.
example_zh: 對解決社會問題各種方法的支持與反對經常引起家人熱烈的爭論。

english: a shout of disapproval or contempt
example_en: The audience booed as she started her speech.
example_zh: 她一開始講話，聽衆便發出一陣噓聲。

english: to become bigger quickly
example_en: In London, the use of the Tube has ballooned.
example_zh: 在倫敦，坐地鐵的人激增。

english: to associate with another or others for mutual benefit
example_en: The two airlines will cooperate on ticketing and schedules.
example_zh: 兩家航空公司將在票務和航班安排上展開合作。

english: full of intense interest or excitement
example_en: The children were all agog to hear the story.
example_zh: 孩子們都渴望着要聽這個故事。

english: marked by lofty or imposing dignity
example_en: The procession made its stately progress through the streets of the city.
example_zh: 遊行的隊伍緩慢而莊嚴地穿過城市的街道。

english: being in an early stage of development
example_en: It is still in an embryonic stage.
example_zh: 它還處於萌芽階段。

english: to cause to feel very excited or happy
example_en: It gave me a big thrill to meet my favorite author in person.
example_zh: 能見到我最喜歡的作者本人使我感到興奮不已。

english: foolishly adventurous and bold
example_en: When he tested an early vaccine on himself, some described the act as foolhardy.
example_zh: 當他在自己身上試驗還處於初級階段的疫苗時，有些人說他的行爲是莽撞的。

english: protracted excessively
to assign value or merit to
example_en: But a curious thing has happened in the half-century since his death — those who opposed him now valorize him.
example_zh: 但是自從他去世半個世紀以來，一件奇怪的事情發生了—那些反對他的人現在對他評價很高。

english: a feeling of like or dislike for someone or something especially when it is not reasonable or logical
example_en: There was a deep-rooted racial prejudice long before the two countries went to war.
example_zh: 早在兩國交戰之前就有了根深蒂固的種族偏見。

english: to give, transfer or deliver into the hands or control of another
example_en: The father consigned the child to his sister's care.
example_zh: 那位父親把孩子託付給他妹妹照看。

english: someone or something that provides help or an advantage
example_en: An anonymous benefactor stepped in to provide the prize money.
example_zh: 一位匿名捐助者施以援手提供了獎金。

english: to express sorrow audibly
example_en: Banshees wail and weep, but they never howl.
example_zh: 女妖會哀號哭泣，但她們從不嚎叫。

english: strong and healthy
example_en: The Secretary of State has made a robust defence of the agreement.
example_zh: 國務卿對這項協議進行了強有力的辯護

english: brilliantly or showily bright, colorful, or impressive
example_en: The evening was crowned by her dazzling performance.
example_zh: 她那令人炫目的表演把晚會的氣氛推向高潮。

english: to pass or flow slowly through or as if through small openings or interstices
example_en: He saw there was a big hole in the back of the man's head, blood was still oozing from it.
example_zh: 他看到這個男人後腦勺上有道大口子，血還在往外滲。

english: to make cheerful and excited
example_en: We were exhilarated by the cool, pine- scented air.
example_zh: 涼爽的、帶有松香味的空氣振作起我們的精神。

english: able to change into many different forms or able to do many different things
example_en: He is a protean stylist who can move from blues to ballads and grand symphony.
example_zh: 他是一位多才多藝的藝術家，能從布魯斯轉換到民謠以及雄壯的交響樂。

english: to make weaker or worse
example_en: Consumption of alcohol impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery.
example_zh: 飲酒會削弱你駕駛汽車或操控機器的能力。

english: to provide with what is needed
example_en: She furnished him with the facts surrounding the case.
example_zh: 她向他提供了與案件有關的事實。

english: to add to something earlier, larger or more important
example_en: Hitler was determined to annex Austria to Germany.
example_zh: 希特勒決定將奧地利併入德國。

english: equal to something in value, meaning, or effect
example_en: If he resigned it would be tantamount to admitting that he was guilty.
example_zh: 他若辭職就等於承認自己有錯。

english: a great success or achievement
example_en: The winning team returned home in triumph .
example_zh: 球隊凱旋而歸。

english: bad or unfavorable
example_en: Universities in the west and China follow two adverse trends: "top-down" and “bottom-up".
example_zh: 中西方大學的形成中有着自上而下及自下而上兩個相逆的趨勢。

english: alternating change
example_en: The vicissitudes of life may suddenly make a rich man very poor.
example_zh: 在人世的盛衰變遷中, 一個有錢人突然也會變成窮光蛋。

english: talking a lot in an energetic and rapid way
example_en: The new comer in our company is voluble.
example_zh: 我們公司新來的同事很健談。

english: having or showing good judgment
example_en: At a key moment in his life, he made a judicious investment that was the foundation of his wealth.
example_zh: 在他一生的關鍵時刻, 他做出了明智的投資, 這便成了他以後富裕的基礎。

english: the anger and resentment aroused by injury or insult
example_en: The decision provoked outrage from women and human rights groups.
example_zh: 這一決定激起了婦女和人權組織的強烈憤慨。

english: marked by simplicity, frugality, or avoidance of luxury and comfort
example_en: Even expedition ships, where spartan accommodation is almost a point of pride, are offering creature comforts.
example_zh: 即使是以簡樸爲傲的探險船上也能提供舒適性。

english: to do something that is not allowed
example_en: No one is permitted to have privileges to transgress the law.
example_zh: 不允許任何人有超越法律的特權。

english: a nervous or fearful feeling of uncertain agitation
existing or occurring at the same time
example_en: The two simultaneous shots sounded like one.
example_zh: 那同時發出的兩聲槍響聽起來像是一響.

english: to thrust oneself in without invitation, permission, or welcome
example_en: The press has been blamed for intruding into people's personal lives in an unacceptable way.
example_zh: 新聞媒體因以一種令人無法接受的方式侵入人們的私生活而受到譴責。

english: composed of elements drawn from various sources
example_en: There are more and more anecdotal e xamples of an eclectic art taste develo ping in the Asian region.
example_zh: 來越多的逸聞例證表明，兼收幷蓄的藝術品味已在亞洲地區逐漸顯現出來。

english: to take something away from
example_en: This law will deprive us of our most ba sic rights.
example_zh: 這條法律將剝奪我們最基本的權利。

english: to hide or disguise
example_en: She cloaked her embarrassment by rushing into speech.
example_zh: 她急忙開口說話，以掩飾自己的尷尬。

english: to elevate by praise or in estimation
example_en: His work exalts all those virtues that w e, as Americans, are taught to hold de ar.
example_zh: 他的作品頌揚了所有那些身爲美國人應該珍視的美德。

english: to cause to combine, unite, or coalesce
example_en: Bank of America merged with a rival bank.
example_zh: 美國銀行和一家競爭銀行合併了。

english: to become impeded or stuck
example_en: Your car will bog down in the mud.
example_zh: 你的車會陷進泥沼的。

english: banish, exile
example_en: She was expatriated for some political reason.
example_zh: 她因某種政治原因而被流放國外。

english: fully and unconditionally guaranteed as a legal right, benefit, or privilege
example_en: We have no vested interest in this respect.
example_zh: 我們在這方面沒有既得利益。

english: marked by moderation
example_en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
example_zh: 尼羅河流域一年四季氣候溫和。

english: done in a secret way
example_en: He made a surreptitious entrance to the club through the little door in the brick wall.
example_zh: 他從磚牆的小門偷偷進入俱樂部。

english: showing or demanding excessive delicacy or care
chinese: 挑剔的，極其注重細節的
example_en: He was fastidious about his appearance.
example_zh: 他非常講究儀表。

english: to stop from doing or expressing something
example_en: The government failed to stifle the unrest.
example_zh: 政府沒有制止住動亂。

english: tending to prevent or ward off
example_en: Vaccination and other prophylactic measures can be carried out.
example_zh: 可以採取疫苗接種和其他預防措施。

english: to cause someone to be no longer friendly or close to another person or group
example_en: He became estranged from his family after the argument.
example_zh: 那場爭吵後他便與家人疏遠了。

english: not likely to upset or embarrass other people
example_en: She gets them to accept these changes by tactful management.
example_zh: 她用圓滑的手腕說服他們接受這些變動

english: marked by or given to offhand and often disdainful dismissal of important matters
example_en: The chief editor takes a cavalier attitude to the concept of fact checking.
example_zh: 總編輯對於覈對事實持輕蔑的態度。

english: to crumble into particles
example_en: Her grandmother's shawl had moldered away in the trunk.
example_zh: 她奶奶的圍巾已經在箱子裏腐爛了。

english: to go or pass around or about
example_en: He carefully skirted the issue of where they would live.
example_zh: 他小心地避開了他們將住在何處這個問題。

english: having or showing sad thoughts and feelings about something that you want to have or do and especially about something that made you happy in the past
a historical account of events arranged in order of time usually without analysis or interpretation
example_en: Her latest novel is a chronicle of life in a Devon village.
example_zh: 她的最近一部小說是德文郡一個小村莊的生活記事。

english: a person of prominence or brilliant achievement
example_en: Corporate luminaries cackle on about the importance of quality.
example_zh: 企業界名人喋喋不休地談論質量的重要性。

english: not wavering or weakening
example_en: You will make it if you have unfaltering determination.
example_zh: 如果你有堅定的決心，你就一定會成功！

english: to make dark or to become dark or darker in color
to assail by words or argument
example_en: All that Cheney has done was to impugn Obama's policies.
example_zh: 切尼所做的一切都是指責奧巴馬的政策

english: made, shown, or done in a way that is not easily seen or notices
example_en: They have been supplying covert milit ary aid to the rebels.
example_zh: 他們一直在暗地裏向叛亂者提供軍事支援。

english: to fall or drop suddenly in amount, value, etc. （
example_en: Mengniu and Yili have seen their shares plummet since the incident broke.
example_zh: 自事件發生以來，蒙牛和伊利的股票大幅下跌.

english: a setting free from the charge of an offense by verdict, sentence, or other legal process
example_en: The jury brought in an acquittal.
example_zh: 陪審團宣告無罪。

english: of the greatest importance
example_en: This step is all-important for solving the problem.
example_zh: 這個步驟在解決此問題中至關重要。

english: having requisite or adequate ability or qualities
not having or showing a desire to be noticed, praised, etc.
example_en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
example_zh: 他話不多，很有禮貌，爲人謙和。

english: offering a pleasant or sustaining environment （
example_en: The local people are very hospitable to strangers.
example_zh: 當地人對外來客人十分友好熱情。

english: to be usual, common, or popular
example_en: Those beliefs still prevail among certain social groups.
example_zh: 這些信念在某些社會羣體中仍很盛行。

english: to continue to do something or to try to do something even though it is difficult or other people want you to stop
example_en: When I set my mind to something, I persist.
example_zh: 一旦我對某事拿定主意，我就會堅持到底。

english: plain to the understanding especially because of clarity and precision of presentation
example_en: The analysis of concepts is a matter of finding more perspicuous and complexity-revealing words.
example_zh: 對概念進行分析是一項有關尋找更加明白易懂和能揭示複雜性的詞彙的問題。

english: to make indirect reference
example_en: Many passages in Scripture allude to this concept.
example_zh: 聖經中有許多經文間接地提到這樣的概念。

english: a person who has previously occupied a position or office to which another has succeeded
example_en: He maintained that he learned everything he knew from his predecessor Kenneth Sisam.
example_zh: 他堅稱他所知道的一切都獲自前任肯尼思·賽瑟姆。

english: showing approval
example_en: We could have done better under more favorable conditions.
example_zh: 在更有利的條件下我們還可以做得更好

english: willing to believe that other people are good and honest
example_en: Perhaps I was too trusting.
example_zh: 也許我太輕信了。

english: to overturn or overthrow from the foundation
example_en: The rebel army is attempting to subvert the government.
example_zh: 反叛軍隊企圖顛覆政府統治。

english: having the same value, use, meaning, etc.
example_en: Even the cheapest car costs the equiv alent of 70 years 'salary for a governm ent worker.
example_zh: 即使是最便宜的汽車，價格也相當於一個公務員70年的薪水。

english: reduced to poverty
example_en: They were impoverished by a prolonged spell of unemployment.
example_zh: 他們因長期失業而一貧如洗。

english: to make excessive claims for
example_en: He has a tendency to oversell himself.
example_zh: 他愛自我吹噓。

english: flagrantly wicked or impious
example_en: The EU reckons that Intel's use of such rebates was nefarious.
example_zh: 歐盟認爲，英特爾利用返點促銷用意惡毒。

english: having or seeming to have no end
example_en: The play dragged on, and seemed interminable.
example_zh: 演出拖拖拉拉地進行着，彷彿沒完沒了

english: coming from outside
example_en: For many people the Church was a symbol of external authority.
example_zh: 對許多人來講，教堂是外來權威的象徵

english: to split into fragments, parts, or factions
example_en: The party began to splinter.
example_zh: 那個黨開始分裂。

english: new and different from what has been known before
example_en: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
example_zh: 抗議者們找到一種新奇的示威方式來反對石油價格的飆升。

english: the practice of not doing or having something that is wanted or enjoyable
example_en: The meaning of life was freedom and the abstinence from evil.
example_zh: 生命的真諦是自由和避免作惡。

english: a eulogistic oration or writing
example_en: He made a speech of panegyric.
example_zh: 他作了一個頌揚性的演講。

english: marked by an overbearingly dignified or assured manner or aspect
example_en: The Cambridge World History of Human Disease is a magisterial work.
example_zh: 《劍橋世界人類疾病史》是一部權威著作。

english: to dislike greatly and often with disgust or intolerance
example_en: You loathe the smell of greasy food when you are seasick.
example_zh: 當你暈船時，你會厭惡油膩的氣味。

english: to participate in a car pool
example_en: The day after, I'll carpool to save money.
example_zh: 後天，我可以拼車省錢。

english: marked by extreme calm, impassivity, and steadiness
example_en: He remained imperturbable in spite of the hysteria and panic all around him.
example_zh: 儘管他周圍的人歇斯底里地驚慌失措，但他仍保持冷靜。

english: the act of making fun of someone or something in a cruel or harsh way
having or showing liveliness and enthusiasm
example_en: Besides ebullient congratulant word, organizer brought a lot of exquisite gifts.
example_zh: 除了熱情洋溢的祝賀詞外，主辦方還帶來了精美的小禮物。

english: able to be discussed and changed before an agreement or decision is made
example_en: He warned that his economic program for the country was not negotiable.
example_zh: 他告誡說他爲國家制訂的經濟計劃是不容商榷的。

english: someone or something that is very exaggerated in a funny or foolish way
example_en: He had unfairly presented a caricature of my views.
example_zh: 他歪曲了我的觀點。

english: friendly, sociable, and congenial
example_en: He is an educated, amiable and decent man.
example_zh: 他是個有教養、和藹可親的正人君子。

english: to stir up
example_en: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
example_zh: 第二次世界大戰激發了他的政治熱情。

english: to stimulate or excite as if by an electric shock
example_en: The aid appeal has galvanized the German business community.
example_zh: 這份救助呼籲已經促使德國的工商業界行動了起來。

english: organized to do good things for other people
example_en: The company has proved to be a most benevolent employer.
example_zh: 結果證明該公司是一個非常仁慈的僱主

english: not limited in any way
example_en: His ambition is unbounded.
example_zh: 他的野心毫無止境。

english: to show in an improper or selfish way that you are happy with you own success or another person’s failure
example_en: Do not gloat when your enemy falls.
example_zh: 不要因爲敵人的失敗而幸災樂禍。

english: to let fall, exude, or precipitate in drops or in a wet mist
example_en: We were asked to distill the crucial points of the book.
example_zh: 我們被要求從這本書中提煉出關鍵點。

english: a concealed or unexpected difficulty or obstacle
example_en: The attack hit a snag and made no headway.
example_zh: 進攻受阻，攻不進去。

english: lacking flavor, zest, interest, animation, or spirit
example_en: She made a vapid comment about the weather.
example_zh: 她對天氣作了一番平淡無奇的評論。

english: concerned only with the obvious or apparent
example_en: This guy is a superficial yuppie with no intellect whatsoever.
example_zh: 這個傢伙是個膚淺的雅皮士，沒有什麼頭腦。

english: a friendly, harmonious relationship
example_en: She understood the importance of establishing a close rapport with clients.
example_zh: 她懂得與客戶建立密切和睦關係的重要性。

english: using words that mean the opposite of what you really think especially in order to be funny
example_en: The film is more of an ironic fantasy than a horror story.
example_zh: 這部電影比較像是諷刺的幻想故事，而不是恐怖片。

english: capable of devising ways and means
example_en: He was amazingly inventive and resourceful, and played a major role in my career.
example_zh: 他極具創造力，而且足智多謀，在我的職業生涯中起到了重要的作用。

english: of or relating to the sense or organs of hearing, to sound, or to the science of sounds
example_en: The microphone converts acoustic waves to electrical signals for transmission.
example_zh: 麥克風將聲波轉化成電信號進行傳播。

english: side by side
example_en: Mary ran abreast of him toward the river.
example_zh: 瑪麗和他並肩朝河邊跑去。

english: filled, covered, or completely overrun as if by a flood
example_en: This, after all, is a company which is awash with cash.
example_zh: 這畢竟是一家現金充裕的公司。

english: sign, indication
example_en: Kurdish leaders saw the visit as an important signal of support
example_zh: 庫爾德領導人將這次訪問視作一種表示支持的重要信號。

english: to proceed slowly or with difficulty
deeply felt
example_en: We would like to take this opportunity to convey our heartfelt condolences to the families of the victims.
example_zh: 我們謹此向受害人家屬表達我們衷心的慰唁。

english: lasting for a limited time
example_en: He afforded a temporary shelter for the needy.
example_zh: 他爲窮人提供暫時的安身之處。

english: a small amount
example_en: They should win, given a modicum of luck.
example_zh: 只要有一點點運氣，他們就會贏。

english: to give, convey, or grant from or as if from a store
example_en: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
example_zh: 具備傳授知識並贏得尊敬的能力是對教師的基本要求。

english: pleasing or sweet sound
example_en: Even the too-near table of boisterous boys contributes to its euphony.
example_zh: 連近旁談笑的年輕人也貢獻出了悅耳之聲。

english: to recruit someone to join one's party, institution, or cause
example_en: Do not proselytize your work or ideas.
example_zh: 不要變節你的工作或觀念

english: an irrational abject attitude of mind toward the supernatural, nature, or God resulting from superstition
example_en: God resulting from
example_zh: superstition 迷信

english: willing to lie and trick people in order to get what is wanted
example_en: His devious nature was shown in half- lies and small dishonesties.
example_zh: 他不正直的天性表現在小謊話及細小的不誠實行爲中。

english: of or relating to the kitchen or cookery
example_en: She was keen to acquire more advanced culinary skills.
example_zh: 她熱切渴望學到更高超的烹飪技巧。

english: spirited, brave
example_en: Huang Jiguang's gallant deed is known by all Chinese.
example_zh: 中國人皆知黃繼光的英勇事蹟。

english: made up of parts that are different
example_en: America has a very heterogeneous population.
example_zh: 美國人口是由不同種族組成的。

english: to make powerless or ineffective
example_en: In combat they paralyze the enemy's will, and easily gain advantage over less experienced foes.
example_zh: 在戰鬥中他們能癱瘓敵人的意志，在對付經驗相對較少的敵人時輕易地取得戰鬥優勢。

english: extremely good and deserving to be admired and copied
to refuse to accept or support
example_en: He used his position to repudiate the charge.
example_zh: 他利用自己的職位來否認指控.

english: to rise above or go beyond the normal limits of
example_en: These issues transcend the limits of language study.
example_zh: 這些問題超出了語言研究的範圍。

english: done in haste without regard for consequences
example_en: On stage she seems hard, brash and uncompromising.
example_zh: 在舞臺上,她顯得冷酷、自以爲是而且不妥協。

english: to combine into a composite whole
example_en: The two meanings conflated.
example_zh: 這兩個意思混在一起了。

english: having the power of forcing someone to do something
example_en: Public secondary and university educa tion is also free but is not compulsory.
example_zh: 公立高中和大學教育也實行免費教育，但不是強制性的.

english: to tile to one side especially of a boat of ship
example_en: The ship listed again, and she was thrown back across the bunk.
example_zh: 船再次傾側了，她又被甩回牀鋪的另一頭。

english: damaging or harmful
example_en: Petty crime is having a deleterious effe ct on community life.
example_zh: 輕微罪行正對社區生活產生有害影響。

english: to include or place within something larger or more comprehensive
example_en: States collect taxes and subsume many of the responsibilities of governing from the county.
example_zh: 邦國負責收稅也包納交集很多郡縣一級的治理職責。

english: to cause to feel happy or confident
example_en: The party was buoyed by an election victory.
example_zh: 競選獲勝，該黨情緒一片高漲。

english: to condemn or forbid as harmful or unlawful
example_en: In some cultures surgery is proscribed.
example_zh: 在一些文化裏，外科手術是被禁止的。

english: exciting horror
to utter a deep moan indicative of pain, grief, or annoyance
example_en: We all groaned at his terrible jokes.
example_zh: 他講的笑話很糟糕，我們都發出不滿的抱怨聲。

english: an amount of money that is used for a special purpose
example_en: The Bush Foundation has funded a variety of faculty development programs.
example_zh: 布什基金會已經資助了許多教員發展項目。

english: to damage the reputation of
example_en: They spread disinformation in order to discredit politicians.
example_zh: 他們散佈假消息，企圖敗壞政治家的名聲。

english: likely to do something
example_en: When he speaks on the air, listeners are apt to mistake him for a white man.
example_zh: 他在廣播中的說話聲會讓觀衆以爲他是白人。

english: to suffer violent internal excitement
example_en: She grinned derisively while I seethed with rage
example_zh: 我怒火中燒，她卻嘲弄地咧着嘴笑。

english: to make angry
having or wielding force, authority, or influence
example_en: The World Health Organization WHO is warning about resistance to drugs which were once so potent.
example_zh: WHO對那些曾經很有效的抗生素的耐藥性發出了警告。

english: not very important
example_en: The tribunals were established for the well-integrated members of society and not for marginal individuals.
example_zh: 這個特別法庭是爲社會中的主流人羣設立的，而不是爲了無足輕重的小人物。

english: to restore to a former state
example_en: Considerable efforts have been made to rehabilitate patients who have suffered in this way.
example_zh: 爲使受這種苦的病人康復已經付出了相當大的努力。

english: being in an early stage of development
example_en: The forum is now open to all budding entrepreneurs.
example_zh: 這個論壇目前向所有企業家新秀敞開大門。

english: to experience failure
example_en: He was one of the founders of the university's medical faculty.
example_zh: 他是該大學醫學院的創建人之一。

english: the recorded events of one year
example_en: The deed will live forever in the annals of infamy.
example_zh: 這事將永遠存在醜行史記載中。

english: difficult to understand
attracted to novelty
example_en: We need better teachers, not newfangled ideas about education.
example_zh: 我們需要更好的老師, 而不是新奇的教育想法。

english: to pass quickly or abruptly from one place or condition to another
example_en: Butterflies flitted from flower to flower.
example_zh: 蝴蝶在花叢中飛來飛去。

english: a set of fundamental beliefs
trap, snare
example_en: The pitfalls of working abroad are numerous.
example_zh: 到國外工作存在許多陷阱。

english: to bother or annoy with many comments or questions
example_en: Richard's mother badgered him into taking a Spanish wife.
example_zh: 理查德的母親磨破嘴皮子，終於說服他娶了個西班牙太太。

english: a strong belief
example_en: There was not sufficient evidence to s ecure a conviction.
example_zh: 沒有足夠的證據來定罪。

english: a reflective looking inward
example_en: Take as much time as you need to introspect upon the areas above.
example_zh: 對以上方面請花儘可能多的時間來思考和反省。

english: a brief summary of a larger work or of a field of knowledge
example_en: The Roman Catholic Church has issued a compendium of its teachings.
example_zh: 羅馬天主教會已經發行了一份其教義的概略。

english: not showing enough thought or effort
example_en: The explanation is too facile for such a complex phenomenon.
example_zh: 這種解釋對於這樣複雜的情況來說過於膚淺了。

english: having a mutual or reciprocal relation
example_en: All things are interrelated and interact on each other.
example_zh: 一切事物都互相聯繫並相互作用。

english: the quality or state of having many different forms, types, ideas, etc.
example_en: Few countries have as rich a diversity of habitat as South Africa.
example_zh: 幾乎沒有哪個國家像南非那樣擁有如此多樣化的動植物棲生地。

english: designed to be used once or only a limited number of times and then thrown away
example_en: It's estimated that around 80 per cent of babies wear disposable nappies.
example_zh: 據估計約 80% 的嬰兒使用一次性尿布

english: in this vicinity
to prevent or keep from developing freely
example_en: Severe migraine can be treated with a drug which constricts the blood vessel.
example_zh: 嚴重的偏頭疼可以用一種收縮血管的藥物進行治療。

english: clearly expressed or understood
example_en: The close-up photography and commentary are clear and unambiguous.
example_zh: 那組特寫照片和附帶的評論一目瞭然，毫無含糊之處。

english: something that is base, trivial, or inferior
physiologically immature or undeveloped
example_en: We can curb juvenile delinquency by education.
example_zh: 我們可以通過教育來控制少年犯罪。

english: to drop or slide down suddenly
example_en: Sales have slumped this year.
example_zh: 今年銷售量銳減。

english: done, made, or accomplished piece by piece or in a fragmentary way
example_en: Instead of the government's piecemeal approach, what is needed is a radical shake-up of 16-19 education.
example_zh: 需要的不是政府零敲碎打的措施，而是要對16至19歲年齡段的教育進行徹底變革。

english: adorn, embellish
example_en: He tried to varnish over the facts, but it was useless.
example_zh: 他想粉飾事實，但那是徒勞的。

english: lacking foresight
to damage or ruin the force or effectiveness of
example_en: If he becomes the major opposition leader, he could hamstring a conservative-led coalition.
example_zh: 如果他成爲主要反對黨的領袖，可能會導致保守黨領導的聯合政府陷於癱瘓。

english: having or showing too much pride in your abilities or achievements
example_en: He was rather vainglorious about his own war record.
example_zh: 他非常喜歡吹噓自己的戰爭經歷。

english: to be in inward turmoil
example_en: The gardener exploded with the rage that had simmered all morning.
example_zh: 那名花匠憋了一個早上的憤怒終於爆發了。

english: degraded, sordid
example_en: It’s well known that the world of entertainment has its seamy side: drug abuse, corruption, alcoholism.
example_zh: 衆所周知，演藝界有其骯髒的一面：濫用毒品、墮落腐化、酗酒等等。

english: to abolish by authoritative action
example_en: The next prime minister could abrogate the treaty.
example_zh: 下一任首相可能會廢除這個條約。

english: of a happy lighthearted character or disposition
example_en: Face everyday in your life with a blithe spirit , try to experience , to taste , to appreciate.
example_zh: 以愉快的心態去面對你生命中的每一天，嘗試着去體會，去品味，去感激。

english: breaking out again
example_en: The patient presented with a case of recrudescent gastralgia.
example_zh: 患者的症狀是複發性胃痛。

english: pretentious nonsense
chinese: 這是他們早就多次兜售給公衆的場面話
example_en: This is the claptrap that they have peddled many times before.
example_zh: 這是他們早就多次兜售給公衆的場面話

english: involving or expressing moral approval or disapproval
example_en: The prime minister has a blind spot on ethical issues.
example_zh: 這位首相無視道德問題。

english: to express agreement
example_en: It's extremely unlikely that two such im probable events would concur.
example_zh: 兩個如此不相干的事件會同時發生是非常不可能的。

english: something that comes before something else and that often leads to or influences its development
example_en: Westwood is always the precursor of the punk revolution after all, whose goal is to challenge the traditional raiment of the fashion world.
example_zh: 韋斯特伍德始終是朋克革命的先驅者，她的目標就是向時裝界的傳統服飾挑戰

english: to draw back or in
example_en: They tried to persuade me to retract my words.
example_zh: 他們試圖說服我收回我的話。

english: mishandle, botch
affording, receiving, or sharing nurture or parental care though not related by blood or legal ties
example_en: The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.
example_zh: 俱樂部的宗旨是促進團體內部的關係。

english: to reduce drastically especially in number
example_en: The pollution could decimate the river' s thriving population of kingfishers.
example_zh: 污染可能會造成河邊大量繁殖的翠鳥大批死亡。

english: to provide for the payment of
to administer a vaccine to usually by injection
example_en: Dogs must be vaccinated against distemper
example_zh: 狗必須接種犬瘟熱疫苗。

english: to determine beforehand
example_en: These factors predetermine to a large extent the outcome.
example_zh: 這些因素在很大程度上預先決定了其結果。

english: needed for a particular purpose
example_en: The state provided the requisite capital for this farm.
example_zh: 國家爲這個農場提供了必要的資金。

english: a measure around a body
putting an end to debate or question especially by reason of irrefutability
example_en: Her attorneys claim there is no conclu sive evidence that any murders took place.
example_zh: 她的律師聲稱並無確鑿證據表明發生了謀殺。

english: very small in amount or number
favoring or inclined to start quarrels or wars
example_en: His bellicose disposition alienated his friend.
example_zh: 他生性好鬥，他的朋友們都疏遠了他。

english: to settle judicially
inclined by nature to companionship with others of the same species
example_en: She's a sociable child who'll talk to anyone.
example_zh: 她是個合羣的孩子，跟誰都有話說。

english: a source of relief or consolation
a formal inquiry into or discussion of a subject
small bumps on your skin that are caused by cold, fear, or a sudden feeling of excitement
example_en: When I ride a bicycle on a windy night, I get goosebumps.
example_zh: 當我在起風的夜裏騎腳踏車時，我會起雞皮疙瘩。

english: expressing a lot of emotion
example_en: He was effusive in his praise for the ge neral.
example_zh: 他對那位將軍極盡溢美之詞。

english: to renounce allegiance or subjection
example_en: Finally the people revolted against the military dictatorship.
example_zh: 人民最終起來反抗軍事獨裁。

english: having or showing qualities that are considered good in business
example_en: This activity was carried on in a businesslike manner.
example_zh: 這個活動開展的效率很高。

english: to attack or overcome by aggressive argument
example_en: The aim was to bludgeon speculators and impress creditors.
example_zh: 目標是要打擊投機倒把並讓債權人留下深刻印象。

english: to set in motion
example_en: There was one teacher who really ignited my interest in words
example_zh: 曾經有一位老師真正激起了我對文字的興趣。

english: big and heavy
example_en: Don had a hefty roll of flab overhanging his waistband.
example_zh: 唐的腰間沉甸甸地墜着一圈贅肉。

english: to instruct and improve especially in moral and religious knowledge
example_en: They tried to edify the child with music.
example_zh: 他們試圖用音樂陶冶這孩子。

english: to bring into peril
example_en: Conservationists say the oil leak could imperil the long-term survival of the creatures.
example_zh: 自然保護協會人士認爲石油泄露將 長期 威脅海龜的生存。

english: arranged or organized in a logical or regular way
example_en: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
example_zh: 全體船員秩序井然地準備棄船。

english: sharing a border, wall, or point
example_en: The house adjacent to ours has been sold, so we have a new neighbour.
example_zh: 與我們毗鄰的房子賣出去了，因此我們有了一個新鄰居。

english: to take part in or experience something along with others
example_en: They preferred not to partake in the social life of the town.
example_zh: 他們不想參加這個鎮的社交活動。

english: a standard method or procedure that is mindlessly adhered to or that minimizes individuality
example_en: The union's support had been in lockstep for years.
example_zh: 工會的支持多年來一直按部就班地延續着。

english: not straight, short, and direct
example_en: His explanation was circuitous and puzzling.
example_zh: 他的解釋在兜圈子，讓人費解。

english: to talk or write foolishly
example_en: He waffled on about everything that didn't matter.
example_zh: 他繼續對所有無關緊要的事胡扯了一通

english: a wicked act or thing
example_en: He thought of New York as a den of iniquity.
example_zh: 他把紐約視爲罪惡的淵藪。

english: not true and is not based on facts
example_en: The charges against her are baseless.
example_zh: 對她的指控毫無根據。

english: lacking discretion, wisdom, or good judgment
example_en: The Government of Jamaica consider it imprudent to abolish the death penalty.
example_zh: 牙買加政府認爲廢除死刑是輕率之舉。

english: to give joy to
example_en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
example_zh: 戰爭結束，人們終於可以歡欣鼓舞了。

english: capable of working, functioning, or developing adequately
example_en: Their defense markets are too small to sustain economically viable production runs.
example_zh: 他們的國防市場太小，就經濟可行性而言不足以維持生產。

english: meant to be humorous or funny
example_en: Some people are inherent and serious, have a few people additionally inherent facetious.
example_zh: 有些人天生嚴肅，另有一些人天生愛開玩笑。

english: a rapid or sudden rise
to free from or as if from a tether
example_en: Only better regulation can untether economies from the fickle fortunes of finance.
example_zh: 只有更好的監管，才能把經濟體從金融業變幻無常的命運中解脫出來。

english: helpful information or criticism that is given to someone to say what can be done to improve a performance, product, etc.
example_en: We need both positive and negative feedback from our customers.
example_zh: 我們需要顧客正反兩方面的反饋意見。

english: to give and take mutually
example_en: He needs these people to fulfill his ambitions and reciprocates by bringing out the best in each of them.
example_zh: 他需要這些人去實現他的雄心壯志，作爲回報，他也會讓他們充分施展各自的才能。

example_zh: 所有的燈都熄滅了，大家都變得歇斯底里起來。

english: meticulously or excessively critical
example_en: He is so hypercritical that he corrects every mistake his students made.
example_zh: 他很苛刻，對於學生的每個錯誤都要糾正。

english: very careful about doing something in a extremely accurate and exact way

example_zh: 畫這幅畫的時候，畫家對細節真是一絲不苟。

english: a list or supply of dramas, operas, pieces, or parts that a company or person is prepared to perform
